hadiths.ar: 1141 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَوْنٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ،  «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَعَنَ الْمُصَوِّرَ».
hadiths.en: 1141 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shu'ba narrated to us, from 'Awn, from his father, "that the Prophet ﷺ cursed the image-maker."

hadiths.ar: 1142 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ ، عَنْ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ ، قَالَ: «رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَرَأَيْتُ هَذِهِ مِنْهُ بَيْضَاءَ وَأَشَارَ إِلَى الْعَنْفَقَةِ، قَالَ: فَقِيلَ لَهُ: مِثْلُ مَنْ أَنْتَ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَا أَبَا جُحَيْفَةَ؟ قَالَ: أَبْرِي النَّبْلَ وَأَرِيشُهَا».
hadiths.en: 1142 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu Juhayfa, who said: "I saw the Prophet ﷺ, and I saw this part of him white" — and he pointed to the tuft of hair beneath the lower lip. He said: He was asked: "What were you like at that time, O Abu Juhayfa?" He said: "I used to trim arrows and fletch them."

hadiths.ar: 1143 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسٌ ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْأَقْمَرِ ، عَنْ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «لَا آكُلُ مُتَّكِئًا».
hadiths.en: 1143 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Qays narrated to us, from 'Ali ibn al-Aqmar, from Abu Juhayfa, that the Prophet ﷺ said: "I do not eat while reclining."

sections.title_ar: وَالْأَشْعَثِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم .
sections.title_en: And al-Ash'ath ibn Qays, from the Prophet ﷺ

hadiths.ar: 1144 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ شَرِيكٍ الْعَامِرِيِّ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَدِيٍّ الْكِنْدِيِّ ، عَنِ الْأَشْعَثِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ ، قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَشْكَرُ النَّاسِ لِلهِ أَشْكَرُهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ».
hadiths.en: 1144 - Yunus narrated to us, saying: Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Talha narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah ibn Sharik al-'Amiri, from 'Abd al-Rahman ibn 'Adi al-Kindi, from al-Ash'ath ibn Qays, who said: The Prophet ﷺ said: "The most grateful of people to God are those most grateful to people."

hadiths.ar: 1145 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ عَقِيلِ بْنِ طَلْحَةَ السُّلَمِيِّ ، عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ هَيْصَمٍ ، عَنِ الْأَشْعَثِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ ، قَالَ:  «قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، إِنَّا نَزْعُمُ أَنَّا مِنْكُمْ أَوْ أَنَّكُمْ مِنَّا - شَكَّ أَبُو بِشْرٍ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: نَحْنُ بَنُو النَّضْرِ بْنِ كِنَانَةَ لَا نَنْتَفِي مِنْ أَبِينَا وَلَا نَقْفُو أُمَّنَا، قَالَ: فَقَالَ الْأَشْعَثُ: لَا أَجِدُ أَحَدًا - أَوْ لَا أُوتَى بِأَحَدٍ - نَفَى قُرَيْشًا مِنْ كِنَانَةَ إِلَّا جَلَدْتُهُ الْحَدَّ».
hadiths.en: 1145 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama narrated to us, from 'Aqil ibn Talha al-Sulami, from Muslim ibn Haysam, from al-Ash'ath ibn Qays, who said: "I said: 'O Messenger of God, we claim that we are from you, or that you are from us' — Abu Bishr was unsure which — and the Messenger of God ﷺ said: 'We are the sons of al-Nadr ibn Kinana; we do not disown our father and we do not slander our mother.' Al-Ash'ath said: 'I will not find anyone' — or: 'No one will be brought to me' — 'who denies that Quraysh descend from Kinana without my flogging him the prescribed punishment.'"

hadiths.ar: 1146 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا وَائِلٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ قَالَ: «مَنْ حَلَفَ عَلَى يَمِينٍ كَاذِبَةٍ لِيَقْتَطِعَ بِهَا مَالَ أَخِيهِ لَقِيَ اللهَ وَهُوَ عَلَيْهِ غَضْبَانُ. فَأَتَى عَلَيْنَا الْأَشْعَثُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ قَالَ: مَا حَدَّثَكُمْ أَبُو عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ؟ فَأَخْبَرْنَاهُ، فَقَالَ: صَدَقَ، فِيَّ نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآيَةُ: {إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِعَهْدِ اللهِ وَأَيْمَانِهِمْ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلا أُولَئِكَ لا خَلاقَ لَهُمْ فِي الآخِرَةِ} إِلَى آخِرِ الْآيَةِ، خَاصَمْتُ رَجُلًا فِي بِئْرٍ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: بَيِّنَتُكَ أَوْ يَمِينُهُ، قُلْتُ: إِذًا يَحْلِفَ وَهُوَ آثِمٌ».
hadiths.en: 1146 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shu'ba narrated to us, from al-A'mash, who said: I heard Abu Wa'il narrate from 'Abd Allah, who said: "Whoever swears a false oath in order to seize the property of his brother will meet God while He is angry with him." Then al-Ash'ath ibn Qays came to us and said: "What did Abu 'Abd al-Rahman narrate to you?" We told him, and he said: "He has spoken truly. This verse was revealed about me: {Indeed, those who exchange God's covenant and their oaths for a small price — those will have no share in the Hereafter} to the end of the verse. I disputed with a man over a well before the Prophet ﷺ, and the Messenger of God ﷺ said: 'Your proof, or his oath.' I said: 'Then he will swear, and he is a sinner.'"

hadiths.ar: 1147 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا وَرْقَاءُ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ قَالَ: «مَنْ حَلَفَ عَلَى يَمِينِ صَبْرٍ لِيَقْتَطِعَ بِهَا مَالًا وَهُوَ فِيهَا فَاجِرٌ لَقِيَ اللهَ عز وجل وَهُوَ عَلَيْهِ غَضْبَانُ. قَالَ: فَخَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا الْأَشْعَثُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ الْكِنْدِيُّ فَقَالَ: مَا حَدَّثَكُمْ أَبُو عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ؟ قُلْنَا: كَذَا وَكَذَا، قَالَ: صَدَقَ، نَزَلَتْ فِيَّ؛ خَاصَمْتُ رَجُلًا فِي بِئْرٍ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَقَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: بَيِّنَتُكَ أَوْ يَمِينُهُ، قَالَ: قُلْتُ: إِذًا يَحْلِفَ وَهُوَ آثِمٌ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: مَنْ حَلَفَ عَلَى يَمِينِ صَبْرٍ هُوَ فِيهَا فَاجِرٌ لِيَقْتَطِعَ بِهَا مَالًا لَقِيَ اللهَ عز وجل وَهُوَ عَلَيْهِ غَضْبَانُ، وَنَزَلَتْ: {إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِعَهْدِ اللهِ وَأَيْمَانِهِمْ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلا} إِلَى آخِرِ الْآيَةِ».
hadiths.en: 1147 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Warqa' narrated to us, from Mansur, from Abu Wa'il, from 'Abd Allah, who said: "Whoever swears a binding oath in order to seize property while he is lying in it will meet God, Mighty and Majestic, while He is angry with him." He said: Al-Ash'ath ibn Qays al-Kindi came out to us and said: "What did Abu 'Abd al-Rahman narrate to you?" We said: "Such and such." He said: "He has spoken truly. It was revealed about me: I disputed with a man over a well before the Messenger of God ﷺ, and the Messenger of God ﷺ said to me: 'Your proof, or his oath.' I said: 'Then he will swear, and he is a sinner.' The Messenger of God ﷺ said: 'Whoever swears a binding oath in which he is lying in order to seize property will meet God, Mighty and Majestic, while He is angry with him.' And it was revealed: {Indeed, those who exchange God's covenant and their oaths for a small price} to the end of the verse."

hadiths.ar: 1148 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ: أَنْبَأَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ خَبَّابًا قَالَ: «شَكَوْنَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شِدَّةَ الرَّمْضَاءِ فَلَمْ يُشْكِنَا».
hadiths.en: 1148 - Yunus narrated to us, saying: Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shu'ba narrated to us, saying: Abu Ishaq informed us, from Sa'id ibn Wahb, who said: I heard Khabbab say: "We complained to the Messenger of God ﷺ about the intensity of the scorching heat, but he did not relieve our complaint."

hadiths.ar: 1149 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ: أَنْبَأَنَا أَبُو  إِسْحَاقَ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ حَارِثَةَ بْنَ مُضَرِّبٍ قَالَ: «دَخَلْنَا عَلَى خَبَّابٍ وَقَدِ اكْتَوَى، فَقَالَ: مَا أَعْلَمُ أَحَدًا لَقِيَ مِنَ الْبَلَاءِ مَا لَقِيتُ، لَقَدْ مَكَثْتُ عَلَى عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا أَجِدُ دِرْهَمًا، وَإِنَّ فِي نَاحِيَةِ بَيْتِي هَذَا أَرْبَعِينَ أَلْفًا، وَلَوْلَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَانَا أَوْ نَهَى أَنْ يَتَمَنَّى أَحَدٌ الْمَوْتَ لَتَمَنَّيْتُهُ».
hadiths.en: 1149 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shu'ba narrated to us, saying: Abu Ishaq informed us, saying: I heard Haritha ibn Mudarrib say: "We visited Khabbab, who had been cauterized, and he said: 'I do not know anyone who has suffered such hardship as I have. I lived in the time of the Prophet ﷺ without finding a single dirham, and now in a corner of this house of mine there are forty thousand. Were it not that the Messenger of God ﷺ forbade us — or forbade anyone — to wish for death, I would have wished for it.'"

hadiths.ar: 1150 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الضُّحَى يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ ، عَنْ خَبَّابٍ ، قَالَ: «كُنْتُ رَجُلًا قَيْنًا فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، فَكَانَ لِي عَلَى الْعَاصِ بْنِ وَائِلٍ دَرَاهِمُ فَأَتَيْتُهُ أَتَقَاضَاهُ فَقَالَ: لَا أَقْضِيكَ حَتَّى تَكْفُرَ بِمُحَمَّدٍ! فَقُلْتُ: لَا أَكْفُرُ بِمُحَمَّدٍ  صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى يُمِيتَكَ اللهُ ثُمَّ يَبْعَثَكَ. قَالَ: فَقَالَ: دَعْنِي حَتَّى أَمُوتَ ثُمَّ أُبْعَثَ فَيَصِيرَ لِي مَالٌ وَوَلَدٌ فَأَقْضِيَكَ! قَالَ: فَنَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآيَةُ: {أَفَرَأَيْتَ الَّذِي كَفَرَ بِآيَاتِنَا وَقَالَ لأُوتَيَنَّ مَالا وَوَلَدًا}».
hadiths.en: 1150 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shu'ba narrated to us, from al-A'mash, who said: I heard Abu al-Duha narrate from Masruq, from Khabbab, who said: "I was a blacksmith in the pre-Islamic period, and al-'As ibn Wa'il owed me some dirhams. I came to him to demand payment and he said: 'I will not pay you until you disbelieve in Muhammad!' I said: 'I will not disbelieve in Muhammad ﷺ until God causes you to die and then resurrects you.' He said: 'Leave me until I die and am resurrected, and then I will have wealth and children, and I will pay you!' So this verse was revealed: {Have you seen the one who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children"?}"

sections.title_ar: وَعَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم .
sections.title_en: And ʿAmr ibn Ḥurayth, from the Prophet, peace be upon him.
title_en_alternates: And ʿAmr ibn Huraith, on the authority of the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him).

hadiths.ar: 1151 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ سَرِيعٍ ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ ، قَالَ: «صَلَّيْتُ خَلْفَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَرَأَ بِـ {إِذَا الشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ}، فَلَمَّا أَتَى عَلَى هَذِهِ الْآيَةِ {وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ * وَالصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ} قُلْتُ فِي نَفْسِي مَا اللَّيْلُ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ وَالصُّبْحُ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ؟».
hadiths.en: 1151 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: al-Masʿūdī narrated to us, from al-Walīd ibn Sarīʿ, from ʿAmr ibn Ḥurayth, who said: “I prayed behind the Prophet, peace be upon him, and he recited {When the sun is wrapped up} (Qur’an 81:1). When he reached this verse {By the night as it departs, and by the dawn as it breathes} (Qur’an 81:17–18), I said to myself: What is ‘the night as it departs’ and ‘the dawn as it breathes’?” [The text ends here in the source, without a closing quotation mark.]
en_alternates: 1151 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: al-Masʿudi narrated to us, from al-Walid ibn Sariʿ, from ʿAmr ibn Huraith, who said: «I prayed behind the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him), and he recited {When the sun is wrapped up}. When he reached this verse: {And by the night as it departs * and by the dawn as it breathes}, I said to myself: What is 'the night as it departs' and 'the dawn as it breathes'?»

hadiths.ar: 1152 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي السَّفَرِ وَحُصَيْنٍ ، سَمِعَا الشَّعْبِيَّ يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ الْبَارِقِيَّ يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «الْخَيْلُ مَعْقُودٌ فِي نَوَاصِيهَا الْخَيْرُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ، قِيلَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، مَا الْخَيْرُ؟ قَالَ: الْأَجْرُ وَالْمَغْنَمُ».
hadiths.en: 1152 - Yunus narrated to us, saying: Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shu'ba narrated to us, from Ibn Abi al-Safar and Husayn, who both heard al-Sha'bi say: I heard 'Urwa ibn Abi al-Ja'd al-Bariqi say: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: "Goodness is tied to the forelocks of horses until the Day of Resurrection." He was asked: "O Messenger of God, what is the goodness?" He said: "Reward and booty."

hadiths.ar: 1153 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الْعَيْزَارَ بْنَ حُرَيْثٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الْجَعْدِ الْبَارِقِيِّ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «الْخَيْلُ مَعْقُودٌ فِي نَوَاصِيهَا الْخَيْرُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ، قِيلَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، مَا الْخَيْرُ؟ قَالَ: الْأَجْرُ وَالْمَغْنَمُ».
hadiths.en: 1153 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shu'ba narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, who said: I heard al-'Ayzar ibn Hurayth narrate from 'Urwa ibn al-Ja'd al-Bariqi, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said: "Goodness is tied to the forelocks of horses until the Day of Resurrection." He was asked: "O Messenger of God, what is the goodness?" He said: "Reward and booty."

hadiths.ar: 1154 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ ، عَنْ أَبِي حُمَيْدَةَ الظَّاعِنِيِّ ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ الْبَارِقِيِّ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «الْخَيْلُ مَعْقُودٌ فِي نَوَاصِيهَا الْخَيْرُ، فَقِيلَ: وَمَا الْخَيْرُ؟ قَالَ: الْأَجْرُ وَالْغَنِيمَةُ».
hadiths.en: 1154 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: al-Mas'udi narrated to us, from Abu Humayda al-Za'ini, from 'Urwa al-Bariqi, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: "Goodness is tied to the forelocks of horses." It was said: "And what is the goodness?" He said: "Reward and spoils."

hadiths.ar: 1155 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الزُّبَيْرُ بْنُ خِرِّيتٍ الْأَزْدِيُّ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي نُعَيْمُ بْنُ أَبِي هِنْدٍ الْأَشْجَعِيُّ ، قَالَ:  «رُئِيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَمْسَحُ خَدَّ فَرَسٍ، فَقِيلَ لَهُ فِي ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: إِنَّ جِبْرِيلَ عَاتَبَنِي فِي الْفَرَسِ». قَالَ أَبُو بِشْرٍ : أَنْبَأَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْفُرَاتِ، عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنِ الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ خِرِّيتٍ، عَنْ نُعَيْمِ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ.
hadiths.en: 1155 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Jarir ibn Hazim narrated to us, saying: al-Zubayr ibn Khirrit al-Azdi narrated to us, saying: Nu'aym ibn Abi Hind al-Ashja'i narrated to me, saying: "The Prophet ﷺ was seen wiping the cheek of a horse. He was asked about that, and the Messenger of God ﷺ said: 'Gabriel rebuked me concerning the horse.'" Abu Bishr said: Ahmad ibn al-Furat informed us, from Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Sa'id ibn Zayd, from al-Zubayr ibn Khirrit, from Nu'aym ibn Abi Hind, from 'Urwa.

hadiths.ar: 1156 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي الْحَكَمُ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي لَيْلَى يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ قَالَ: «مُعَقِّبَاتٌ لَا يَخِيبُ قَائِلُهُنَّ - أَوْ قَالَ: فَاعِلُهُنَّ - أَنْ تُكَبِّرَ اللهَ أَرْبَعًا وَثَلَاثِينَ، وَتُسَبِّحَهُ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ، وَتَحْمَدَهُ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ دُبُرَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ. قَالَ الْحَكَمُ: فَمَا تَرَكْتُهُنَّ بَعْدُ». وَرَوَى هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ أَبُو عَامِرٍ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى عَنْ كَعْبٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم.
hadiths.en: 1156 - Yunus narrated to us, saying: Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shu'ba narrated to us, saying: al-Hakam informed me, saying: I heard Ibn Abi Layla narrate from Ka'b ibn 'Ujra, who said: "There are after-prayer phrases whose sayer is never disappointed — or he said: whose doer — namely to say 'God is greatest' thirty-four times, to glorify Him ('Glory be to God') thirty-three times, and to praise Him ('Praise be to God') thirty-three times, after every prayer." Al-Hakam said: "I have not left them since." Abu 'Amir narrated this hadith from Sufyan, from Mansur, from al-Hakam, from Ibn Abi Layla, from Ka'b, from the Prophet ﷺ.

hadiths.ar: 1157 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي  الْحَكَمُ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي لَيْلَى قَالَ: «لَقِيَنِي كَعْبُ بْنُ عُجْرَةَ فَقَالَ: أَلَا أُهْدِي إِلَيْكَ هَدِيَّةً؟ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْنَا: قَدْ عَرَفْنَا كَيْفَ نُسَلِّمُ عَلَيْكَ، فَكَيْفَ نُصَلِّي عَلَيْكَ؟ قَالَ: قُولُوا: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ».
hadiths.en: 1157 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shu'ba narrated to us, saying: al-Hakam informed me, saying: I heard Ibn Abi Layla say: "Ka'b ibn 'Ujra met me and said: 'Shall I not give you a gift? The Prophet ﷺ came out to us and we said: We have learned how to greet you with peace, so how do we invoke blessings upon you? He said: Say: O God, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You sent blessings upon the family of Ibrahim; You are Praiseworthy and Glorious. O God, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You blessed the family of Ibrahim; You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.'"

hadiths.ar: 1158 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْأَصْبَهَانِيِّ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللهِ بْنَ مَعْقِلٍ يَقُولُ: «جَلَسْتُ إِلَى كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ فِي هَذَا الْمَسْجِدِ فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ قَوْلِ اللهِ عز وجل: {فَفِدْيَةٌ مِنْ صِيَامٍ أَوْ صَدَقَةٍ أَوْ نُسُكٍ}، فَقَالَ: فِيَّ نَزَلَتْ؛ حُمِلْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالْقَمْلُ يَتَنَاثَرُ عَلَى وَجْهِي، فَقَالَ: مَا كُنْتُ أَرَى الْجَهْدَ يَبْلُغُ بِكَ مَا أَرَى! انْحَرْ شَاةً، فَقُلْتُ: لَا أَجِدُ، فَنَزَلَتْ: {فَفِدْيَةٌ مِنْ صِيَامٍ}  ؛ ثَلَاثَةُ أَيَّامٍ، أَوْ إِطْعَامُ سِتَّةِ مَسَاكِينَ نِصْفَ صَاعٍ، نَزَلَتْ فِيَّ خَاصَّةً وَهِيَ لَكُمْ عَامَّةً».
hadiths.en: 1158 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shu'ba narrated to us, from 'Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Asbahani, who said: I heard 'Abd Allah ibn Ma'qil say: "I sat with Ka'b ibn 'Ujra in this mosque and asked him about the saying of God, Mighty and Majestic: {then a ransom of fasting, or charity, or sacrifice}. He said: 'It was revealed about me. I was carried to the Messenger of God ﷺ with lice scattering over my face, and he said: I did not think the hardship had reached you to the extent that I see! Slaughter a sheep. I said: I cannot find one. So it was revealed: {then a ransom of fasting} — three days — or feeding six poor people, half a sa' each. It was revealed specifically about me, and it is general for you.'"

hadiths.ar: 1159 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ ، عَنْ مَوْلًى لِبَنِي سَالِمٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ أَحَدُكُمْ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ لِلصَّلَاةِ فَهُوَ فِي صَلَاةٍ، فَلَا يُشَبِّكَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَصَابِعَهُ بَعْدَمَا يَتَوَضَّأُ أَوْ بَعْدَمَا يَدْخُلُ الصَّلَاةَ».
hadiths.en: 1159 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Ibn Abi Dhi'b narrated to us, from Sa'id al-Maqburi, from a freedman of Banu Salim, from his father, from Ka'b ibn 'Ujra, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: "When one of you performs ablution and then goes out to the prayer, he is in prayer; so let none of you interlace his fingers after performing ablution or after entering the prayer."

hadiths.ar: 1160 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى الْهِلَالِيُّ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ كَعْبٍ ، قَالَ: «دَخَلَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ  اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَسْجِدَ فَقَالَ: مَنْ هَاهُنَا؟ هَلْ تَسْمَعُونَ؟ إِنَّهُ يَكُونُ بَعْدِي أُمَرَاءُ يَعْمَلُونَ بِغَيْرِ طَاعَةِ اللهِ، فَمَنْ شَارَكَهُمْ فِي عَمَلِهِمْ وَأَعَانَهُمْ عَلَى ظُلْمِهِمْ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّي وَلَسْتُ مِنْهُ، وَمَنْ لَمْ يَشْرَكْهُمْ فِي عَمَلِهِمْ وَلَمْ يُعِنْهُمْ عَلَى ظُلْمِهِمْ فَهُوَ مِنِّي وَأَنَا مِنْهُ».
hadiths.en: 1160 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Sulayman ibn al-Mughira narrated to us, saying: Musa al-Hilali narrated to us, from his father, from Ka'b, who said: "The Messenger of God ﷺ came into the mosque to us and said: 'Who is here? Are you listening? After me there will be rulers who act in disobedience to God. Whoever joins them in their work and helps them in their wrongdoing is not from me and I am not from him; and whoever does not join them in their work and does not help them in their wrongdoing, he is from me and I am from him.'"

hadiths.ar: 1161 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ وَأَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى ، عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ ، قَالَ: «كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَمَنَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ وَنَحْنُ مُحْرِمُونَ وَقَدْ حَالَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ الْبَيْتِ، وَلِي وَفْرَةٌ، فَجَعَلَ الْقَمْلُ يَتَنَاثَرُ عَلَيَّ - أَوْ  قَالَ: عَلَى وَجْهِي، فَقَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: يُؤْذِيكَ هَوَامُّكَ؟، قُلْتُ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: فَاحْلِقْ رَأْسَكَ، وَصُمْ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ أَوْ أَطْعِمْ سِتَّةَ مَسَاكِينَ أَوِ انْسُكْ نُسُكًا».
hadiths.en: 1161 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Hushaym and Abu 'Awana narrated to us, from Abu Bishr, from Mujahid, from 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla, from Ka'b ibn 'Ujra, who said: "We were with the Prophet ﷺ at the time of al-Hudaybiyya, in a state of ihram, and the polytheists had blocked us from the House. I had thick hair, and lice began to scatter over me — or he said: over my face. The Messenger of God ﷺ said to me: 'Are your vermin troubling you?' I said: 'Yes.' He said: 'Then shave your head, and fast three days, or feed six poor people, or offer a sacrifice.'"

hadiths.ar: 1162 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ ، قَالَ: «خَرَجْتُ مَعَ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ يَوْمَ الْعِيدِ فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ قَبْلَهَا، فَلَمَّا صَلَّيْنَا رَأَى النَّاسَ عُنُقًا وَاحِدًا يَنْطَلِقُونَ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ، فَقَالَ: مَا يَصْنَعُ هَؤُلَاءِ؟، قُلْتُ: يَنْطَلِقُونَ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ، فَقَالَ: إِنَّ هَذَا لَبِدْعَةٌ وَتَرْكٌ لِلسُّنَّةِ».
hadiths.en: 1162 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Ibn Abi Dhi'b narrated to us, from Sa'd ibn Ishaq, from his paternal uncle, who said: "I went out with Ka'b ibn 'Ujra on the day of the festival and he did not pray before it. When we had prayed he saw the people streaming as one body toward the mosque, and he said: 'What are these doing?' I said: 'They are heading to the mosque.' He said: 'This is an innovation and an abandonment of the Sunna.'"

hadiths.ar: 1163 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ ، عَنْ فُرَاتٍ الْقَزَّازِ ، عَنْ أَبِي الطُّفَيْلِ ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ أَسِيدٍ الْغِفَارِيِّ مِنْ أَهْلِ الصُّفَّةِ، قَالَ: «اطَّلَعَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَنَحْنُ نَتَذَاكَرُ السَّاعَةَ، فَقَالَ: إِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَا تَقُومُ حَتَّى يَكُونَ عَشْرُ آيَاتٍ: الدُّخَانُ، وَالدَّجَّالُ، وَالدَّابَّةُ، وَطُلُوعُ الشَّمْسِ مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا، وَثَلَاثَةُ خُسُوفٍ خَسْفٌ بِالْمَشْرِقِ وَخَسْفٌ بِالْمَغْرِبِ وَخَسْفٌ بِجَزِيرَةِ الْعَرَبِ، وَنُزُولُ عِيسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ، وَفَتْحُ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ، وَنَارٌ تَخْرُجُ مِنْ قَعْرِ عَدَنٍ تَسُوقُ النَّاسَ إِلَى الْمَحْشَرِ».
hadiths.en: 1163 - Yunus narrated to us, saying: Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: al-Mas'udi narrated to us, from Furat al-Qazzaz, from Abu al-Tufayl, from Hudhayfa ibn Asid al-Ghifari, one of the People of the Bench, who said: "The Messenger of God ﷺ looked in on us while we were discussing the Hour, and he said: 'The Hour will not come until there are ten signs: the smoke; the Dajjal; the Beast; the rising of the sun from its place of setting; three sinkings of the earth — one in the east, one in the west and one in the Arabian Peninsula; the descent of 'Isa ibn Maryam; the release of Yajuj and Majuj; and a fire that comes out of the depths of Aden driving the people to the place of gathering.'"

hadiths.ar: 1164 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْمُثَنَّى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي الطُّفَيْلِ ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ أَسِيدٍ «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَتَاهُ مَوْتُ النَّجَاشِيِّ فَقَالَ: إِنَّ أَخَاكُمْ مَاتَ بِغَيْرِ أَرْضِكُمْ، فَقُومُوا فَصَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ، فَصَفَّهُمْ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَلْفَهُ وَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ».
hadiths.en: 1164 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: al-Muthanna ibn Sa'id narrated to us, from Qatada, from Abu al-Tufayl, from Hudhayfa ibn Asid, "that news of the death of al-Najashi reached the Prophet ﷺ, and he said: 'Your brother has died in a land other than yours; so rise and pray over him.' The Messenger of God ﷺ arranged them in rows behind him and prayed over him."

hadiths.ar: 1165 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ عَمْرٍو وَجَرِيرِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ ،  فَأَمَّا طَلْحَةُ فَقَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ اللَّيْثِيُّ أَنَّ أَبَا الطُّفَيْلِ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ أَسِيدٍ الْغِفَارِيِّ أَبِي سَرِيحَةَ ، وَأَمَّا جَرِيرٌ فَقَالَ: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ آلِ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ - وَحَدِيثُ طَلْحَةَ أَتَمُّهُمَا وَأَحْسَنُ - قَالَ: «ذَكَرَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الدَّابَّةَ فَقَالَ: لَهَا ثَلَاثُ خَرَجَاتٍ مِنَ الدَّهْرِ؛ فَتَخْرُجُ فِي أَقْصَى الْبَادِيَةِ وَلَا يَدْخُلُ ذِكْرُهَا الْقَرْيَةَ - يَعْنِي مَكَّةَ، ثُمَّ تَكْمُنُ زَمَانًا طَوِيلًا ثُمَّ تَخْرُجُ خَرْجَةً أُخْرَى دُونَ ذَلِكَ فَيَعْلُو ذِكْرُهَا فِي أَهْلِ الْبَادِيَةِ وَيَدْخُلُ ذِكْرُهَا الْقَرْيَةَ؛ يَعْنِي مَكَّةَ، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ثُمَّ بَيْنَمَا النَّاسُ فِي أَعْظَمِ الْمَسَاجِدِ عَلَى اللهِ حُرْمَةً خَيْرِهَا وَأَكْرَمِهَا الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ لَمْ يَرُعْهُمْ إِلَّا وَهِيَ تَرْغُو بَيْنَ الرُّكْنِ وَالْمَقَامِ تَنْفُضُ عَنْ رَأْسِهَا التُّرَابَ، فَارْفَضَّ النَّاسُ مَعَهَا شَتَّى وَمَعًا، وَثَبَتَ عِصَابَةٌ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَعَرَفُوا أَنَّهُمْ لَنْ يُعْجِزُوا اللهَ، فَبَدَأَتْ بِهِمْ فَجَلَّتْ وُجُوهَهُمْ حَتَّى تَجْعَلَهَا كَأَنَّهَا الْكَوْكَبُ الدُّرِّيُّ، وَوَلَّتْ فِي الْأَرْضِ لَا يُدْرِكُهَا طَالِبٌ وَلَا يَنْجُو مِنْهَا هَارِبٌ، حَتَّى إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَتَعَوَّذُ مِنْهَا بِالصَّلَاةِ فَتَأْتِيهِ مِنْ خَلْفِهِ فَتَقُولُ: يَا فُلَانُ، الْآنَ تُصَلِّي! فَيُقْبِلُ عَلَيْهَا فَتَسِمُهُ فِي وَجْهِهِ ثُمَّ تَنْطَلِقُ، وَيَشْتَرِكُ النَّاسُ فِي الْأَمْوَالِ وَيَصْطَحِبُونَ  فِي الْأَمْصَارِ يُعْرَفُ الْمُؤْمِنُ مِنَ الْكَافِرِ، حَتَّى إِنَّ الْمُؤْمِنَ يَقُولُ: يَا كَافِرُ، اقْضِنِي حَقِّي! وَحَتَّى إِنَّ الْكَافِرَ يَقُولُ: يَا مُؤْمِنُ، اقْضِنِي حَقِّي!».
hadiths.en: 1165 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, from Talha ibn 'Amr and Jarir ibn Hazim. As for Talha, he said: 'Abd Allah ibn 'Ubayd ibn 'Umayr al-Laythi informed me that Abu al-Tufayl narrated to him from Hudhayfa ibn Asid al-Ghifari Abu Sarih; and as for Jarir, he said: from 'Abd Allah ibn 'Umayr, from a man of the family of 'Abd Allah ibn Mas'ud — and the hadith of Talha is the more complete and the better of the two — who said: "The Messenger of God ﷺ mentioned the Beast and said: 'It has three emergences over time. It will emerge in the farthest desert, and word of it will not reach the town' — meaning Mecca. 'Then it will lie hidden for a long time and then emerge a second time, closer than that, and word of it will spread among the people of the desert and reach the town' — meaning Mecca. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: 'Then, while the people are in the most honored of mosques before God, the best and most noble of them, the Sacred Mosque, nothing will startle them but that it is groaning between the Corner and the Station, shaking dust from its head. The people will scatter from it, some apart and some together, while a band of believers remains firm, knowing that they cannot escape God. It will begin with them and brighten their faces until it makes them like a shining star. Then it will go forth over the earth: no pursuer will overtake it and no fugitive will escape it, so that a man will seek refuge from it in prayer and it will come to him from behind and say: O so-and-so, now you pray! He will turn to face it and it will mark him on his face, and then it will go on. The people will share in property and keep company in the cities; the believer will be distinguished from the disbeliever, until the believer says: O disbeliever, pay me my due! and the disbeliever says: O believer, pay me my due!'"

hadiths.ar: 1166 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللهِ بْنَ يَزِيدَ الْأَنْصَارِيَّ يَقُولُ: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ النُّهْبَى وَالْمُثْلَةِ».
hadiths.en: 1166 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from ʿAdī ibn Thābit, who said: I heard ʿAbd Allāh ibn Yazīd al-Anṣārī say: “The Messenger of God, peace be upon him, forbade plundering (al-nuhbā) and mutilation (al-muthla).”
en_alternates: Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from ʿAdi ibn Thabit, who said: I heard ʿAbd Allah ibn Yazid al-Ansari say: «The Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) forbade plundering (al-nuhba) and mutilation (al-muthla).»

sections.title_en: And the Hadith of Qurra ibn Iyas

hadiths.ar: 1167 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا قُرَّةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ قُرَّةَ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ: «أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، أَرِنِي الْخَاتَمَ! فَقَالَ: أَدْخِلْ يَدَكَ، قَالَ: فَأَدْخَلْتُ يَدِي فِي جُرُبَّانِهِ فَجَعَلْتُ أَلْمَسُ، أَنْظُرُ إِلَى الْخَاتَمِ، فَإِذَا هُوَ عَلَى نُغْضِ كَتِفِهِ مِثْلُ الْبَيْضَةِ، فَمَا مَنَعَهُ ذَاكَ أَنْ جَعَلَ يَدْعُو لِي، وَإِنَّ يَدِي لَفِي جُرُبَّانِهِ».
hadiths.en: 1167 - Yunus narrated to us, saying: Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Qurra ibn Khalid narrated to us, Mu'awiya ibn Qurra narrated to us, from his father, who said: "I came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: 'O Messenger of God, show me the Seal!' He said: 'Put your hand in.' I put my hand into the opening of his collar and began to feel and look at the Seal, and it was on the shoulder blade, like an egg. That did not stop him from praying for me while my hand was in his collar."

hadiths.ar: 1168 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ الْجُعْفِيُّ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عُرْوَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللهِ الْجُعْفِيُّ ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ قُرَّةَ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ: «انْتَهَيْتُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَإِذَا هُوَ مُطْلِقُ الْأَزْرَارِ، فَكُنْتَ لَا تَرَى مُعَاوِيَةَ وَابْنَهُ إِلَّا مُطْلِقَى الْأَزْرَارِ».
hadiths.en: 1168 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Zuhayr ibn Mu'awiya al-Ju'fi narrated to us, saying: 'Urwa ibn 'Abd Allah al-Ju'fi narrated to us, from Mu'awiya ibn Qurra, from his father, who said: "I came to the Prophet ﷺ and found him with his shirt buttons undone." You would never see Mu'awiya and his son except with their buttons undone.

hadiths.ar: 1169 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ أَبُو مُسْلِمٍ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ قُرَّةَ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ: «كُنَّا عَلَى عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نُطْرَدُ طَرْدًا أَنْ نَقُومَ بَيْنَ السَّوَارِي فِي الصَّلَاةِ».
hadiths.en: 1169 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Harun Abu Muslim narrated to us, saying: Qatada narrated to us, from Mu'awiya ibn Qurra, from his father, who said: "In the time of the Prophet ﷺ we were driven away from standing between the pillars in prayer."

hadiths.ar: 1170 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ قُرَّةَ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «صَوْمُ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ مِنَ الشَّهْرِ صَوْمُ الدَّهْرِ وَإِفْطَارُهُ».
hadiths.en: 1170 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shu'ba narrated to us, from Mu'awiya ibn Qurra, from his father, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "Fasting three days of the month is the fasting of a lifetime, and its breaking."

hadiths.ar: 1171 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ قُرَّةَ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم «كَانَ يَخْتَلِفُ إِلَيْهِ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ مَعَهُ ابْنٌ لَهُ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ: يَا فُلَانُ، أَتُحِبُّهُ؟، فَقَالَ: نَعَمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، فَأَحَبَّكَ اللهُ كَمَا أُحِبُّهُ! فَفَقَدَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلَ عَنْهُ،  فَقَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ مَاتَ ابْنُهُ! فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: أَمَا يَرْضَى - أَوْ: أَلَا تَرْضَى - أَنْ لَا تَأْتِيَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بَابًا مِنْ أَبْوَابِ الْجَنَّةِ إِلَّا جَاءَ يَسْعَى حَتَّى يَفْتَحَهُ لَكَ؟، فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، أَلَهُ وَحْدَهُ أَمْ لِكُلِّنَا؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: بَلْ لِكُلِّكُمْ».
hadiths.en: 1171 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shu'ba narrated to us, from Mu'awiya ibn Qurra, from his father, that the Prophet ﷺ "was visited by a man of the Ansar who had a son with him. The Messenger of God ﷺ said to him one day: 'O so-and-so, do you love him?' He said: 'Yes, O Messenger of God; may God love you as I love him!' Then the Prophet ﷺ missed him and asked about him, and they said: 'O Messenger of God, his son has died!' The Messenger of God ﷺ said: 'Are you not pleased that you will not come to any door of the gates of Paradise but he will come running until he opens it for you?' A man said: 'O Messenger of God, is that for him alone or for all of us?' The Messenger of God ﷺ said: 'Rather, for all of you.'"

hadiths.ar: 1172 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ قُرَّةَ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِذَا فَسَدَ أَهْلُ الشَّامِ فَلَا خَيْرَ فِيكُمْ، لَا تَزَالُ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي مَنْصُورِينَ لَا يَضُرُّهُمْ مَنْ خَذَلَهُمْ حَتَّى تَقُومَ السَّاعَةُ».
hadiths.en: 1172 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shu'ba narrated to us, saying: Mu'awiya ibn Qurra narrated to us, from his father, who said: The Prophet ﷺ said: "When the people of Syria become corrupt, there is no good in you. A group of my community will continue to be victorious; those who abandon them will not harm them until the Hour comes."

hadiths.ar: 1173 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ قُرَّةَ ، قَالَ: «أَتَى أَبِي النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَدْ حَلَبَ وَصَرَّ».
hadiths.en: 1173 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shu'ba narrated to us, from Mu'awiya ibn Qurra, who said: "My father came to the Prophet ﷺ having milked and tied up."

hadiths.ar: 1174 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ قُرَّةَ «أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ ذَهَبَ يَأْتِي النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالسِّوَاكِ، فَجَعَلُوا يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَى دِقَّةِ سَاقِهِ أَوْ يَعْجَبُونَ مِنْ دِقَّةِ سَاقِهِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: لَهُمَا أَثْقَلُ فِي الْمِيزَانِ مِنْ أُحُدٍ»، هَكَذَا رَوَاهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ، وَقَالَ غَيْرُ أَبِي دَاوُدَ: عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ قُرَّةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ.
hadiths.en: 1174 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shu'ba narrated to us, from Mu'awiya ibn Qurra, "that Ibn Mas'ud went to bring the siwak to the Prophet ﷺ, and they began looking at the thinness of his shins — or marveling at the thinness of his shins. The Prophet ﷺ said: 'They are heavier in the Balance than Uhud.'" Abu Dawud narrated it thus, and someone other than Abu Dawud said: from Shu'ba, from Mu'awiya ibn Qurra, from his father.

sections.title_ar: وَعِيَاضِ بْنِ حِمَارٍ الْمُجَاشِعِيِّ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم .
sections.title_en: And ʿIyad ibn Himar al-Mujashiʿi, on the authority of the Prophet ﷺ.

hadiths.ar: 1175 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ ، عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ حِمَارٍ الْمُجَاشِعِيِّ «أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ فِي خُطْبَتِهِ: أَلَا إِنَّ رَبِّي - أَوْ: إِنَّ رَبِّي - أَمَرَنِي أَنْ أُعَلِّمَكُمْ مَا جَهِلْتُمْ مِمَّا عَلَّمَنِي يَوْمِي هَذَا، كُلُّ مَالٍ نَحَلْتُ عَبْدِي حَلَالٌ، وَإِنِّي خَلَقْتُ عِبَادِي حُنَفَاءَ كُلَّهُمْ، وَإِنَّهُمْ أَتَتْهُمُ الشَّيَاطِينُ فَاجْتَالَتْهُمْ عَنْ دِينِهِمْ وَحَرَّمَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ مَا أَحْلَلْتُ لَهُمْ فَأَمَرَتْهُمْ أَنْ يُشْرِكُوا بِي مَا لَمْ أُنَزِّلْ بِهِ سُلْطَانًا، وَإِنَّ اللهَ عز وجل نَظَرَ إِلَى أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ فَمَقَتَهُمْ عَرَبَهُمْ وَعَجَمَهُمْ إِلَّا بَقَايَا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ، فَقَالَ: يَا مُحَمَّدُ، إِنَّمَا بَعَثْتُكَ لِأَبْتَلِيَكَ وَأَبْتَلِيَ بِكَ، وَأَنْزَلْتُ عَلَيْكَ كِتَابًا لَا  يَغْسِلُهُ الْمَاءُ، تَقْرَؤُهُ نَائِمًا وَيَقْظَانَ، وَإِنَّ اللهَ عز وجل أَمَرَنِي أَنْ أُحَرِّقَ قُرَيْشًا، فَقُلْتُ: رَبِّ، إِذًا يَثْلَغُوا رَأْسِي فَيَدَعُوهُ خُبْزَةً! فَقَالَ: اسْتَخْرِجْهُمْ كَمَا أَخْرَجُوكَ، وَاغْزُهُمْ يُغْزَ بِكَ، وَأَنْفِقْ فَسَيُنْفَقُ عَلَيْكَ، وَابْعَثْ جَيْشًا نَبْعَثْ خَمْسَةَ أَمْثَالِهِ، وَقَاتِلْ بِمَنْ أَطَاعَكَ مَنْ عَصَاكَ، وَقَالَ: أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ ثَلَاثَةٌ: ذُو سُلْطَانٍ مُقْتَصِدٌ مُتَصَدِّقٌ مُوَفَّقٌ، وَرَجُلٌ رَحِيمٌ رَقِيقُ الْقَلْبِ لِكُلِّ قُرْبَى مُسْلِمٍ، وَفَقِيرٌ عَفِيفٌ مُتَصَدِّقٌ. وَأَهْلُ النَّارِ خَمْسَةٌ: الضَّعِيفُ الَّذِي لَا زَبْرَ لَهُ الَّذِينَ هُمْ فِيكُمْ تَبَعًا لَا يَبْتَغُونَ أَهْلًا وَلَا مَالًا، وَالْخَائِنُ الَّذِي لَا يَخْفَى لَهُ طَمَعٌ  وَإِنْ دَقَّ إِلَّا خَانَهُ، وَرَجُلٌ لَا يُصْبِحُ وَلَا يُمْسِي إِلَّا وَهُوَ يُخَادِعُكَ عَنْ أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ - وَذَكَرَ الْبُخْلَ أَوِ الْكَذِبَ - وَالشِّنْظِيرُ الْفَحَّاشُ». قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ : فَحَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ قَالَ: كُنَّا عِنْدَ قَتَادَةَ فَذَكَرْنَا هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ، فَقَالَ يُونُسُ الْهَدَادِيُّ - وَمَا كَانَ فِينَا أَحَدٌ أَحْفَظَ مِنْهُ: إِنَّ قَتَادَةَ لَمْ يَسْمَعْ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ مِنْ مُطَرِّفٍ. قَالَ: فَعِبْنَا عَلَيْهِ ذَلِكَ، قَالَ: فَاسْأَلُوهُ، فَهِبْنَاهُ، قَالَ: وَجَاءَهُ أَعْرَابِيٌّ فَقُلْنَا لِلْأَعْرَابِيِّ: سَلْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ خُطْبَةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ حَدِيثِ عِيَاضِ بْنِ حِمَارٍ أَسَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ مُطَرِّفٍ؟ فَقَالَ الْأَعْرَابِيُّ: يَا أَبَا الْخَطَّابِ، أَخْبِرْنِي عَنْ خُطْبَةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم! يَعْنِي حَدِيثَ عِيَاضٍ، أَسَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ مُطَرِّفٍ؟ فَغَضِبَ وَقَالَ: حَدَّثَنِيهِ ثَلَاثَةٌ عَنْهُ؛ حَدَّثَنِيهِ يَزِيدُ أَخُوهُ ابْنُ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ، وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ الْعَلَاءُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ الْعَدَوِيُّ عَنْهُ - وَذَكَرَ ثَالِثًا لَمْ يَحْفَظْهُ هَمَّامٌ.
hadiths.en: 1175 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Hisham narrated to us, from Qatadah, from Mutarrif ibn ʿAbdillah ibn al-Shikhkhir, from ʿIyad ibn Himar al-Mujashiʿi: “That the Prophet of Allah ﷺ said one day in his sermon: Indeed my Lord – or: my Lord – has commanded me to teach you what you do not know of what He taught me this day: Every property I have granted to a servant is lawful. I created My servants all upright (hunafaʾ), but the devils came to them and led them astray from their religion, forbade them what I had made lawful for them, and commanded them to associate partners with Me for which I sent down no authority. And Allah the Mighty and Majestic looked upon the people of the earth and loathed them, Arab and non-Arab alike, except remnants of the People of the Book. He said: O Muhammad, I sent you only to test you and to test others through you, and I sent down upon you a Book that water does not wash away, which you recite asleep and awake. And Allah the Mighty and Majestic has commanded me to burn Quraysh. I said: My Lord, then they would crush my head and leave it like a loaf of bread! He said: Drive them out as they drove you out, fight them and you will be aided in fighting them, spend and it will be spent upon you, send an army and We will send five times its like, and fight those who obey you against those who disobey you. And he said: The people of Paradise are three: a ruler who is just, charitable and granted success; a man who is merciful and tender-hearted toward every relative and Muslim; and a poor man who is chaste and gives in charity. And the people of the Fire are five: the weak one who has no restraint, who are among you as followers, seeking neither family nor wealth; the traitor whose greed is never hidden, however small, but he betrays; a man who does not rise in the morning or evening except that he is deceiving you about your family and your property – and he mentioned stinginess or lying – and the foul-mouthed, ill-natured one.” Abu Dawud said: Hammam narrated to us, saying: We were with Qatadah and mentioned this hadith, and Yunus al-Haddadi – and none among us was a better memorizer than he – said: Qatadah did not hear this hadith from Mutarrif. He said: We faulted him for that. He said: Ask him! But we were in awe of him. A Bedouin came to him, so we said to the Bedouin: Ask Qatadah about the sermon of the Prophet ﷺ, the hadith of ʿIyad ibn Himar, did you hear it from Mutarrif? The Bedouin said: O Abu al-Khattab, tell me about the sermon of the Prophet ﷺ – meaning the hadith of ʿIyad – did you hear it from Mutarrif? He became angry and said: Three people narrated it to me from him: Yazid, his brother, son of ʿAbdullah ibn al-Shikhkhir, and al-ʿAlaʾ ibn Ziyad al-ʿAdawi narrated it to me from him – and he mentioned a third whom Hammam did not remember.

hadiths.ar: 1176 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عِمْرَانُ الْقَطَّانُ وَهَمَّامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، قَالَ هَمَّامٌ: عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ ، وَقَالَ عِمْرَانُ: عَنْ مُطَرِّفِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ ، عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ حِمَارٍ ، قَالَ: «قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، الرَّجُلُ مِنْ قَوْمِي يَشْتُمُنِي وَهُوَ دُونِي؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: الْمُسْتَبَّانِ شَيْطَانَانِ يَتَهَاتَرَانِ وَيَتَكَاذَبَانِ، فَمَا قَالَا فَهُوَ عَلَى الْبَادِئِ حَتَّى يَعْتَدِيَ الْمَظْلُومُ».
hadiths.en: 1176 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: ʿImran al-Qattan and Hammam narrated to us, from Qatadah – Hammam said: from Yazid ibn ʿAbdillah ibn al-Shikhkhir, and ʿImran said: from Mutarrif ibn ʿAbdillah ibn al-Shikhkhir – from ʿIyad ibn Himar, who said: “I said: O Messenger of Allah, a man of my people insults me while he is of lower standing than me? The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Two people who insult one another are two devils, spouting nonsense and lying to each other; what they say falls upon the one who began, until the wronged one transgresses.”

hadiths.ar: 1177 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ خَالِدًا الْحَذَّاءَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ ، عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ حِمَارٍ الْمُجَاشِعِيِّ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «مَنِ الْتَقَطَ لُقَطَةً فَلْيُشْهِدْ ذَوَيْ عَدْلٍ - أَوْ ذَا عَدْلٍ - وَلَا يَكْتُمْ وَلَا يُغَيِّبْ، فَإِنْ جَاءَ صَاحِبُهَا فَهُوَ أَحَقُّ بِهَا، وَإِلَّا فَهُوَ مَالُ اللهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ». قَالَ أَبُو بِشْرٍ : وَرَأَيْتُ فِي مَوْضِعٍ آخَرَ عَنْ أَبِي دَاوُدَ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ ، عَنْ عِيَاضٍ - وَلَيْسَ فِيهِ مُطَرِّفٌ.
hadiths.en: 1177 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, he said: I heard Khalid al-Hadhdhaʾ narrate from Yazid ibn ʿAbdillah ibn al-Shikhkhir, from Mutarrif ibn ʿAbdillah ibn al-Shikhkhir, from ʿIyad ibn Himar al-Mujashiʿi, from the Prophet ﷺ that he said: “Whoever finds a lost item should call two just witnesses – or one just witness – and should not conceal it or hide it. If its owner comes, he has more right to it; otherwise it is the property of Allah, which He gives to whom He wills.” Abu Bishr said: And I saw in another place, from Abu Dawud, from Shuʿbah, from Khalid, from Yazid, from ʿIyad – and Mutarrif is not in it.

hadiths.ar: 1178 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو التَّيَّاحِ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ ، عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ حِمَارٍ ، قَالَ: «أَهْدَيْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم هَدِيَّةً - أَوْ قَالَ: نَاقَةً - فَقَالَ لِي: أَسْلَمْتَ؟، فَقُلْتُ: لَا. فَأَبَى أَنْ يَقْبَلَهَا، وَقَالَ: إِنَّا لَا نَقْبَلُ زَبَدَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ»، قُلْتُ لِلْحَسَنِ: مَا زَبْدُ الْمُشْرِكِينَ؟ قَالَ: رِفْدُهُمْ.
hadiths.en: 1178 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Hammad ibn Zayd narrated to us, he said: Abu al-Tayyah narrated to us, he said: al-Hasan narrated to us, from ʿIyad ibn Himar, who said: “I presented a gift – or he said: a she-camel – to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He said to me: Have you accepted Islam? I said: No. He refused to accept it and said: We do not accept the zabad of the polytheists.” I asked al-Hasan: What is the zabad of the polytheists? He said: Their gifts.

hadiths.ar: 1179 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عِمْرَانُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ ، عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ حِمَارٍ ، قَالَ: «أَهْدَيْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَاقَةً - أَوْ قَالَ: هَدِيَّةً - فَقَالَ: أَسْلَمْتَ؟، قُلْتُ: لَا. قَالَ: إِنِّي نُهِيتُ عَنْ زَبْدِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ».
hadiths.en: 1179 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: ʿImran narrated to us, from Qatadah, from Yazid ibn ʿAbdillah, from ʿIyad ibn Himar, who said: “I presented a she-camel – or he said: a gift – to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He said: Have you accepted Islam? I said: No. He said: I have been forbidden the zabad of the polytheists.”

hadiths.ar: 1180 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ الضَّبِّيُّ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ بْنِ التَّوْأَمِ ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ «أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْحِلْفِ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ، فَقَالَ: لَا حِلْفَ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ، وَتَمَسَّكُوا بِحِلْفِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ».
hadiths.en: 1180 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Jarir ibn ʿAbd al-Hamid al-Dabbi narrated to us, from Mughira, from his father, from Shuʿba ibn al-Tawʾam, from Qays ibn ʿAsim: «that he asked the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) about alliance in Islam, and he said: There is no alliance in Islam, but hold fast to the alliance of the Jahiliyya.»

hadiths.ar: 1181 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ مُطَرِّفَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ حَكِيمِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ التَّمِيمِيِّ «أَنَّ أَبَاهُ أَوْصَى بَنِيهِ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ فَقَالَ: إِذَا أَنَا مُتُّ فَلَا تَنُوحُوا عَلَيَّ، فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يُنَحْ عَلَيْهِ».
hadiths.en: 1181 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Qatada, who said: I heard Mutarrif ibn ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Shikhkhir narrating from Hakim ibn Qays al-Tamimi: «that his father gave a bequest to his sons at his death, saying: When I die, do not wail over me, for the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) was not wailed over.»

hadiths.ar: 1182 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ قَبِيصَةَ بْنَ هُلْبٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يَقُولُ «وَذَكَرَ الصَّدَقَةَ فَقَالَ: لَا يَجِيئَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ بِشَاةٍ لَهَا يُعَارٌ».
hadiths.en: 1182 - Yūnus narrated to us, Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Simāk ibn Ḥarb, who said: I heard Qabīṣa ibn Hulb narrating from his father that he heard the Prophet, peace be upon him, say – and he mentioned charity (ṣadaqa) – “Let none of you come with a sheep that bleats (yuʿār).”
en_alternates: 1182 - Yunus narrated to us; Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Simak ibn Harb, who said: I heard Qabisa ibn Hulb narrating from his father that he heard the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) say – «and he mentioned charity (ṣadaqa), and said: Let none of you come with a sheep that bleats.»

hadiths.ar: 1183 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ ، عَنْ قَبِيصَةَ بْنِ هُلْبٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَنَّهُ «صَلَّى مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَكَانَ يَنْصَرِفُ عَنْ شِقَّيْهِ».
hadiths.en: 1183 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Simāk, from Qabīṣa ibn Hulb, from his father: “that he prayed with the Prophet, peace be upon him, and he would turn away (after the prayer) to either side.”
en_alternates: 1183 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Simak, from Qabisa ibn Hulb, from his father, that he «prayed with the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him), and he would turn away to either side (after the prayer).»

sections.title_en: And the Hadiths of Abu Razin al-'Uqayli

hadiths.ar: 1184 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ عَطَاءٍ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ وَكِيعَ بْنَ عُدُسٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَمِّهِ أَبِي رَزِينٍ الْعُقَيْلِيِّ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «رُؤْيَا الْمُؤْمِنِ جُزْءٌ مِنْ أَرْبَعِينَ جُزْءًا مِنَ النُّبُوَّةِ، وَهِيَ عَلَى رِجْلِ طَائِرٍ مُعَلَّقَةٌ مَا لَمْ يُحَدِّثْ بِهَا، فَإِذَا حَدَّثَ بِهَا  سَقَطَتْ، قَالَ: وَأَحْسَبُهُ قَالَ: وَلَا تُحَدِّثْ بِهَا إِلَّا حَبِيبًا أَوْ لَبِيبًا».
hadiths.en: 1184 - Yunus narrated to us, Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shu'ba narrated to us, from Ya'la ibn 'Ata', who said: I heard Waki' ibn 'Udus narrate from his paternal uncle Abu Razin al-'Uqayli that the Prophet ﷺ said: "The dream of the believer is one part of forty parts of prophethood, and it is suspended on a bird's leg as long as it is not narrated; when it is narrated, it falls." He said: "And I think he said: Do not narrate it except to a loved one or a person of understanding."

hadiths.ar: 1185 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي يَعْلَى بْنُ عَطَاءٍ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ وَكِيعَ بْنَ عُدُسٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي رَزِينٍ الْعُقَيْلِيِّ قَالَ: «قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، كَيْفَ يُحْيِي اللهُ الْمَوْتَى؟ قَالَ: أَمَا مَرَرْتَ بِوَادٍ مُمْحِلٍ ثُمَّ مَرَرْتَ بِهِ خَضِرًا، قَالَ: بَلَى. قَالَ: فَكَذَلِكَ النُّشُورُ، أَوْ قَالَ: {كَذَلِكَ يُحْيِي اللهُ الْمَوْتَى}».
hadiths.en: 1185 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shu'ba narrated to us, saying: Ya'la ibn 'Ata' informed me, saying: I heard Waki' ibn 'Udus narrate from Abu Razin al-'Uqayli, who said: "I said: 'O Messenger of God, how does God bring the dead to life?' He said: 'Have you not passed through a barren valley and then passed through it when it was green?' He said: 'Yes.' He said: 'So is the resurrection' — or he said: '{Thus does God bring the dead to life}.'"

hadiths.ar: 1186 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ عَطَاءٍ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ وَكِيعَ بْنَ عُدُسٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي رَزِينٍ الْعُقَيْلِيِّ قَالَ: «قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، إِنَّ أُمِّي كَانَتْ تَصِلُ الرَّحِمَ وَتَفْعَلُ وَتَفْعَلُ، وَمَاتَتْ مُشْرِكَةً! فَأَيْنَ هِيَ؟ قَالَ: هِيَ فِي النَّارِ، قَالَ: قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، فَأَيْنَ أُمُّكَ؟ قَالَ: أَمَا تَرْضَى أَنْ تَكُونَ أُمُّكَ مَعَ أُمِّي».
hadiths.en: 1186 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shu'ba narrated to us, from Ya'la ibn 'Ata', who said: I heard Waki' ibn 'Udus narrate from Abu Razin al-'Uqayli, who said: "I said: 'O Messenger of God, my mother used to maintain family ties and do such and such, and she died a polytheist! Where is she?' He said: 'She is in the Fire.' I said: 'O Messenger of God, and where is your mother?' He said: 'Are you not pleased that your mother be with my mother?'"

hadiths.ar: 1187 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي النُّعْمَانُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَوْسٍ الثَّقَفِيِّ ، عَنْ أَبِي رَزِينٍ الْعُقَيْلِيِّ ، قَالَ: «قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، إِنَّ أَبِي شَيْخٌ كَبِيرٌ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ الْحَجَّ وَلَا الْعُمْرَةَ وَلَا  الظَّعْنَ! قَالَ: حُجَّ عَنْ أَبِيكَ أَوِ اعْتَمِرْ».
hadiths.en: 1187 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shu'ba narrated to us, saying: al-Nu'man ibn Salim informed me, from 'Amr ibn Aws al-Thaqafi, from Abu Razin al-'Uqayli, who said: "I said: 'O Messenger of God, my father is a very old man who cannot perform Hajj or 'Umra or travel!' He said: 'Perform Hajj on behalf of your father, or 'Umra.'"

hadiths.ar: 1188 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ عَطَاءٍ ، عَنْ وَكِيعِ بْنِ حُدُسٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي رَزِينٍ ، قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «ضَحِكَ رَبُّنَا عز وجل مِنْ قُنُوطِ عِبَادِهِ وَقُرْبِ غِيَرِهِ، فَقُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، وَيَضْحَكُ الرَّبُّ تبارك وتعالى؟! فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: نَعَمْ، فَقَالَ: لَنْ نَعْدَمَ مِنْ رَبٍّ يَضْحَكُ خَيْرًا».
hadiths.en: 1188 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama narrated to us, from Ya'la ibn 'Ata', from Waki' ibn Hudus, from Abu Razin, who said: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Our Lord, Mighty and Majestic, laughs at the despair of His servants and how near their relief is." I said: "O Messenger of God, does the Lord, Blessed and Exalted, laugh?" The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "Yes." He said: "We will never lack good from a Lord who laughs."

hadiths.ar: 1189 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ عَطَاءٍ ، عَنْ وَكِيعِ بْنِ حُدُسٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي رَزِينٍ ، قَالَ: «كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يُسْأَلَ، فَإِذَا سَأَلَهُ أَبُو رَزِينٍ أَعْجَبَهُ. قَالَ: قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، أَيْنَ كَانَ رَبُّنَا عز وجل قَبْلَ أَنْ يَخْلُقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ؟ قَالَ: كَانَ فِي عَمَاءٍ، مَا فَوْقَهُ هَوَاءٌ وَمَا تَحْتَهُ هَوَاءٌ، ثُمَّ خَلَقَ الْعَرْشَ عَلَى الْمَاءِ».
hadiths.en: 1189 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama narrated to us, from Ya'la ibn 'Ata', from Waki' ibn Hudus, from Abu Razin, who said: "The Prophet ﷺ disliked being asked questions, but when Abu Razin asked him it pleased him. I said: 'O Messenger of God, where was our Lord, Mighty and Majestic, before He created the heavens and the earth?' He said: 'He was in a cloud, with air above it and air below it; then He created the Throne upon the water.'"

hadiths.ar: 1190 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ عَطَاءٍ ، عَنْ وَكِيعِ بْنِ حُدُسٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي رَزِينٍ ، قَالَ: «قُلْتُ:  يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، كُلُّنَا يَرَى رَبَّهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ، قُلْتُ: وَمَا آيَةُ ذَلِكَ فِي خَلْقِهِ؟ قَالَ: أَلَيْسَ كُلُّكُمْ يَرَى الْقَمَرَ مُخْلِيًا بِهِ؟، قُلْتُ: بَلَى. قَالَ: فَاللهُ عز وجل أَعْظَمُ».
hadiths.en: 1190 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama narrated to us, from Ya'la ibn 'Ata', from Waki' ibn Hudus, from Abu Razin, who said: "I said: 'O Messenger of God, will each of us see his Lord on the Day of Resurrection?' He said: 'Yes.' I said: 'And what is the sign of that in His creation?' He said: 'Does not each of you see the moon alone with him?' I said: 'Yes.' He said: 'God, Mighty and Majestic, is greater.'"

hadiths.ar: 1191 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ بْنُ عُتْبَةَ ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ طَلْقٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «لَا وِتْرَانِ فِي لَيْلَةٍ».
hadiths.en: 1191 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Ayyūb ibn ʿUtba narrated to us, from Qays ibn Ṭalq, from his father, that the Prophet, peace be upon him, said: “There are not two witr prayers in one night.”

hadiths.ar: 1192 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ بْنُ عُتْبَةَ ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ  طَلْقٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ: «قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، يَكُونُ أَحَدُنَا فِي الصَّلَاةِ فَيَمَسُّ ذَكَرَهُ، أَيُعِيدُ الْوُضُوءَ؟ قَالَ: لَا، إِنَّمَا هُوَ مِنْكَ».
hadiths.en: 1192 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Ayyūb ibn ʿUtba narrated to us, from Qays ibn Ṭalq, from his father, who said: “I said: O Messenger of God, one of us is in prayer and touches his private part; must he repeat the ablution? He said: No, it is only a part of you.”

hadiths.ar: 1193 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ بْنُ عُتْبَةَ ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ طَلْقٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لَا يَحِلُّ لِامْرَأَةٍ أَنْ تَمْنَعَ زَوْجَهَا وَلَوْ عَلَى ظَهْرِ قَتَبٍ».
hadiths.en: 1193 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Ayyūb ibn ʿUtba narrated to us, from Qays ibn Ṭalq, from his father, who said: The Prophet, peace be upon him, said: “It is not permissible for a woman to refuse her husband, even if she is on the back of a camel saddle (qatab).”

hadiths.ar: 1194 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ بْنُ عُتْبَةَ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ طَلْقٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ: «سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: أَيُصَلِّي الرَّجُلُ فِي ثَوْبٍ وَاحِدٍ؟ فَسَكَتَ حَتَّى حَضَرَتِ الصَّلَاةُ، فَصَلَّى فِي ثَوْبٍ وَاحِدٍ طَارَقَ بَيْنَ طَرَفَيْهِ».
hadiths.en: 1194 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Ayyūb ibn ʿUtba narrated to us, from Qays ibn Ṭalq, from his father, who said: “The Messenger of God, peace be upon him, was asked: May a man pray in a single garment? He was silent until the time of prayer came, then he prayed in a single garment, overlapping its two ends.”

sections.title_ar: وَعَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ .
sections.title_en: And 'Abd Allah ibn Zayd ibn 'Asim al-Ansari

hadiths.ar: 1195 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي حَبِيبُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عَبَّادَ بْنَ تَمِيمٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ قَالَ: «رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَوَضَّأَ فَدَلَكَ ذِرَاعَيْهِ».
hadiths.en: 1195 - Yunus narrated to us, saying: Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shu'ba narrated to us, saying: Habib ibn Zayd al-Ansari narrated to me, saying: I heard 'Abbad ibn Tamim narrate from 'Abd Allah ibn Zayd, who said: "I saw the Prophet ﷺ perform ablution and rub his forearms."

hadiths.ar: 1196 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ تَمِيمٍ ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ، قَالَ: «خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْتَسْقِي فَحَوَّلَ النَّاسَ ظَهْرَهُ وَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ وَقَلَبَ رِدَاءَهُ، وَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ بِالنَّاسِ وَجَهَرَ بِالْقِرَاءَةِ».
hadiths.en: 1196 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Ibn Abi Dhi'b narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from 'Abbad ibn Tamim, from his uncle 'Abd Allah ibn Zayd, who said: "The Messenger of God ﷺ went out to pray for rain. He turned his back to the people and faced the qibla, turned his cloak inside out, and prayed two rak'as with the people, reciting aloud."

hadiths.ar: 1197 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ تَمِيمٍ ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ، قَالَ: «رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُسْتَلْقِيًا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَاضِعًا إِحْدَى رِجْلَيْهِ عَلَى الْأُخْرَى».
hadiths.en: 1197 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Ibn Abi Dhi'b narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from 'Abbad ibn Tamim, from his uncle 'Abd Allah ibn Zayd, who said: "I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ lying on his back in the mosque, with one leg placed over the other."

hadiths.ar: 1198 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا خَارِجَةُ بْنُ مُصْعَبٍ ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى الْأَنْصَارِيِّ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ: قَالَ لَنَا عَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ زَيْدٍ : «أَلَا أَتَوَضَّأُ لَكُمْ وُضُوءَ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم؟ قُلْنَا: بَلَى، فَتَمَضْمَضَ وَاسْتَنْشَقَ بِغَرْفَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ ثَلَاثًا، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ ثَلَاثًا، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ ذِرَاعَيْهِ مَرَّتَيْنِ مَرَّتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ مَسَحَ رَأْسَهُ فَأَقْبَلَ بِيَدِهِ وَأَدْبَرَ بِهَا، وَغَسَلَ رِجْلَيْهِ ثَلَاثًا ثَلَاثًا، ثُمَّ قَالَ: هَكَذَا كَانَ وُضُوءُ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم».
hadiths.en: 1198 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Kharija ibn Mus'ab narrated to us, from 'Amr ibn Yahya al-Ansari, from his father, who said: 'Abd Allah ibn Zayd said to us: "Shall I not perform for you the ablution of the Messenger of God ﷺ?" We said: "Yes." So he rinsed his mouth and sniffed water with a single handful, three times; then washed his face three times; then washed his forearms twice each; then wiped his head, bringing his hand forward and back; and washed his feet three times each. Then he said: "Thus was the ablution of the Messenger of God ﷺ."

hadiths.ar: 1199 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الْوَاقِفِيُّ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ «أَنَّهُ رَأَى الْأَذَانَ فِي الْمَنَامِ، فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لَهُ، قَالَ: فَأَذَّنَ بِلَالٌ، قَالَ: وَجَاءَ عَمِّي إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، أَنَا أَرَى الرُّؤْيَا وَيُؤَذِّنُ بِلَالٌ! قَالَ: فَأَقِمْ أَنْتَ، قَالَ: فَأَقَامَ عَمِّي».
hadiths.en: 1199 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn 'Amr al-Waqifi narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah ibn Muhammad al-Ansari, from his uncle 'Abd Allah ibn Zayd, "that he saw the call to prayer in a dream and came to the Prophet ﷺ and told him. Bilal gave the call. He said: And my uncle came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: 'O Messenger of God, I am the one who saw the dream, yet Bilal gives the call!' He said: 'Then you give the iqama.' So my uncle gave the iqama."

sections.title_en: The Hadiths of Mu'awiya ibn al-Hakam

hadiths.ar: 1200 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ السُّلَمِيِّ ،  قَالَ: «سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الطِّيَرَةِ فَقَالَ: هُوَ شَيْءٌ تَجِدُونَهُ فِي صُدُورِكُمْ فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمْ، قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، إِنَّ قَوْمًا يَأْتُونَ الْكُهَّانَ! فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: لَا تَأْتُوهُمْ».
hadiths.en: 1200 - Yunus narrated to us, saying: Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Ibn Abi Dhi'b narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Salama, from Mu'awiya ibn al-Hakam al-Sulami, who said: "I asked the Messenger of God ﷺ about omens, and he said: 'It is something you find in your hearts, so do not let it deter you.' I said: 'O Messenger of God, some people go to soothsayers!' The Messenger of God ﷺ said: 'Do not go to them.'"

hadiths.ar: 1201 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَرْبُ بْنُ شَدَّادٍ وَأَبَانُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ ، عَنْ هِلَالِ بْنِ أَبِي مَيْمُونَةَ ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ السُّلَمِيِّ ، قَالَ: «صَلَّيْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَعَطَسَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى جَنْبِي، فَقُلْتُ: يَرْحَمُكَ اللهُ! فَرَمَانِي الْقَوْمُ بِأَبْصَارِهِمْ، فَقُلْتُ: وَاثُكْلَ أُمِّيَاهْ، مَا لِي أَرَاكُمْ تَنْظُرُونَ إِلَيَّ وَأَنَا أُصَلِّي! فَجَعَلُوا يَضْرِبُونَ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ عَلَى أَفْخَاذِهِمْ يُصَمِّتُونِي، فَلَمَّا قَضَى رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَاتَهُ، فَبِأَبِي وَأُمِّي مَا رَأَيْتُ قَبْلَهُ وَلَا بَعْدَهُ أَحَدًا أَحْسَنَ تَعْلِيمًا مِنْهُ، وَاللهِ مَا كَهَرَنِي وَلَا سَبَّنِي وَلَا ضَرَبَنِي، وَلَكِنَّهُ قَالَ لِي: إِنَّ صَلَاتَنَا هَذِهِ لَا يَصْلُحُ فِيهَا شَيْءٌ مِنْ كَلَامِ النَّاسِ، إِنَّمَا هُوَ الصَّلَاةُ وَالتَّسْبِيحُ وَالتَّحْمِيدُ وَقِرَاءَةُ الْقُرْآنِ، أَوْ كَالَّذِي قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَكَانَتْ لِي غَنَمٌ تَرْعَى  بَيْنَ أُحُدٍ وَالْجَوَّانِيَّةِ فِيهَا جَارِيَةٌ لِي، فَاطَّلَعْتُهَا ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ وَإِذَا الذِّئْبُ قَدْ ذَهَبَ مِنْهَا بِشَاةٍ، وَأَنَا مِنْ بَنِي آدَمَ آسَفُ كَمَا يَأْسَفُونَ، فَرَفَعْتُ يَدِي فَصَكَكْتُهَا صَكَّةً، فَأَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَعَظَّمَ ذَلِكَ عَلَيَّ، فَقُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، أَفَلَا أُعْتِقُهَا؟ قَالَ: ادْعُهَا، فَدَعَوْتُهَا. قَالَ: فَقَالَ لَهَا: أَيْنَ اللهُ؟، قَالَتْ: فِي السَّمَاءِ، قَالَ: مَنْ أَنَا؟ قَالَتْ: أَنْتَ رَسُولُ اللهِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: أَعْتِقْهَا؛ فَإِنَّهَا مُؤْمِنَةٌ، قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، إِنَّ فِينَا قَوْمًا يَخُطُّونَ! فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: قَدْ كَانَ نَبِيٌّ مِنَ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ يَخُطُّ، فَمَنْ وَافَقَ خَطَّهُ فَذَاكَ، قُلْتُ: إِنَّ فِينَا قَوْمًا يَتَطَيَّرُونَ، قَالَ: هُوَ شَيْءٌ يَجِدُونَهُ فِي صُدُورِهِمْ، وَلَكِنْ لَا يَصُدَّنَّهُمْ، قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، إِنَّ فِينَا قَوْمًا يَأْتُونَ الْكُهَّانَ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: فَلَا تَأْتُوهُمْ».
hadiths.en: 1201 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Harb ibn Shaddad and Aban ibn Yazid narrated to us, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from Hilal ibn Abi Maymuna, from 'Ata' ibn Yasar, from Mu'awiya ibn al-Hakam al-Sulami, who said: "I prayed with the Prophet ﷺ and a man next to me sneezed, and I said: 'May God have mercy on you!' The people shot me looks, and I said: 'Woe to my mother! What is the matter with you that you stare at me while I am praying?' They began striking their hands on their thighs to silence me. When the Messenger of God ﷺ finished his prayer — may my father and mother be his ransom, I never saw before him nor after him a better teacher than he — by God, he did not scold me, curse me or strike me, but said to me: 'In this prayer of ours nothing of people's speech is fitting; it is only glorification, magnification and Qur'an recitation' — or as the Messenger of God ﷺ said. I had sheep that grazed between Uhud and al-Jawwaniyya, with a slave girl of mine tending them. One day I looked in on them and a wolf had taken one of the sheep. I am one of the sons of Adam and grieve as they grieve, so I raised my hand and slapped her. I came to the Messenger of God ﷺ and told him, and he regarded it as grave against me. I said: 'O Messenger of God, shall I not free her?' He said: 'Call her.' I called her. He said to her: 'Where is God?' She said: 'In the heaven.' He said: 'Who am I?' She said: 'You are the Messenger of God.' The Messenger of God ﷺ said: 'Free her, for she is a believer.' I said: 'O Messenger of God, among us are people who draw lines in the sand.' The Messenger of God ﷺ said: 'There was a prophet among the prophets who drew lines; whoever's line matches his, that is it.' I said: 'Among us are people who take omens from birds.' He said: 'It is something they find in their hearts, but let it not deter them.' I said: 'O Messenger of God, among us are people who go to soothsayers.' The Messenger of God ﷺ said: 'Then do not go to them.'"

sections.title_ar: وَسَفِينَةَ مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
sections.title_en: And Safina, the Freedman of the Messenger of God ﷺ

hadiths.ar: 1202 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَشْرَجُ بْنُ نُبَاتَةَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ جُمْهَانَ ، عَنْ سَفِينَةَ مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: خَطَبَنَا رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: «إِنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ نَبِيٌّ إِلَّا وَقَدْ أَنْذَرَ الدَّجَّالَ أُمَّتَهُ، أَلَا وَإِنَّهُ أَعْوَرُ عَيْنِ الشِّمَالِ، وَبِالْيُمْنَى ظَفَرَةٌ غَلِيظَةٌ، بَيْنَ عَيْنَيْهِ كَافِرٌ - يَعْنِي مَكْتُوبٌ: ك ف ر - وَيَخْرُجُ مَعَهُ وَادِيَانِ أَحَدُهُمَا  جَنَّةٌ وَأُخْرَى نَارٌ، فَنَارُهُ جَنَّةٌ وَجَنَّتُهُ نَارٌ، فَيَقُولُ الدَّجَّالُ لِلنَّاسِ: أَلَسْتُ رَبَّكُمْ أُحْيِي وَأُمِيتُ؟ وَمَعَهُ نَبِيَّانِ مِنَ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ إِنِّي لَأَعْرِفُ اسْمَهُمَا وَاسْمَ آبَائِهِمَا، لَوْ شِئْتُ أَنْ أُسَمِّيَهُمَا سَمَّيْتُهُمَا، أَحَدُهُمَا عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَالْآخَرُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ، فَيَقُولُ: أَلَسْتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ أُحْيِي وَأُمِيتُ؟ فَيَقُولُ أَحَدُهُمَا: كَذَبْتَ - فَلَا يَسْمَعُهُ أَحَدٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ إِلَّا صَاحِبُهُ، وَيَقُولُ الْآخَرُ: صَدَقْتَ - وَيَسْمَعُهُ النَّاسُ وَذَلِكَ فِتْنَةٌ، ثُمَّ يَسِيرُ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ الْمَدِينَةَ فَيَقُولُ: هَذِهِ قَرْيَةُ ذَاكَ الرَّجُلِ، فَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُ أَنْ يَدْخُلَهَا، ثُمَّ يَسِيرُ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ الشَّامَ فَيُهْلِكَهُ اللهُ عِنْدَ عَقَبَةِ أَفِيقٍ».
hadiths.en: 1202 - Yunus narrated to us, saying: Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: al-Hashraj ibn Nubata narrated to us, saying: Sa'id ibn Jumhan narrated to us, from Safina, the freedman of the Messenger of God ﷺ, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ gave us a sermon and said: "There was no prophet who did not warn his community about the Dajjal. Beware, he is blind in the left eye, with a thick growth on the right eye. Between his eyes is written 'Kafir' — meaning the letters k-f-r. With him will come out two rivers, one a garden and the other a fire; his fire is a garden and his garden is a fire. The Dajjal will say to the people: 'Am I not your Lord? I give life and I cause death.' With him will be two prophets from among the prophets; I know their names and the names of their fathers, and if I wished to name them I would name them. One will be on his right and the other on his left. He will say: 'Am I not your Lord, giving life and causing death?' One of them will say: 'You have lied' — and no one among the people will hear him except his companion — and the other will say: 'You have spoken truly' — and the people will hear him, and that is a trial. Then he will travel until he comes to Medina and say: 'This is the town of that man,' but he will not be permitted to enter it. Then he will travel until he comes to Syria, and God will destroy him at the pass of Afiq."

hadiths.ar: 1203 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَشْرَجُ بْنُ نُبَاتَةَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ جُمْهَانَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي سَفِينَةُ ، قَالَ خَطَبَنَا رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: «الْخِلَافَةُ فِي أُمَّتِي ثَلَاثُونَ سَنَةً، ثُمَّ يَكُونُ مُلْكٌ.  ثُمَّ قَالَ سَفِينَةُ: امْسِكْ؛ خِلَافَةُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، وَخِلَافَةُ عُمَرَ ثِنْتَا عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً وَسِتَّةُ أَشْهُرٍ، وَخِلَافَةُ عُثْمَانَ ثِنْتَا عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً، ثُمَّ خِلَافَةُ عَلِيٍّ تَكْمِلَةُ الثَّلَاثِينَ. قُلْتُ: فَمُعَاوِيَةُ؟ قَالَ: كَانَ أَوَّلَ الْمُلُوكِ».
hadiths.en: 1203 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: al-Hashraj ibn Nubata narrated to us, saying: Sa'id ibn Jumhan narrated to me, saying: Safina narrated to me, saying: The Messenger of God ﷺ gave us a sermon and said: "The caliphate in my community will last thirty years, and then there will be kingship." Then Safina said: "Keep count: the caliphate of Abu Bakr, and the caliphate of 'Umar, twelve years and six months; and the caliphate of 'Uthman, twelve years; then the caliphate of 'Ali completes the thirty." I said: "And Mu'awiya?" He said: "He was the first of the kings."

sections.title_en: And the Hadith of Aws ibn Hudhayfa al-Thaqafi

hadiths.ar: 1204 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الطَّائِفِيُّ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ أَوْسِ بْنِ حُذَيْفَةَ الثَّقَفِيُّ ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ أَوْسٍ قَالَ: «قَدِمْنَا وَفْدَ ثَقِيفَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَنَزَلَ الْأَحْلَافِيُّونَ عَلَى الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ وَأَنْزَلَ الْمَالِكِيِّينَ قُبَّتَهُ، قَالَ: وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْتِينَا فَيُحَدِّثُنَا بَعْدَ الْعِشَاءِ الْآخِرَةِ حَتَّى يُرَاوِحَ بَيْنَ قَدَمَيْهِ مِنْ طُولِ الْقِيَامِ، فَكَانَ أَكْثَرُ مَا يُحَدِّثُنَا اشْتِكَاءَ قُرَيْشٍ؛ يَقُولُ: كُنَّا بِمَكَّةَ مُسْتَذَلِّينَ مُسْتَضْعَفِينَ، فَلَمَّا قَدِمْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ انْتَصَفْنَا مِنَ الْقَوْمِ فَكَانَتْ سِجَالُ الْحَرْبِ عَلَيْنَا وَلَنَا، فَاحْتَبَسَ عَنَّا لَيْلَةً عَنِ الْوَقْتِ الَّذِي كَانَ يَأْتِينَا فِيهِ ثُمَّ أَتَانَا، فَقُلْنَا: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، احْتَبَسْتَ عَنَّا اللَّيْلَةَ  عَنِ الْوَقْتِ الَّذِي كُنْتَ تَأْتِينَا فِيهِ! فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: إِنَّهُ طَرَأَ عَلَيَّ حِزْبٌ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ فَأَحْبَبْتُ أَنْ لَا أَخْرُجَ حَتَّى أَقْرَأَهُ - أَوْ قَالَ: أَقْضِيَهُ، قَالَ: فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحْنَا سَأَلْنَا أَصْحَابَ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ أَحْزَابِ الْقُرْآنِ كَيْفَ تُحَزِّبُونَهُ؟ فَقَالُوا: ثَلَاثٌ، وَخَمْسٌ، وَسَبْعٌ، وَتِسْعٌ، وَإِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ، وَثَلَاثَ عَشْرَةَ، وَحِزْبُ الْمُفَصَّلِ».
hadiths.en: 1204 - Yunus narrated to us, saying: Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: 'Abd Allah ibn 'Abd al-Rahman al-Ta'ifi narrated to us, saying: 'Uthman ibn 'Abd Allah ibn Aws ibn Hudhayfa al-Thaqafi narrated to us, from his grandfather Aws, who said: "We came as the delegation of Thaqif to the Prophet ﷺ. The Ahlafis lodged with al-Mughira ibn Shu'ba, and he lodged the Malikis in his tent. The Messenger of God ﷺ would come to us and talk to us after the late evening prayer, until he shifted from one foot to the other from the length of standing. Most of what he talked to us about was the complaints of Quraysh; he would say: 'We were in Mecca humiliated and oppressed, but when we came to Medina we obtained justice from the people, and the war was won by turns, sometimes against us and sometimes for us.' One night he was delayed from the time he used to come to us, and then he came. We said: 'O Messenger of God, you were delayed tonight from the time you used to come to us!' The Messenger of God ﷺ said: 'A portion of the Qur'an came upon me, and I did not wish to go out until I had recited it' — or he said: 'completed it.' He said: In the morning we asked the Companions of the Messenger of God ﷺ how they divided the Qur'an into portions. They said: 'Three, five, seven, nine, eleven, thirteen, and the portion of al-Mufassal.'"

hadiths.ar: 1205 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَوْسٍ - وَكَانَ أَوْسٌ جَدَّهُ - قَالَ: «أَشَارَ إِلَيَّ جَدِّي أَنْ أُنَاوِلَهُ نَعْلَيْهِ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي، فَنَاوَلْتُهُ فَلَبِسَهَا وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي، فَلَمَّا صَلَّى قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ  اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي فِي نَعْلَيْهِ».
hadiths.en: 1205 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shu'ba narrated to us, from al-Nu'man ibn Salim, from Ibn Aws — Aws being his grandfather — who said: "My grandfather signaled to me to hand him his sandals while he was praying. I handed them to him and he put them on while praying. When he had finished praying he said: 'I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ pray in his sandals.'"

hadiths.ar: 1206 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ ، عَنْ أَوْسِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ الثَّقَفِيِّ - وَكَانَ فِي الْوَفْدِ - قَالَ: «كُنْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي قُبَّةٍ وَمَا مِنَ الْقَوْمِ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا نَائِمٌ غَيْرِي، فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَسَارَّهُ فَقَالَ: اذْهَبْ فَاقْتُلْهُ، ثُمَّ دَعَاهُ فَقَالَ: أَلَيْسَ يَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَأَنِّي رَسُولُ اللهِ؟، قَالَ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: فَإِنِّي أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أُقَاتِلَ النَّاسَ حَتَّى يَشْهَدُوا أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَأَنِّي رَسُولُ اللهِ، فَإِذَا شَهِدُوهَا فَقَدْ مَنَعُوا  دِمَاءَهُمْ وَأَمْوَالَهُمْ - أَوْ قَالَ: قَدْ مُنِعُوا - إِلَّا بِحَقِّهَا».
hadiths.en: 1206 - Abu Dawud narrated to us: Shu'ba narrated to us, from al-Nu'man ibn Salim, from Aws ibn Aws al-Thaqafi — who was in the delegation — who said: "I was with the Prophet ﷺ in a tent and none of the people was awake except me. A man came and whispered to him, and he said: 'Go and kill him.' Then he called him back and said: 'Does he not testify that there is no god but God and that I am the Messenger of God?' He said: 'Yes.' He said: 'I have been commanded to fight people until they testify that there is no god but God and that I am the Messenger of God. When they testify to it, they have secured their blood and their property — or he said: they have been secured — except for what is due on it.'"

hadiths.ar: 1207 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَوْسٍ ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ ، قَالَ: «رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم اسْتَوْكَفَ ثَلَاثًا، قُلْتُ: مَا اسْتَوْكَفَ ثَلَاثًا؟ قَالَ: صَبَّ عَلَى يَدِهِ ثَلَاثًا».
hadiths.en: 1207 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shu'ba narrated to us, from al-Nu'man ibn Salim, from Ibn Aws, from his grandfather, who said: "I saw the Prophet ﷺ pour water three times." I said: "What is 'pouring three times'?" He said: "He poured water over his hand three times."

hadiths.ar: 1208 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسٌ ، عَنْ عُمَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ الطَّائِفِيِّ ، عَنْ أَوْسٍ الثَّقَفِيِّ ، قَالَ:  «قَدِمْنَا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي وَفْدِ ثَقِيفَ فَأَقَمْنَا عِنْدَهُ نِصْفَ شَهْرٍ، فَرَأَيْتُهُ يَنْفَتِلُ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَعَنْ يَسَارِهِ».
hadiths.en: 1208 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Qays narrated to us, from 'Umayr ibn 'Abd Allah, from 'Abd al-Malik ibn al-Mughira al-Ta'ifi, from Aws al-Thaqafi, who said: "We came to the Prophet ﷺ in the delegation of Thaqif and stayed with him for half a month, and I saw him turn away from the prayer both to his right and to his left."

hadiths.ar: 1209 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ عَطَاءٍ ، عَنْ أَوْسٍ الثَّقَفِيِّ «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَوَضَّأَ وَمَسَحَ عَلَى نَعْلَيْهِ».
hadiths.en: 1209 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama narrated to us, from Ya'la ibn 'Ata', from Aws al-Thaqafi, "that the Messenger of God ﷺ performed ablution and wiped over his sandals."

hadiths.ar: 1210 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْشَرٍ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ الْأَزْدِيِّ ، عَنْ أَوْسِ بْنِ أَبِي أَوْسٍ الثَّقَفِيِّ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «مَنْ غَسَّلَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَاغْتَسَلَ وَبَكَّرَ وَابْتَكَرَ وَمَشَى وَلَمْ يَرْكَبْ كَانَ لَهُ بِكُلِّ خُطْوَةٍ صِيَامُ سَنَةٍ وَقِيَامُهَا».
hadiths.en: 1210 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Abu Ma'shar narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Qays, from Muhammad ibn Sa'd al-Azdi, from Aws ibn Abi Aws al-Thaqafi, that the Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever washes himself and bathes on Friday, goes early and arrives early, walks and does not ride, will have for every step the reward of a year's fasting and night prayer."

sections.title_en: And Bilāl, freedman of Abū Bakr.

hadiths.ar: 1211 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْعُمَرِيُّ وَابْنُ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، قَالَ: «دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ الْكَعْبَةَ فَأَغْلَقَ عَلَيْهِ الْبَابَ، وَدَخَلَ مَعَهُ الْفَضْلُ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ وَأُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ وَبِلَالٌ، فَلَمَّا خَرَجُوا سَابَقْتُ النَّاسَ فَسَبَقْتُهُمْ، فَقُلْتُ لِبِلَالٍ : أَيْنَ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم؟ قَالَ: بَيْنَ الْعَمُودَيْنِ  الْمُقَدَّمَيْنِ حِيَالَ الْجَزْعَةِ».
hadiths.en: 1211 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: al-ʿUmarī and Ibn Nāfiʿ narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, who said: “The Messenger of God, peace be upon him, entered the Kaʿba on the day of the conquest of Mecca and closed the door behind him, and with him entered al-Faḍl ibn ʿAbbās, ʿUthmān ibn Ṭalḥa, Usāma ibn Zayd and Bilāl. When they came out, I raced the people and got ahead of them, and I said to Bilāl: Where did the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, pray? He said: Between the two front pillars, opposite the jazʿa (a marker inside the Kaʿba, perhaps a reddish stone).”

hadiths.ar: 1212 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ قَالَ: أَنْبَأَنَا الْحَكَمُ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي لَيْلَى يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ بِلَالًا قَالَ: «كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَمْسَحُ عَلَى الْخُفَّيْنِ وَالْخِمَارِ»، وَرَوَى هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ الْأَعْمَشُ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ عَنْ بِلَالٍ.
hadiths.en: 1212 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, he said: al-Ḥakam informed us, he said: I heard Ibn Abī Laylā narrating that Bilāl said: “The Prophet, peace be upon him, used to wipe over the leather socks and the head covering (khimār).” And al-Aʿmash narrated this hadith from al-Ḥakam, from Ibn Abī Laylā, from Kaʿb ibn ʿUjra, from Bilāl.
