A man of the household said: 'That one is a hypocrite who does not love God and His Messenger!' The Messenger of God ﷺ said: 'Does he not say there is no god but God?' They said: 'God and His Messenger know best; as for us, we see his affection and his conversation only directed toward the hypocrites!' The Messenger of God ﷺ said: 'God, Mighty and Majestic, has forbidden the Fire to whoever says there is no god but God, seeking by it the face of God.'" Mahmud said: "I narrated this hadith in a gathering in which was Abu Ayyub al-Ansari, in the land of the Romans, during the campaign of Yazid ibn Mu'awiya. Abu Ayyub objected to me and said: 'I do not think the Messenger of God ﷺ ever said this.' Mahmud said: I vowed that if God returned me safe, I would ask 'Itban ibn Malik about this hadith in his people's mosque if he were alive. So I entered ihram for 'umra from Ilya', then came to Medina and found 'Itban an elderly blind man leading his people in prayer. I gave him my lineage and he recognized me — or he said: I asked him about this hadith, and he narrated it to me as he had narrated it to me the first time." Al-Zuhri said: "We think that was before the obligatory duties were revealed, for an injunction was revealed after which we found the scholars holding that view. So whoever among you can avoid being deluded, let him not be deluded. We fear the matter has come to that. God, Mighty and Majestic, has imposed on the people of this statement duties which we fear the matter has now come to."

sections.title_ar: مَحْمُودُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
sections.title_en: Maḥmūd ibn al-Rabīʿ, from the Prophet, peace be upon him
title_en_alternates: Mahmud ibn al-Rabiʿ, on the authority of the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him)

hadiths.ar: 1338 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ مَحْمُودِ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ «أَنَّهُ عَقَلَ مَجَّةً مَجَّهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي دَارِهِمْ».
hadiths.en: 1338 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Maḥmūd ibn al-Rabīʿ: “that he remembered a mouthful of water that the Prophet, peace be upon him, spat out (majja) in their house.”
en_alternates: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Ibrahim ibn Saʿd narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Mahmud ibn al-Rabiʿ: «that he remembered a mouthful of water that the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) had spat out in their house.»

hadiths.ar: 1339 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ ، عَنْ جَوْنِ بْنِ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الْمُحَبِّقِ الْهُذَلِيِّ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «دِبَاغُ الْأَدِيمِ ذَكَاتُهُ».
hadiths.en: 1339 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Hishām narrated to us, from Qatāda, from al-Ḥasan, from Jawn ibn Qatāda, from Salama ibn al-Muḥabbiq al-Hudhalī, that the Prophet, peace be upon him, said: “The tanning of a hide is its purification by slaughter (dhakātuhu).”
en_alternates: Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Hisham narrated to us, from Qatada, from al-Hasan, from Jawn ibn Qatada, from Salama ibn al-Muhabbiq al-Hudhali, that the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) said: «The tanning of a hide is its purification (dhakāt).»

hadiths.ar: 1340 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ أَبِي الْفَيْضِ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللهِ بْنَ مُرَّةَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي سَعْدٍ الزُّرَقِيِّ «أَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنْ أَشْجَعَ سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْعَزْلِ، قَالَ: مَا يُقَدَّرْ فِي الرَّحِمِ يَكُنْ».
hadiths.en: 1340 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Abū al-Fayḍ, who said: I heard ʿAbd Allāh ibn Murra narrating from Abū Saʿd al-Zuraqī: “that a man of Ashjaʿ asked the Prophet, peace be upon him, about coitus interruptus (ʿazl); he said: What is decreed in the womb will come to be.”
en_alternates: 1340 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Abu al-Fayd, who said: I heard ʿAbd Allah ibn Murra narrating from Abu Saʿd al-Zuraqi: «that a man from Ashjaʿ asked the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) about coitus interruptus (ʿazl), and he said: Whatever is decreed in the womb will come to be.»

hadiths.ar: 1341 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ ، عَنِ الْعَيْزَارِ بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الْجَعْدِ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «الْخَيْلُ مَعْقُودٌ فِي نَوَاصِيهَا الْخَيْرُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ».
hadiths.en: 1341 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-ʿAyzār ibn Ḥurayth, from ʿUrwa ibn al-Jaʿd, who said: I heard the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, say: “Goodness is tied to the forelocks of horses until the Day of Resurrection.”
en_alternates: 1341 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from al-ʿAyzar ibn Hurayth, from ʿUrwa ibn al-Jaʿd, who said: I heard the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) say: «Good is tied to the forelocks of horses until the Day of Resurrection.»

hadiths.ar: 1342 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي يَعْلَى بْنُ عَطَاءٍ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عُمَارَةَ بْنَ حَدِيدٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ صَخْرٍ الْغَامِدِيِّ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِأُمَّتِي فِي بُكُورِهَا، قَالَ: وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا بَعَثَ سَرِيَّةً بَعَثَهَا مِنْ أَوَّلِ النَّهَارِ. وَكَانَ صَخْرٌ رَجُلًا تَاجِرًا، كَانَ يُرْسِلُ غِلْمَانَهُ مِنْ أَوَّلِ النَّهَارِ، فَكَثُرَ مَالُهُ حَتَّى كَانَ لَا يَدْرِي أَيْنَ يَضَعُهُ».
hadiths.en: 1342 - Yūnus narrated to us, Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, he said: Yaʿlā ibn ʿAṭāʾ informed me, he said: I heard ʿUmāra ibn Ḥadīd narrating from Ṣakhr al-Ghāmidī that the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, said: “O God, bless my community in its early mornings.” He said: When the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, sent out a military detachment, he would send it at the start of the day. And Ṣakhr was a merchant who would send out his servants at the start of the day, so his wealth increased until he did not know where to put it.
en_alternates: 1342 - Yunus narrated to us; Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, he said: Yaʿla ibn ʿAta' informed me, he said: I heard ʿUmara ibn Hadid narrating from Sakhr al-Ghamidi that the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) said: «O God, bless my community in their early mornings. He said: And when the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) sent out a raiding party, he would send it at the beginning of the day. And Sakhr was a merchant who would send out his servants at the beginning of the day, so his wealth grew until he did not know where to put it.»

hadiths.ar: 1343 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ عَطَاءٍ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ السُّوَائِيَّ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: «صَلَّى بِنَا رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي مَسْجِدِ الْخَيْفِ بِمِنًى صَلَاةَ الصُّبْحِ، فَلَمَّا قَضَى صَلَاتَهُ إِذَا رَجُلَانِ فِي مُؤَخَّرِ الْمَسْجِدِ لَمْ يُصَلِّيَا مَعَ النَّاسِ، فَأُتِيَ بِهِمَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تُرْعَدُ فَرَائِصُهُمَا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: مَا مَنَعَكُمَا أَنْ تُصَلِّيَا مَعَنَا؟، قَالَا: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، صَلَّيْنَا فِي رِحَالِنَا! فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: فَلَا تَفْعَلَا، إِذَا صَلَّيْتُمَا فِي رِحَالِكُمَا ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُمَا الْإِمَامَ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي فَصَلِّيَا مَعَهُ، فَإِنَّهَا لَكُمَا نَافِلَةٌ أَوْ تَطَوُّعٌ».
hadiths.en: 1343 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Yaʿlā ibn ʿAṭāʾ, who said: I heard Jābir ibn Yazīd ibn al-Aswad al-Suwāʾī narrating from his father, who said: “The Messenger of God, peace be upon him, led us in the dawn prayer in the mosque of al-Khayf at Minā. When he finished his prayer, there were two men at the back of the mosque who had not prayed with the people. They were brought to the Prophet, peace be upon him, their shoulder muscles trembling, and the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, said: What prevented you from praying with us? They said: O Messenger of God, we prayed in our camps! The Messenger of God, peace be upon him, said: Do not do so. If you have prayed in your camps and then come to the imam while he is praying, pray with him, for it will be for you a supererogatory (nāfila) or voluntary prayer.”

hadiths.ar: 1344 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ عَطَاءٍ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: «أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ فِي مَسْجِدِ الْخَيْفِ، فَتَنَاوَلْتُ يَدَهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ أَطَيْبُ مِنْ رِيحِ الْمِسْكِ وَأَبْرَدُ مِنَ الثَّلْجِ».
hadiths.en: 1344 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Yaʿlā ibn ʿAṭāʾ, who said: I heard Jābir ibn Yazīd ibn al-Aswad narrating from his father, who said: “I came to the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, while he was in the mosque of al-Khayf, and I took hold of his hand, and it was more fragrant than the scent of musk and colder than snow.”

hadiths.ar: 1345 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ وَحَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، كِلَاهُمَا عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ الْعُقَيْلِيِّ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ حَوَالَةَ الْأَزْدِيِّ ، قَالَ: «أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ فِي ظِلِّ دَوْمَةٍ وَكَاتِبٌ يُمْلِي عَلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ: يَا ابْنَ حَوَالَةَ، أَلَا أَكْتُبُكَ؟، قُلْتُ: مَا خَارَ اللهُ لِي وَرَسُولُهُ! فَجَعَلَ يُمْلِي وَيُمْلِي، قَالَ: وَنَظَرْتُ فَإِذَا اسْمُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما، فَعَرَفْتُ أَنَّهُمَا لَا يُكْتَبَانِ إِلَّا فِي خَيْرٍ، قَالَ لِي: يَا ابْنَ حَوَالَةَ: أَلَا أَكْتُبُكَ؟، قُلْتُ: بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ! ثُمَّ قَالَ: يَا ابْنَ حَوَالَةَ، كَيْفَ أَنْتَ إِذَا نَشَأَتْ فِتْنَةٌ الْقَاعِدُ فِيهَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْقَائِمِ وَالْقَائِمُ فِيهَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْمَاشِي وَالْمَاشِي فِيهَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ السَّاعِي؟، قُلْتُ: مَا خَارَ اللهُ لِي وَرَسُولُهُ، ثُمَّ  قَالَ: يَا ابْنَ حَوَالَةَ، كَيْفَ أَنْتَ إِذَا نَشَأَتْ أُخْرَى الَّتِي قَبْلَهَا كَنَفْحَةِ أَرْنَبٍ كَأَنَّهَا صَيَاصِي بَقَرٍ؟، قُلْتُ: مَا خَارَ اللهُ لِي وَرَسُولُهُ، قَالَ: وَمَرَّ رَجُلٌ مُقَنَّعٌ، فَقَالَ: هَذَا وَأَصْحَابُهُ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَى الْحَقِّ! فَأَتَيْتُهُ فَأَخَذْتُ بِمَنْكِبِهِ وَأَقْبَلْتُ بِوَجْهِهِ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ: هَذَا يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ؟ قَالَ: هَذَا، فَإِذَا هُوَ عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عَفَّانَ».
hadiths.en: 1345 - Yunus narrated to us, saying: Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama and Hammad ibn Zayd narrated to us, both from Sa'id al-Jurayri, from 'Abd Allah ibn Shaqiq al-'Uqayli, from 'Abd Allah ibn Hawala al-Azdi, who said: "I came to the Messenger of God ﷺ while he was in the shade of a doum palm, with a scribe taking dictation from him. He said: 'O Ibn Hawala, shall I not have you written down?' I said: 'Whatever God and His Messenger choose for me.' He kept dictating and dictating. I looked, and there were the names of Abu Bakr and 'Umar, may God be pleased with them, so I knew that they would be written down only for something good. He said to me: 'O Ibn Hawala, shall I not have you written down?' I said: 'Yes, O Messenger of God!' Then he said: 'O Ibn Hawala, how will you be when a tribulation arises in which the one sitting is better than the one standing, the one standing is better than the one walking, and the one walking is better than the one running?' I said: 'Whatever God and His Messenger choose for me.' Then he said: 'O Ibn Hawala, how will you be when another arises, the previous one being like the sneeze of a rabbit compared to it, as though it were the horns of cattle?' I said: 'Whatever God and His Messenger choose for me.' A man passed by, his head covered, and he said: 'This man and his companions will be on the truth on that day!' I went to him, took him by the shoulder, turned his face toward the Messenger of God ﷺ and said: 'This one, O Messenger of God?' He said: 'This one.' And it was 'Uthman ibn 'Affan."

hadiths.ar: 1346 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ وَحَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ حَوَالَةَ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ: «تَهْجُمُونَ عَلَى رَجُلٍ مُعْتَجِرٍ بِبُرْدَةٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ يُبَايِعُ النَّاسَ، قَالَ: فَهَجَمْنَا عَلَى عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ رضي الله عنه، مُعْتَجِرٌ بِبُرْدَةٍ يُبَايِعُ النَّاسَ».
hadiths.en: 1346 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama and Hammad ibn Zayd narrated to us, from al-Jurayri, from 'Abd Allah ibn Shaqiq, from 'Abd Allah ibn Hawala, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said one day: "You will come upon a man wrapped in a cloak, one of the people of Paradise, receiving the pledge of allegiance from the people." He said: "We came upon 'Uthman ibn 'Affan, may God be pleased with him, wrapped in a cloak, receiving the pledge of allegiance from the people."

hadiths.ar: 1347 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا غَسَّانُ بْنُ بُرْزِينَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سَيَّارُ بْنُ سَلَامَةَ الرِّيَاحِيُّ - مِنْ بَنِي تَمِيمٍ - عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ السَّلِيطِيِّ مِنْ بَنِي عَبْسٍ ، عَنْ نُقَادَةَ الْأَسَدِيِّ «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَهُ إِلَى رَجُلٍ يَسْتَحْمِلُهُ فِي نَاقَةٍ لَهُ فَأَبَى، فَأَتَى رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَهُ، فَبَعَثَهُ إِلَى رَجُلٍ آخَرَ يَسْتَحْمِلُهُ فَبَعَثَ إِلَيْهِ بِنَاقَةٍ، فَجَاءَ بِهَا نُقَادَةُ يَقُودُهَا، فَلَمَّا نَظَرَ إِلَيْهَا رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: بَارَكَ اللهُ فِيهَا وَفِيمَنْ بَعَثَ بِهَا، قَالَ نُقَادَةُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، وَفِيمَنْ جَاءَ بِهَا؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: وَفِيمَنْ جَاءَ بِهَا، قَالَ: فَقُدِّمَتْ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَحُلِبَتْ فَدَرَّتْ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: اللَّهُمَّ أَكْثِرْ مَالَ فُلَانٍ وَوَلَدَهُ - الْمَانِعَ الْأَوَّلَ - وَقَالَ لِصَاحِبِ النَّاقَةِ: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ رِزْقَ فُلَانٍ يَوْمًا بِيَوْمٍ».
hadiths.en: 1347 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Ghassān ibn Burzīn narrated to us, he said: Sayyār ibn Salāma al-Riyāḥī – of Banū Tamīm – narrated to us, from al-Barāʾ al-Salīṭī of Banū ʿAbs, from Nuqāda al-Asadī: “that the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, sent him to a man to ask him for a mount (a she-camel of his), but he refused. So he came to the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, and told him, and he sent him to another man to ask him for a mount, and he sent a she-camel with him. Nuqāda came leading her, and when the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, looked at her he said: May God bless her and the one who sent her. Nuqāda said: And the one who brought her, O Messenger of God? The Messenger of God, peace be upon him, said: And the one who brought her. He said: Then she was brought forward to the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, and milked, and she gave abundant milk. The Messenger of God, peace be upon him, said: O God, increase the wealth and children of so-and-so – the first one who refused – and he said of the owner of the she-camel: O God, make the provision of so-and-so day by day.”

hadiths.ar: 1348 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الْأَحْوَلِ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا حَاجِبٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم «نَهَى أَنْ يُتَوَضَّأَ مِنْ فَضْلِ وَضُوءِ الْمَرْأَةِ»، هَكَذَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ. وَقَالَ عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ: عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَاجِبٍ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو.
hadiths.en: 1348 - Yūnus narrated to us, Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim al-Aḥwal, who said: I heard Abū Ḥājib narrating from a man among the Companions of the Prophet, peace be upon him, that the Prophet, peace be upon him, “forbade performing ablution with the leftover water of a woman's ablution.” Thus Abū Dāwūd narrated to us. And ʿAbd al-Ṣamad ibn ʿAbd al-Wārith said: From Shuʿba, from ʿĀṣim, from Abū Ḥājib, from al-Ḥakam ibn ʿAmr.
en_alternates: 1348 - Yunus narrated to us; Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from ʿAsim al-Ahwal, who said: I heard Abu Hajib narrating from a man among the Companions of the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) that the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) «forbade performing ablution with the leftover water of a woman's ablution» – thus Abu Dawud narrated to us. And ʿAbd al-Samad ibn ʿAbd al-Warith said: from Shuʿba, from ʿAsim, from Abu Hajib, from al-Hakam ibn ʿAmr.

hadiths.ar: 1349 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ نَصْرِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ الْحُوَيْرِثِ ، قَالَ: «كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ إِذَا افْتَتَحَ الصَّلَاةَ وَإِذَا رَكَعَ وَإِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ».
hadiths.en: 1349 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Qatāda, from Naṣr ibn ʿĀṣim, from Mālik ibn al-Ḥuwayrith, who said: “The Prophet, peace be upon him, used to raise his hands when he began the prayer, when he bowed, and when he raised his head from bowing.”
en_alternates: 1349 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Qatada, from Nasr ibn ʿAsim, from Malik ibn al-Huwayrith, who said: «The Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) used to raise his hands when he began the prayer, when he bowed, and when he raised his head from bowing.»

sections.title_ar: عَمْرُو بْنُ أُمَيَّةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم .
sections.title_en: ʿAmr ibn Umayya, on the authority of the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him).

hadiths.ar: 1350 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَرْبُ بْنُ شَدَّادٍ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي أَنَّهُ «رَأَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَمْسَحُ عَلَى الْخُفَّيْنِ».
hadiths.en: 1350 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Harb ibn Shaddad narrated to us, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, who said: Jaʿfar ibn ʿAmr ibn Umayya narrated to us, he said: My father narrated to me that he «saw the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) wiping over his leather socks.»

hadiths.ar: 1351 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ الضَّمْرِيُّ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ: «رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَحْتَزُّ مِنْ كَتِفِ شَاةٍ، فَصَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ».
hadiths.en: 1351 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Ibrahim ibn Saʿd narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, who said: Jaʿfar ibn ʿAmr ibn Umayya al-Damri narrated to me, from his father, who said: «I saw the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) cutting meat from a shoulder of lamb, then he prayed without performing ablution.»

sections.title_ar: قُطْبَةُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم .
sections.title_en: Quṭba ibn Mālik, from the Prophet, peace be upon him.
title_en_alternates: Qutba ibn Malik, on the authority of the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him).

hadiths.ar: 1352 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ وَالْمَسْعُودِيُّ ، قَالَا: أَنْبَأَنَا زِيَادُ بْنُ عِلَاقَةَ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ قُطْبَةَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ يَقُولُ: «صَلَّيْتُ خَلْفَ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصُّبْحَ فَقَرَأَ بِقَافٍ، قَرَأَ: {وَالنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَاتٍ}». قَالَ الْمَسْعُودِيُّ فِي حَدِيثِهِ: فَلَمَّا قَرَأَ {وَالنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَاتٍ} قُلْتُ فِي نَفْسِي: مَا بُسُوقُهَا؟.
hadiths.en: 1352 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba and al-Masʿūdī narrated to us, both saying: Ziyād ibn ʿIlāqa informed us, he said: I heard Quṭba ibn Mālik say: “I prayed the dawn prayer behind the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, and he recited Sūrat Qāf; he recited: {and the tall palm trees} (Qur’an 50:10).” Al-Masʿūdī said in his version: When he recited {and the tall palm trees}, I said to myself: What is their tallness (busūq)?
en_alternates: 1352 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba and al-Masʿudi narrated to us, both said: Ziyad ibn Ilaqa informed us, he said: I heard Qutba ibn Malik say: «I prayed the dawn prayer behind the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him), and he recited Qaf; he recited: {and the tall palm trees}.» Al-Masʿudi said in his narration: When he recited {and the tall palm trees}, I said to myself: What is their tallness?

sections.title_ar: ثَعْلَبَةُ بْنُ زَهْدَمٍ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم .
sections.title_en: Thaʿlaba ibn Zahdam, from the Messenger of God, peace be upon him.

hadiths.ar: 1353 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الْأَسْوَدَ بْنَ هِلَالٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي ثَعْلَبَةَ بْنِ يَرْبُوعٍ «أَنَّ أُنَاسًا مِنْهُمْ أَتَوْا رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَانُوا - بَنُو ثَعْلَبَةَ - أَصَابُوا رَجُلًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، هَؤُلَاءِ بَنُو ثَعْلَبَةَ بْنِ يَرْبُوعٍ قَتَلَتْ فُلَانًا! فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: لَا تَجْنِي نَفْسٌ عَلَى أُخْرَى، وَذَكَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصَّدَقَةَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: يَدُ الْمُعْطِي الْعُلْيَا؛ أُمَّكَ وَأَبَاكَ، وَأُخْتَكَ وَأَخَاكَ، ثُمَّ أَدْنَاكَ فَأَدْنَاكَ». هَكَذَا قَالَ شُعْبَةُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي ثَعْلَبَةَ، وَقَالَ الثَّوْرِيُّ: عَنْ ثَعْلَبَةَ بْنِ زَهْدَمٍ.
hadiths.en: 1353 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Ashʿath ibn Abī al-Shaʿthāʾ, who said: I heard al-Aswad ibn Hilāl narrating from a man of Banū Thaʿlaba ibn Yarbūʿ: “that some people of them came to the Messenger of God, peace be upon him – they, Banū Thaʿlaba, had killed a man from among the Companions of the Messenger of God, peace be upon him – and a man said: O Messenger of God, these are Banū Thaʿlaba ibn Yarbūʿ, who killed so-and-so! The Messenger of God, peace be upon him, said: No soul shall bear the guilt of another. And the Prophet, peace be upon him, mentioned charity and said: The giving hand is the upper one: (begin with) your mother and your father, your sister and your brother, then the next closest and the next closest.” Thus Shuʿba said: from a man of Banū Thaʿlaba; and al-Thawrī said: from Thaʿlaba ibn Zahdam.

sections.title_ar: عَرْفَجَةُ بْنُ أَسْعَدَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم .
sections.title_en: ʿArfaja ibn Asʿad, from the Messenger of God, peace be upon him.
title_en_alternates: ʿArfaja ibn Asʿad, on the authority of the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him).

hadiths.ar: 1354 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَشْهَبِ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ طَرَفَةَ ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ عَرْفَجَةَ بْنِ أَسْعَدَ «أَنَّهُ أُصِيبَ أَنْفُهُ يَوْمَ الْكُلَابِ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَاتَّخَذَ أَنْفًا مِنْ وَرِقٍ فَأَنْتَنَ عَلَيْهِ، فَأَمَرَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم  أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ أَنْفًا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ».
hadiths.en: 1354 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Abū al-Ashhab narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Ṭarafa, from his grandfather ʿArfaja ibn Asʿad: “that his nose was struck off on the day of al-Kulāb in the pre-Islamic period, so he made a nose of silver, which began to rot on him, so the Prophet, peace be upon him, ⦗p. 587⦘ commanded him to make a nose of gold.”
en_alternates: 1354 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Abu al-Ashhab narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Rahman ibn Tarafa, from his grandfather ʿArfaja ibn Asʿad: «that his nose was injured on the day of al-Kulab in the Jahiliyya, so he made himself a nose of silver, which began to stink on him, and the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) commanded him to make a nose of gold.»

sections.title_ar: جُنْدُبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللهِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم .
sections.title_en: Jundub ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from the Messenger of God, peace be upon him.
title_en_alternates: Jundub ibn ʿAbd Allah, on the authority of the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him).

hadiths.ar: 1355 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عِمْرَانُ الْقَطَّانُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ ، عَنْ جُنْدُبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «مَنْ قُتِلَ تَحْتَ رَايَةٍ عِمِّيَّةٍ يَنْصُرُ الْعَصَبَةَ وَيَغْضَبُ لِلْعَصَبَةِ فَقَتِيلُ جَاهِلِيَّةٍ».
hadiths.en: 1355 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: ʿImrān al-Qaṭṭān narrated to us, from Qatāda, from Abū Mijlaz, from Jundub ibn ʿAbd Allāh, that the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, said: “Whoever is killed under a blind banner, supporting tribal partisanship and getting angry for the sake of tribal partisanship, dies a death of pre-Islamic ignorance (jāhiliyya).”
en_alternates: 1355 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: ʿImran al-Qattan narrated to us, from Qatada, from Abu Mijlaz, from Jundub ibn ʿAbd Allah, that the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) said: «Whoever is killed under a blind banner, supporting tribal partisanship and becoming angry for the sake of tribal partisanship, dies the death of the Jahiliyya (pre-Islamic ignorance).»

hadiths.ar: 1356 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ مُطَرِّفَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ حَكِيمِ بْنِ قَيْسِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ «أَنَّ أَبَاهُ أَوْصَى فَقَالَ: إِذَا أَنَا مُتُّ فَلَا تَنُوحُوا عَلَيَّ، فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يُنَحْ عَلَيْهِ».
hadiths.en: 1356 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Qatāda, who said: I heard Muṭarrif ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Shikhkhīr narrating from Ḥakīm ibn Qays ibn ʿĀṣim: “that his father left a bequest, saying: When I die, do not wail over me, for no one wailed over the Messenger of God, peace be upon him.”
en_alternates: 1356 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Qatada, who said: I heard Mutarrif ibn ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Shikhkhir narrating from Hakim ibn Qays ibn ʿAsim: «that his father left a bequest, saying: When I die, do not wail over me, for the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) was not wailed over.»

hadiths.ar: 1357 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتَ سِيرِينَ تُحَدِّثُ عَنِ الرَّبَابِ ، عَنْ سَلْمَانَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «إِذَا صَامَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيُفْطِرْ عَلَى التَّمْرِ، فَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ فَعَلَى الْمَاءِ فَإِنَّهُ طَهُورٌ».
hadiths.en: 1357 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim, who said: I heard Ḥafṣa bint Sīrīn narrating from al-Rabāb, from Salmān ibn ʿĀmir, that the Prophet, peace be upon him, said: “When one of you fasts, let him break his fast with dates; and if he does not find any, then with water, for it is purifying.”
en_alternates: 1357 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from ʿAsim, who said: I heard Hafsa bint Sirin narrating from al-Rabab, from Salman ibn ʿAmir, that the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) said: «When one of you fasts, let him break his fast with dates; if he cannot find any, then with water, for it is purifying.»

sections.title_ar: مُعَاوِيَةُ اللَّيْثِيُّ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم .
sections.title_en: Muʿāwiya al-Laythī, from the Prophet, peace be upon him.
title_en_alternates: Muʿawiya al-Laythi, on the authority of the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him).

hadiths.ar: 1358 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عِمْرَانُ الْقَطَّانُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ نَصْرِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ اللَّيْثِيِّ ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ اللَّيْثِيِّ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «يُصْبِحُ النَّاسُ مُجْدِبِينَ، فَيَأْتِيهِمُ اللهُ بِرِزْقٍ مِنْ عِنْدِهِ، فَيُصْبِحُونَ مُشْرِكِينَ فَيَقُولُونَ: مُطِرْنَا بِنَوْءِ كَذَا وَكَذَا».
hadiths.en: 1358 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: ʿImrān al-Qaṭṭān narrated to us, from Qatāda, from Naṣr ibn ʿĀṣim al-Laythī, from Muʿāwiya al-Laythī, that the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, said: “People will wake up in drought, then God will bring them provision from Himself, and they will wake up as polytheists, saying: We were given rain by the setting of such-and-such a star (nawʾ).”
en_alternates: 1358 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: ʿImran al-Qattan narrated to us, from Qatada, from Nasr ibn ʿAsim al-Laythi, from Muʿawiya al-Laythi, that the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) said: «People will wake up in drought, and God will bring them provision from Himself, and they will wake up as polytheists, saying: We were given rain by such-and-such a star.»

hadiths.ar: 1359 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ: قَالَ لِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُنْكَدِرِ : مَا اسْمُكَ؟ قُلْتُ: شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو شُعْبَةَ - وَكَانَ لَطِيفًا - عَنْ سُوَيْدِ بْنِ مُقَرِّنٍ ، قَالَ: «لَطَمَ رَجُلٌ غُلَامًا لَهُ أَوْ إِنْسَانًا، فَقَالَ سُوَيْدٌ: أَمَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ الصُّورَةَ مُحَرَّمَةٌ؟ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنِي سَابِعَ سَبْعَةِ إِخْوَةٍ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا لَنَا إِلَّا خَادِمٌ، فَلَطَمَهُ أَحَدُنَا فَأَمَرَهُ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُعْتِقَهُ».
hadiths.en: 1359 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, he said: Muḥammad ibn al-Munkadir said to me: What is your name? I said: Shuʿba. He said: Abū Shuʿba – who was a kind man – narrated to me, from Suwayd ibn Muqarrin, who said: “A man slapped a servant of his, or another person, and Suwayd said: Do you not know that the face is sacrosanct? I remember that we were seven brothers in the time of the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, and we had only one servant, and one of us slapped him, so the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, commanded him to free him.”
en_alternates: 1359 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, he said: Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir said to me: What is your name? I said: Shuʿba. He said: Abu Shuʿba narrated to me – and he was gentle – from Suwayd ibn Muqarrin, who said: «A man slapped a servant of his, or some other person, and Suwayd said: Do you not know that the face is inviolable? I saw myself as the seventh of seven brothers in the time of the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him), and we had nothing but one servant, and one of us slapped him, and the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) commanded him to set him free.»

sections.title_ar: هِلَالٌ الْمَازِنِيُّ عَنْ سُوَيْدِ بْنِ مُقَرِّنٍ
sections.title_en: Hilāl al-Māzinī, from Suwayd ibn Muqarrin
title_en_alternates: Hilal al-Mazini, on the authority of Suwayd ibn Muqarrin

hadiths.ar: 1360 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ ، سَمِعْتُ هِلَالًا الْمَازِنِيَّ يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ سُوَيْدَ بْنَ مُقَرِّنٍ يَقُولُ: «أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِجَرَّةٍ انْتُبِذَ فِيهَا، فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَنَهَانِي، فَكَسَرْتُ الْجَرَّةَ».
hadiths.en: 1360 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Abū Ḥamza: I heard Hilāl al-Māzinī say: I heard Suwayd ibn Muqarrin say: “I came to the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, with a jar in which nabīdh (a fermented infusion) had been made, and I asked him about it, and he forbade me, so I broke the jar.”
en_alternates: 1360 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Abu Hamza: I heard Hilal al-Mazini say: I heard Suwayd ibn Muqarrin say: «I came to the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) with a jar in which nabīdh had been made, and I asked him about it, and he forbade me, so I broke the jar.»

hadiths.ar: 1361 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ ، عَنْ حَنْظَلَةَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ «أَنَّ رَجُلًا سَلَّمَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى تَمَسَّحَ وَقَالَ: لَمْ يَمْنَعْنِي أَنْ أَرُدَّ عَلَيْكَ إِلَّا أَنِّي لَمْ أَكُنْ مُتَوَضِّئًا، أَوْ قَالَ: لَمْ يَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى تَمَسَّحَ فَرَدَّ عَلَيْهِ».
hadiths.en: 1361 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn al-Munkadir, from a man, from Ḥanẓala al-Anṣārī: “that a man greeted the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, with salām and he did not return the greeting until he had wiped himself (with earth, i.e., performed tayammum), and said: Nothing prevented me from returning your greeting except that I was not in a state of ablution.” Or he said: “He did not return his greeting until he had wiped himself, and then he returned his greeting.”
en_alternates: 1361 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir, from a man, from Hanzala al-Ansari: «that a man greeted the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) with salām, and he did not return it until he had wiped himself (i.e., performed dry ablution) and said: Nothing prevented me from returning your greeting except that I was not in a state of ablution» – or he said: «he did not return it to him until he had wiped himself, then he returned it to him.»

hadiths.ar: 1362 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ خُبَيْبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ حَفْصَ بْنَ عَاصِمٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُعَلَّى أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «كَانَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَأَنَا أُصَلِّي، قَالَ: فَدَعَانِي، قَالَ: فَصَلَّيْتُ ثُمَّ جِئْتُ، فَقَالَ: مَا مَنَعَكَ أَنْ تُجِيبَنِي حِينَ دَعَوْتُكَ؟ أَمَا سَمِعْتَ اللهَ تبارك وتعالى يَقُولُ: {يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَجِيبُوا لِلهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ لِمَا يُحْيِيكُمْ}؟ لَأُعَلِّمَنَّكَ أَعْظَمَ سُورَةٍ فِي الْقُرْآنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَخْرُجَ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ، قَالَ: فَمَشَيْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى كِدْنَا أَنْ نَبْلُغَ بَابَ الْمَسْجِدِ، فَقُلْتُ: نَسِيَ! فَذَكَّرْتُهُ فَقُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، إِنَّكَ قُلْتَ لِي كَذَا وَكَذَا! فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: {الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ} السَّبْعُ الْمَثَانِي وَالْقُرْآنُ الْعَظِيمُ الَّذِي أُوتِيتُهُ».
hadiths.en: 1362 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Khubayb ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, who said: I heard Ḥafṣ ibn ʿĀṣim narrating from Abū Saʿīd ibn al-Muʿallā that the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, “was in the mosque while I was praying. He said: He called me, so I finished my prayer and then came. He said: What prevented you from answering me when I called you? Did you not hear God, Blessed and Exalted, say: {O you who believe, respond to God and to the Messenger when he calls you to that which gives you life} (Qur’an 8:24)? I will teach you the greatest sūra in the Qur’an before I leave the mosque. He said: So I walked with the Prophet, peace be upon him, until we were about to reach the door of the mosque, and I said (to myself): He has forgotten! So I reminded him, saying: O Messenger of God, you said such-and-such to me! The Messenger of God, peace be upon him, said: {Praise be to God, Lord of the worlds} (Qur’an 1:2) – it is the seven oft-repeated (verses) and the Great Qur’an which I have been given.”

hadiths.ar: 1363 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا صَفْوَانُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو السَّكْسَكِيُّ ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُثَنَّى الْمُلَيْكِيِّ ، عَنْ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ عَبْدٍ السُّلَمِيِّ - وَكَانَتْ لَهُ صُحْبَةٌ - أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «الْقَتْلَى ثَلَاثَةٌ: رَجُلٌ مُؤْمِنٌ خَرَجَ بِنَفْسِهِ وَمَالِهِ فَلَقِيَ الْعَدُوَّ فَقَاتَلَ حَتَّى يُقْتَلَ فَذَلِكَ الْمُمْتَحَنُ فِي خَيْمَةِ اللهِ تَحْتَ عَرْشِهِ لَا يَفْضُلُهُ النَّبِيُّونَ إِلَّا بِدَرَجَةِ النُّبُوَّةِ، وَرَجُلٌ مُؤْمِنٌ قَرَفَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ وَالْخَطَايَا لَقِيَ الْعَدُوَّ فَقَاتَلَ حَتَّى يُقْتَلَ فَذَلِكَ مَصْمَصَةٌ  مَحَتْ ذُنُوبَهُ وَخَطَايَاهُ، إِنَّ السَّيْفَ مَحَّاءٌ لِلْخَطَايَا، وَقِيلَ لَهُ: ادْخُلْ مِنْ أَيِّ أَبْوَابِ الْجَنَّةِ الثَّمَانِيَةِ شِئْتَ فَإِنَّهَا ثَمَانِيَةُ أَبْوَابٍ، وَلِجَهَنَّمَ سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَابٍ بَعْضُهَا أَفْضَلُ مِنْ بَعْضٍ، وَرَجُلٌ مُنَافِقٌ خَرَجَ بِنَفْسِهِ وَمَالِهِ فَقَاتَلَ حَتَّى يُقْتَلَ فَذَاكَ فِي النَّارِ، إِنَّ السَّيْفَ لَا يَمْحُو النِّفَاقَ».
hadiths.en: 1363 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Mubārak narrated to us, he said: Ṣafwān ibn ʿAmr al-Saksakī narrated to us, from Abū al-Muthannā al-Mulaykī, from ʿUtba ibn ʿAbd al-Sulamī – who was a Companion – that the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, said: “The slain are three: a believing man who went out with his life and his wealth and met the enemy and fought until he was killed – he is the tested one in God's tent beneath His Throne; the prophets are not superior to him except by the rank of prophethood. And a believing man who had burdened himself with sins and wrongdoing, who met the enemy and fought until he was killed – that is a purification (maṣmaṣa) that wipes away his sins and wrongdoing, for the sword is a wiper-away of wrongdoing; and it will be said to him: Enter from whichever of the eight gates of Paradise you wish, for there are eight gates – and Hell has seven gates, some of them worse than others. And a hypocrite who went out with his life and his wealth and fought until he was killed – he is in the Fire; the sword does not wipe away hypocrisy.”

sections.title_ar: سُفْيَانُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ - أَوِ الْحَكَمُ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ .
sections.title_en: Sufyān ibn al-Ḥakam – or al-Ḥakam ibn Sufyān.
title_en_alternates: Sufyan ibn al-Hakam – or al-Hakam ibn Sufyan.

hadiths.ar: 1364 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ أَوْ أَبِي الْحَكَمِ - رَجُلٌ مِنْ ثَقِيفَ - عَنْ أَبِيهِ «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَوَضَّأَ وَنَضَحَ فَرْجَهُ».
hadiths.en: 1364 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from Mujāhid, from al-Ḥakam or Abū al-Ḥakam – a man of Thaqīf – from his father: “that the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, performed ablution and sprinkled water on his private parts.”
en_alternates: 1364 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Mansur, from Mujahid, from al-Hakam or Abu al-Hakam – a man of Thaqif – from his father: «that the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) performed ablution and sprinkled water on his private part.»

hadiths.ar: 1365 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ وَزَائِدَةُ ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ ، قَالَ: «رَأَى عُمَارَةُ بْنُ رُوَيْبَةَ - وَكَانَتْ لَهُ صُحْبَةٌ -  بِشْرَ بْنَ مَرْوَانَ يَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ فِي الدُّعَاءِ - يَعْنِي يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ، قَالَ شُعْبَةُ: فَشَتَمَهُ أَوْ نَالَ مِنْهُ، وَقَالَ زَائِدَةُ: قَبَّحَ اللهُ هَاتَيْنِ الْيَدَيْنِ، مَا زَادَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى هَكَذَا، وَأَشَارَ» أَبُو دَاوُدَ بِالسَّبَّابَةِ.
hadiths.en: 1365 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba and Zāʾida narrated to us, from Ḥuṣayn, who said: “ʿUmāra ibn Ruwayba – who was a Companion – ⦗p. 600⦘ saw Bishr ibn Marwān raising his hands in supplication, meaning on Friday (during the sermon).” Shuʿba said: “So he rebuked him or insulted him.” And Zāʾida said: “May God disfigure these two hands! The Messenger of God, peace be upon him, did no more than this, and he pointed,” (Abū Dāwūd pointing with the index finger).
en_alternates: 1365 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba and Zaʾida narrated to us, from Husayn, who said: «ʿUmara ibn Ruwayba – who was a Companion – saw Bishr ibn Marwan raising his hands in supplication – meaning on Friday. Shuʿba said: So he insulted him or reproached him; and Zaʾida said: May God disfigure these two hands! The Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) did not do more than this, and he pointed» – Abu Dawud pointed with his index finger.

hadiths.ar: 1366 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ عَطَاءٍ ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الشَّرِيدِ الثَّقَفِيِّ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ «أَنَّ مَجْذُومًا أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِيُبَايِعَهُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: قُلْ لَهُ فَلْيَرْجِعْ فَإِنِّي قَدْ بَايَعْتُهُ».
hadiths.en: 1366 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Sharīk narrated to us, from Yaʿlā ibn ʿAṭāʾ, from ʿAmr ibn al-Sharīd al-Thaqafī, from his father: “that a man with leprosy came to the Prophet, peace be upon him, to pledge allegiance to him, and the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, said: Tell him to go back, for I have accepted his pledge.”

hadiths.ar: 1367 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَعْلَى الطَّائِفِيُّ ، قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الشَّرِيدِ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ: «اسْتَنْشَدَنِي رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِائَةَ قَافِيَةٍ مِنْ شِعْرِ أُمَيَّةَ بْنِ أَبِي الصَّلْتِ، كُلَّمَا أَنْشَدْتُهُ قَافِيَةً قَالَ: هِيهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: إِنْ كَادَ  لَيُسْلِمُ فِي شِعْرِهِ».
hadiths.en: 1367 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Yaʿlā al-Ṭāʾifī narrated to us, he said: ʿAmr ibn al-Sharīd narrated to me, from his father, who said: “The Messenger of God, peace be upon him, asked me to recite to him a hundred verses (qāfiya) of the poetry of Umayya ibn Abī al-Ṣalt. Every time I recited a verse to him he said: Go on! Then the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, said: He almost became a Muslim in his poetry.”

hadiths.ar: 1368 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الشَّرِيدِ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «الْمَرْءُ أَوْلَى بِسَقَبِهِ»، قَالَ: فَقُلْتُ لِعَمْرٍو: مَا سَقَبُهُ؟ قَالَ: شُفْعَتُهُ.
hadiths.en: 1368 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from ʿAmr ibn al-Sharīd, from his father, that the Prophet, peace be upon him, said: “A person is more entitled to his saqab.” He said: I said to ʿAmr: What is his saqab? He said: His right of preemption (shufʿa).

sections.title_en: al-Jarrah and Abu Sinan, both of Ashjaʿ

hadiths.ar: 1369 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ خِلَاسٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ ، قَالَ: «أُتِيَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ فِي امْرَأَةٍ تُوُفِّيَ عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا وَلَمْ يَدْخُلْ بِهَا وَلَمْ يَفْرِضْ لَهَا، فَأَبَى أَنْ يَقُولَ فِيهَا شَيْئًا، فَأُتِيَ فِيهَا بَعْدَ شَهْرٍ فَقَالَ: أَقُولُ فِيهِ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَ صَوَابًا فَمِنْكَ وَإِنْ كَانَ خَطَأً فَمِنِّي، لَهَا صَدُقَةُ إِحْدَى نِسَائِهَا وَلَهَا الْمِيرَاثُ وَعَلَيْهَا الْعِدَّةُ، فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَشْجَعَ فَقَالَ: قَضَى رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِينَا بِذَلِكَ فِي بَرْوَعَ بِنْتِ وَاشِقٍ، فَقَالَ: هَلُمَّ شَاهِدَيْنِ عَلَى هَذَا! فَشَهِدَ أَبُو سِنَانٍ وَالْجَرَّاحُ؛ رَجُلَانِ مِنْ أَشْجَعَ».
hadiths.en: 1369 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Hisham narrated to us, from Qatada, from Khilas, from ʿAbd Allah ibn ʿUtba, who said: «Ibn Masʿud was brought the case of a woman whose husband had died without consummating the marriage or fixing a dowry for her. He refused to say anything about it. Then it was brought to him again after a month, and he said: I will give my opinion on it: O God, if it is correct, it is from You, and if it is wrong, it is from me: she is entitled to a dowry like that of the women of her family, she inherits, and she must observe the waiting period. Then a man of Ashjaʿ stood and said: The Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) judged among us thus in the case of Barwaʿ bint Waʿshiq. He said: Bring two witnesses to this! So Abu Sinan and al-Jarrah, two men of Ashjaʿ, testified.»

hadiths.ar: 1370 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، قَالَ: كَتَبَ إِلَيَّ وَقَرَأْتُهُ عَلَيْهِ وَقَالَ لِي: إِذَا كَتَبْتُ إِلَيْكَ فَقَدْ حَدَّثْتُكَ، فَقَالَ: سَمِعْتُ هِلَالَ بْنَ يَسَافٍ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ قَيْسٍ الْأَشْجَعِيِّ قَالَ: «قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: إِذَا تَوَضَّأْتَ فَانْثُرْ، وَإِذَا اسْتَجْمَرْتَ فَأَوْتِرْ».
hadiths.en: 1370 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Manṣūr, who said: He wrote to me and I read it back to him, and he said to me: If I write to you, then I have narrated to you. He said: I heard Hilāl ibn Yasāf, from Salama ibn Qays al-Ashjaʿī, who said: “The Messenger of God, peace be upon him, said to me: When you perform ablution, blow your nose (inthir); and when you clean yourself with stones, do so an odd number of times.”
en_alternates: 1370 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Mansur, who said: He wrote to me and I read it back to him, and he said to me: When I write to you, I have narrated to you. He said: I heard Hilal ibn Yasaf, from Salama ibn Qays al-Ashjaʿi, who said: «The Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) said to me: When you perform ablution, blow out your nose; and when you clean yourself with stones, do so an odd number of times.»

hadiths.ar: 1371 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ وَوَرْقَاءُ وَسَلَّامٌ وَقَيْسٌ ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، عَنْ رِبْعِيِّ بْنِ حِرَاشٍ ، عَنْ طَارِقٍ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «إِذَا كُنْتَ فِي صَلَاةٍ فَلَا تَبْزُقْ تُجَاهَ وَجْهِكَ وَلَا عَنْ يَمِينِكَ، وَلَكِنِ ابْزُقْ تُجَاهَ يَسَارِكَ إِذَا كَانَ فَارِغًا، وَإِلَّا فَتَحْتَ قَدَمِكَ، وَقَالَ قَيْسٌ: الْيُسْرَى».
hadiths.en: 1371 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba, Warqāʾ, Sallām and Qays narrated to us, all of them from Manṣūr, from Ribʿī ibn Ḥirāsh, from Ṭāriq, from the Prophet, peace be upon him, who said: “When you are in prayer, do not spit in front of your face or to your right, but spit to your left if it is free, and otherwise under your foot.” And Qays said: “the left (foot).”
en_alternates: 1371 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba, Warqa', Sallam and Qays narrated to us, all of them from Mansur, from Ribʿi ibn Hirash, from Tariq, from the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him), who said: «When you are in prayer, do not spit in front of your face or to your right, but spit toward your left if it is empty, and otherwise under your foot.» Qays said: the left foot.

hadiths.ar: 1372 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ ، قَالَ: «خَطَبَنَا عُتْبَةُ بْنُ غَزْوَانَ فَقَالَ فِي خُطْبَتِهِ: أَلَا وَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنِي لَسَابِعَ سَبْعَةٍ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا لَنَا طَعَامٌ قَرِيبًا مِنْ شَهْرٍ إِلَّا وَرَقُ الشَّجَرِ حَتَّى قَرِحَتْ أَشْدَاقُنَا مِنْهُ».
hadiths.en: 1372 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Sulaymān ibn al-Mughīra narrated to us, from Ḥumayd ibn Hilāl, from Khālid ibn ʿUmayr, who said: “ʿUtba ibn Ghazwān addressed us, and said in his sermon: Indeed, I have seen myself as the seventh of seven with the Messenger of God, peace be upon him; for nearly a month we had no food except the leaves of trees, until our mouths became sore from it.”
en_alternates: 1372 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Sulayman ibn al-Mughira narrated to us, from Humayd ibn Hilal, from Khalid ibn ʿUmayr, who said: «ʿUtba ibn Ghazwan addressed us and said in his sermon: Indeed, I have seen myself as the seventh of seven with the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him); we had no food for nearly a month except the leaves of trees, until our jaws became sore from it.»

hadiths.ar: 1373 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ سَمُرَةَ السُّوَائِيَّ يَقُولُ: «سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ: إِنَّ بَيْنَ يَدَيِ السَّاعَةِ كَذَّابِينَ، فَقَالَ كَلِمَةً لَمْ أَفْهَمْهَا، فَقُلْتُ لِأَبِي: مَا قَالَ؟ قَالَ: فَاحْذَرُوهُمْ».
hadiths.en: 1373 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Simak ibn Harb, who said: I heard Jabir ibn Samura al-Suwaʾi say: «I heard the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) delivering a sermon, saying: Before the Hour there will be liars. Then he said a word that I did not understand, so I said to my father: What did he say? He said: So beware of them.»

hadiths.ar: 1374 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ سَمُرَةَ يَقُولُ: «سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ: أَلَا إِنَّ الْإِسْلَامَ لَا يَزَالُ عَزِيزًا إِلَى اثْنَيْ عَشَرَ خَلِيفَةً، ثُمَّ قَالَ كَلِمَةً لَمْ أَفْهَمْهَا، فَقُلْتُ لِأَبِي: مَا قَالَ؟ فَقَالَ: كُلُّهُمْ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ».
hadiths.en: 1374 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Hammad ibn Salama narrated to us, from Simak ibn Harb, who said: I heard Jabir ibn Samura say: «I heard the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) delivering a sermon, saying: Indeed, Islam will remain mighty up to twelve caliphs. Then he said a word that I did not understand, so I said to my father: What did he say? He said: All of them are from Quraysh.»

hadiths.ar: 1375 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ خُمَيْرٍ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللهِ بْنَ بُسْرٍ السُّلَمِيَّ ، قَالَ: «أَتَانَا رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَلْقَتْ لَهُ أُمِّي قَطِيفَةً فَجَلَسَ عَلَيْهَا، فَأَتَتْهُ بِتَمْرٍ فَجَعَلَ يَأْكُلُ وَيَقُولُ بِالنَّوَى هَكَذَا - وَلَوَى أَبُو دَاوُدَ إِصْبَعَيْهِ السَّبَّابَةَ وَالْوُسْطَى - كَمَا يَرْمِي بِالنَّوَاةِ فَوْقَ إِصْبَعِهِ، ثُمَّ دَعَا بِشَرَابٍ فَشَرِبَ ثُمَّ سَقَى الَّذِي عَنْ يَمِينِهِ، فَقَالَتْ أُمِّي: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، ادْعُ اللهَ لَنَا! فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ، وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ».
hadiths.en: 1375 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Yazīd ibn Khumayr, who said: I heard ʿAbd Allāh ibn Busr al-Sulamī say: “The Messenger of God, peace be upon him, came to us, and my mother spread a woolen cloth (qaṭīfa) for him and he sat on it. She brought him dates, and he began to eat and (to dispose of) the pits like this – and Abū Dāwūd twisted together his index and middle fingers – as one flicks a date pit above one's finger. Then he asked for a drink and drank, then gave it to the one on his right. My mother said: O Messenger of God, supplicate to God for us! So the Prophet, peace be upon him, said: O God, bless them in what You have provided for them, and forgive them and have mercy on them.”
en_alternates: 1375 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Yazid ibn Khumayr, who said: I heard ʿAbd Allah ibn Busr al-Sulami say: «The Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) came to us, and my mother spread a velvet cloth for him and he sat on it. She brought him dates, and he began eating and doing like this with the date stones – Abu Dawud twisted his two fingers, the index and the middle – as one flicks a date stone over his finger. Then he asked for a drink and drank, and then gave it to the one on his right. My mother said: O Messenger of God, pray to God for us! The Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) said: O God, bless them in what You have provided them, and forgive them and have mercy on them.»

hadiths.ar: 1376 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ ، عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ ، قَالَ: «رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَغَزَوْتُ فِي خِلَافَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فِي السَّرَايَا وَغَيْرِهَا».
hadiths.en: 1376 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Qays ibn Muslim, from Ṭāriq ibn Shihāb, who said: “I saw the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, and I took part in military campaigns during the caliphate of Abū Bakr, in detachments and otherwise.”
en_alternates: 1376 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Qays ibn Muslim, from Tariq ibn Shihab, who said: «I saw the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him), and I fought during the caliphate of Abu Bakr, in the raiding parties and otherwise.»

hadiths.ar: 1377 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ مُخَارِقٍ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ طَارِقَ بْنَ شِهَابٍ يَقُولُ: «قَدِمَ وَفْدُ بَجِيلَةَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: ابْدَءُوا بِالْأَحْمَسِيِّينَ، وَدَعَا لَنَا».
hadiths.en: 1377 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Mukhāriq, who said: I heard Ṭāriq ibn Shihāb say: “The delegation of Bajīla came to the Prophet, peace be upon him, and he said: Begin with the Aḥmasīs. And he supplicated for us.”
en_alternates: 1377 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Mukhariq, who said: I heard Tariq ibn Shihab say: «The delegation of Bajila came to the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him), and he said: Begin with the Ahmasis, and he prayed for us.»

hadiths.ar: 1378 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي السَّفَرِ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الشَّعْبِيَّ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ مُضَرِّسِ بْنِ أَوْسِ بْنِ لَامٍ ، قَالَ: «أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِجَمْعٍ فَقُلْتُ: هَلْ لِي مِنْ حَجٍّ؟ فَقَالَ: مَنْ صَلَّى مَعَنَا هَذِهِ الصَّلَاةَ وَوَقَفَ مَعَنَا هَذَا الْمَوْقِفَ حَتَّى يُفِيضَ أَفَاضَ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ عَرَفَاتٍ لَيْلًا أَوْ نَهَارًا تَمَّ حَجُّهُ وَقَضَى تَفَثَهُ».
hadiths.en: 1378 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Ibn Abī al-Safar, who said: I heard al-Shaʿbī narrating from ʿUrwa ibn Muḍarris ibn Aws ibn Lām, who said: “I came to the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, at Jamʿ (Muzdalifa) and said: Do I have a valid Hajj? He said: Whoever prays this prayer with us and stands in this standing place with us until he departs, having already departed from ʿArafāt before that, by night or by day, his Hajj is complete and he has fulfilled his rites (tafath).”
en_alternates: 1378 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Ibn Abi al-Safar, who said: I heard al-Shaʿbi narrating from ʿUrwa ibn Mudarris ibn Aws ibn Lam, who said: «I came to the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) at Jamʿ (Muzdalifa) and said: Do I have a Hajj? He said: Whoever prays this prayer with us and stands with us at this standing-place until he departs, having departed before that from ʿArafat, by night or by day, his Hajj is complete and he has fulfilled his rites.»

hadiths.ar: 1379 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُقَالُ لَهُ ابْنُ أَبِي الْجَدْعَاءِ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «لَيَدْخُلَنَّ الْجَنَّةَ بِشَفَاعَةِ رَجُلٍ مِنْ أُمَّتِي أَكْثَرُ مِنْ بَنِي تَمِيمٍ».
hadiths.en: 1379 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Wuhayb ibn Khālid narrated to us, from Khālid al-Ḥadhdhāʾ, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Shaqīq, from a man among the Companions of the Prophet, peace be upon him, who was called Ibn Abī al-Jadʿāʾ, who said: I heard the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, say: “More people than Banū Tamīm will enter Paradise through the intercession of one man from my community.”
en_alternates: 1379 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Wuhayb ibn Khalid narrated to us, from Khalid al-Hadhdhaʾ, from ʿAbd Allah ibn Shaqiq, from a man among the Companions of the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) called Ibn Abi al-Jadʿa', who said: I heard the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) say: «More people than Banu Tamim will enter Paradise through the intercession of one man from my community.»

hadiths.ar: 1380 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ ، عَنْ عَطِيَّةَ الْقُرَظِيِّ ، قَالَ: «كُنْتُ فِي سَبْيِ قُرَيْظَةَ، فَأَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَنْ أَنْبَتَ أَنْ يُقْتَلَ، فَكُنْتُ فِيمَنْ لَمْ يُنْبِتْ فَتُرِكْتُ».
hadiths.en: 1380 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿUmayr, from ʿAṭiyya al-Quraẓī, who said: “I was among the captives of Banū Quraẓa, and the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, commanded that whoever had grown pubic hair be killed. I was among those who had not grown any, so I was left alone.”
en_alternates: 1380 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿUmayr, from ʿAtiyya al-Qurazi, who said: «I was among the captives of Qurayza, and the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) commanded that whoever had grown pubic hair be killed; I was among those who had not, so I was left alone.»

hadiths.ar: 1381 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبَانَ ، عَنِ السُّدِّيِّ ، عَنْ رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ شَدَّادٍ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَمِقِ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «إِذَا أَمَّنَ الرَّجُلُ الرَّجُلَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ ثُمَّ قَتَلَهُ فَأَنَا بَرِيءٌ مِنَ الْقَاتِلِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ الْمَقْتُولُ كَافِرًا».
hadiths.en: 1381 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Muḥammad ibn Abān narrated to us, from al-Suddī, from Rifāʿa ibn Shaddād, who said: ʿAmr ibn al-Ḥamiq narrated to me that the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, said: “When a man grants another man security for his life and then kills him, I am free of the killer, even if the one killed was a disbeliever.”

hadiths.ar: 1382 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا قُرَّةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ ، عَنْ رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ شَدَّادٍ ، قَالَ: «كُنْتُ أَبْطَنَ شَيْءٍ بِالْمُخْتَارِ - يَعْنِي الْكَذَّابَ، قَالَ: فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ فَقَالَ: دَخَلْتَ وَقَدْ قَامَ جِبْرِيلُ قَبْلُ مِنْ هَذَا الْكُرْسِيِّ، قَالَ: فَأَهْوَيْتُ إِلَى قَائِمِ سَيْفِي فَقُلْتُ: مَا أَنْتَظِرُ أَنْ أَمْشِيَ بَيْنَ رَأْسِ هَذَا وَجَسَدِهِ حَتَّى ذَكَرْتُ حَدِيثًا حَدَّثَنِيهِ عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَمِقِ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: إِذَا أَمَّنَ الرَّجُلُ الرَّجُلَ عَلَى دَمِهِ ثُمَّ قَتَلَهُ رُفِعَ لَهُ لِوَاءُ الْغَدْرِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ»، فَكَفَفْتُ عَنْهُ.
hadiths.en: 1382 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Qurra ibn Khālid narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿUmayr, from Rifāʿa ibn Shaddād, who said: “I was the closest of people to al-Mukhtār – meaning the liar. He said: I entered upon him one day and he said: You have entered just after Jibrīl got up from this seat. He said: So I reached for the hilt of my sword and said: I am only waiting to walk between this one's head and his body, when I remembered a hadith that ʿAmr ibn al-Ḥamiq narrated to me, that the Prophet, peace be upon him, said: When a man grants another man security for his blood and then kills him, a banner of treachery will be raised for him on the Day of Resurrection.” So I held back from him.

hadiths.ar: 1383 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عِمْرَانَ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبْزَى ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ: «صَلَّيْتُ خَلْفَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَكَانَ لَا يُتِمُّ التَّكْبِيرَ».
hadiths.en: 1383 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿImrān, from Ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abzā, from his father, who said: “I prayed behind the Prophet, peace be upon him, and he would not complete the takbīr.”
en_alternates: Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from al-Hasan ibn ʿImran, from the son of ʿAbd al-Rahman ibn Abza, from his father, who said: «I prayed behind the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him), and he would not complete the takbīr.»

sections.title_ar: سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ صُرَدٍ وَخَالِدُ بْنُ عُرْفُطَةَ .
sections.title_en: Sulayman ibn Surad and Khalid ibn ʿUrfuta.

hadiths.ar: 1384 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي جَامِعُ بْنُ شَدَّادٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ ، قَالَ: «كُنْتُ جَالِسًا عِنْدَ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ صُرَدٍ وَخَالِدِ بْنِ عُرْفُطَةَ فَذَكَرَا رَجُلًا مَاتَ فِي بَطْنِهِ وَأَحَبَّا أَنْ يَحْضُرَا جِنَازَتَهُ، فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا لِلْآخَرِ: أَلَمْ يَقُلْ - أَوْ أَلَمْ تَسْمَعْ  رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: إِنَّ الَّذِي يَقْتُلُهُ بَطْنُهُ لَنْ يُعَذَّبَ فِي قَبْرِهِ؟ فَقَالَ الْآخَرُ: بَلَى».
hadiths.en: 1384 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, he said: Jamiʿ ibn Shaddad informed me, from ʿAbd Allah ibn Yasar, who said: «I was sitting with Sulayman ibn Surad and Khalid ibn ʿUrfuta, and they mentioned a man who had died of a stomach ailment, and they wished to attend his funeral. One of them said to the other: Did he not say – or: Did you not hear the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) say: The one whom his stomach kills will not be punished in his grave? The other said: Yes indeed.»

hadiths.ar: 1385 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ صُرَدٍ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم «قَالَ يَوْمَ الْأَحْزَابِ: الْآنَ نَغْزُوهُمْ وَلَا يَغْزُونَا».
hadiths.en: 1385 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, who said: I heard Sulayman ibn Surad say that the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) «said on the day of al-Ahzab: Now we will raid them, and they will not raid us.»

hadiths.ar: 1386 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ ، عَنْ كُرْزِ بْنِ عَلْقَمَةَ ، قَالَ: «قَالَ رَجُلٌ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، هَلْ لِلْإِسْلَامِ مِنْ مُدَّةٍ أَوْ مُنْتَهًى يَنْتَهِي إِلَيْهِ؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ، وَايْمُ اللهِ مَا مِنْ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍ مِنَ الْعَرَبِ وَالْعَجَمِ أَرَادَ اللهُ بِهِمْ خَيْرًا إِلَّا أَدْخَلَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْإِسْلَامَ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ مَهْ؟ قَالَ: ثُمَّ تَقَعُ الْفِتَنُ كَأَنَّهَا الظُّلَمُ، فَقَالَ الرَّجُلُ: كَلَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللهُ، فَقَالَ: بَلَى، وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ تَعُودُونَ أَسَاوِدَ صُبًّا يَضْرِبُ بَعْضُكُمْ رِقَابَ بَعْضٍ».
hadiths.en: 1386 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwa ibn al-Zubayr, from Kurz ibn ʿAlqama, who said: “A man said: O Messenger of God, does Islam have a term or an end to which it comes? He said: Yes; by God, there is no household of the Arabs or non-Arabs for whom God wills good except that He brings Islam into them. He said: Then what? He said: Then trials will occur like patches of darkness. The man said: Never, God willing! He said: Yes, by the One in whose hand is my soul, you will return as pouring black serpents, striking one another's necks.”
en_alternates: 1386 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Sufyan ibn ʿUyayna narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from ʿUrwa ibn al-Zubayr, from Kurz ibn ʿAlqama, who said: «A man said: O Messenger of God, does Islam have a term or an end to which it comes? He said: Yes, by God, there is no household of the Arabs or non-Arabs for whom God wills good except that He brings Islam into it. He said: Then what? He said: Then trials will occur like patches of darkness. The man said: Never, God willing. He said: Indeed, by the One in whose hand is my soul, you will return as serpents poured out, striking one another's necks.»

hadiths.ar: 1387 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ الدَّسْتُوَائِيُّ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ ، عَنْ هِلَالِ بْنِ أَبِي مَيْمُونَةَ ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ ، عَنْ رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ عَرَابَةَ الْجُهَنِيِّ ، قَالَ: «كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى إِذَا كُنَّا بِالْكَدِيدِ أَوْ قَالَ: بِقُدَيْدٍ جَعَلَ رِجَالٌ مِنَّا يَسْتَأْذِنُونَ إِلَى أَهْلِيهِمْ فَيَأْذَنُ لَهُمْ، فَحَمِدَ اللهَ وَقَالَ خَيْرًا، ثُمَّ قَالَ: مَا بَالُ شِقِّ الشَّجَرَةِ الَّتِي تَلِي رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَبْغَضُ إِلَيْكُمْ مِنَ الشِّقِّ الْآخَرِ، فَلَمْ تَرَ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ إِلَّا بَاكِيًا، فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، إِنَّ الَّذِي يَسْتَأْذِنُكَ بَعْدَ هَذَا لَسَفِيهٌ. قَالَ: فَحَمِدَ اللهَ وَقَالَ خَيْرًا، وَقَالَ: أَشْهَدُ عِنْدَ اللهِ لَا يَمُوتُ عَبْدٌ يَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ  وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللهِ صِدْقًا مِنْ قَلْبِهِ ثُمَّ يُسَدِّدُ إِلَّا سُلِكَ فِي الْجَنَّةِ، وَقَالَ: وَعَدَنِي رَبِّي أَنْ يُدْخِلَ الْجَنَّةَ مِنْ أُمَّتِي سَبْعِينَ أَلْفًا لَا حِسَابَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا عَذَابَ، وَإِنِّي لَأَرْجُو أَنْ لَا يَدْخُلُوهَا حَتَّى تَبَوَّءُوا أَنْتُمْ وَمَنْ صَلَحَ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ وَذَرَارِيِّكُمْ مَسَاكِنَ فِي الْجَنَّةِ».
hadiths.en: 1387 - Yunus narrated to us, saying: Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Hisham al-Dastuwa'i narrated to us, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from Hilal ibn Abi Maymuna, from 'Ata' ibn Yasar, from Rifa'a ibn 'Araba al-Juhani, who said: "We were with the Messenger of God ﷺ until, when we were at al-Kadid — or he said: at Qudayd — some of the men began asking permission to go to their families, and he gave them permission. Then he praised God and spoke well, and said: 'What is the matter with the side of the tree nearest the Messenger of God ﷺ, that it is more hateful to you than the other side?' At that you could see nothing among the people but weeping. A man said: 'O Messenger of God, whoever asks your permission after this is a fool.' He praised God and spoke well, and said: 'I bear witness before God that no servant who testifies that there is no god but God and that Muhammad is the Messenger of God, truthfully from his heart, and then stays upright, dies except that he will be admitted into Paradise.' And he said: 'My Lord has promised me that He will admit seventy thousand of my community to Paradise with no reckoning or punishment against them. And I hope they will not enter it until you and those of your wives and offspring who are righteous have taken up your dwellings in Paradise.'"

hadiths.ar: 1388 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى ، عَنْ هِلَالِ بْنِ أَبِي مَيْمُونَةَ ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ ، عَنْ رِفَاعَةَ الْجُهَنِيِّ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِذَا مَضَى ثُلُثُ اللَّيْلِ - أَوْ قَالَ: ثُلُثَا اللَّيْلِ - يَنْزِلُ اللهُ عز وجل إِلَى سَمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا وَقَالَ: لَا أَسْأَلُ عَنْ عِبَادِي أَحَدًا غَيْرِي، مَنْ  ذَا الَّذِي يَسْتَغْفِرُنِي أَغْفِرُ لَهُ؟ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَدْعُونِي أَسْتَجِيبُ لَهُ؟ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَسْأَلُنِي أُعْطِهِ؟ حَتَّى يَطْلُعَ الْفَجْرُ».
hadiths.en: 1388 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Hisham narrated to us, from Yahya, from Hilal ibn Abi Maymuna, from 'Ata' ibn Yasar, from Rifa'a al-Juhani, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "When a third of the night has passed — or he said: two thirds of the night — God, Mighty and Majestic, descends to the lowest heaven and says: 'None asks about My servants but Me. Who is it who seeks My forgiveness that I may forgive him? Who is it who calls upon Me that I may answer him? Who is it who asks of Me that I may give him?' until the dawn rises."

hadiths.ar: 1389 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عُكَيْمٍ ، قَالَ: «قُرِئَ عَلَيْنَا كِتَابُ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَنَحْنُ بِأَرْضِ جُهَيْنَةَ أَنْ لَا تَسْتَمْتِعُوا مِنَ الْمَيْتَةِ بِشَيْءٍ، إِهَابٍ وَلَا عَصَبٍ».
hadiths.en: 1389 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from al-Ḥakam, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Laylā, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUkaym, who said: “The letter of the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, was read to us while we were in the land of Juhayna, (stating) that you are not to make use of anything from carrion, neither hide nor sinew.”
en_alternates: 1389 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from al-Hakam, from ʿAbd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla, from ʿAbd Allah ibn ʿUkaym, who said: «The letter of the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) was read to us while we were in the land of Juhayna: that you are not to benefit from carrion in anything, neither hide nor sinew.»

hadiths.ar: 1390 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْمُثَنَّى  بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ ، عَنْ أَبِي مُسْلِمٍ الْجَذْمِيِّ ، عَنِ الْجَارُودِ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «ضَالَّةُ الْمُسْلِمِ حَرَقُ النَّارِ».
hadiths.en: 1390 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: al-Muthannā ⦗p. 625⦘ ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Qatāda, from Yazīd ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Shikhkhīr, from Abū Muslim al-Jadhmī, from al-Jārūd, who said: The Messenger of God, peace be upon him, said: “A stray animal of a Muslim is a flame of Hellfire.”
en_alternates: 1390 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: al-Muthanna ibn Saʿid narrated to us, from Qatada, from Yazid ibn ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Shikhkhir, from Abu Muslim al-Jadhmi, from al-Jarud, who said: The Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) said: «The stray animal of a Muslim is a blaze of Fire (i.e., taking it for oneself leads to the Fire).»

hadiths.ar: 1391 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو  عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ ، عَنْ رَجَاءٍ ، عَنْ مِحْجَنٍ ، قَالَ: «أَخَذَ مِحْجَنٌ بِيَدِي حَتَّى انْتَهَيْنَا إِلَى مَسْجِدِ الْبَصْرَةِ، فَإِذَا بُرَيْدَةُ الْأَسْلَمِيُّ قَاعِدٌ عَلَى بَابٍ مِنْ أَبْوَابِ الْمَسْجِدِ، وَفِي الْمَسْجِدِ رَجُلٌ يُقَالُ لَهُ سُكْبَةُ يُطِيلُ الصَّلَاةَ، قَالَ: وَكَانَ فِي بُرَيْدَةَ مُزَاحَةٌ، قَالَ بُرَيْدَةُ: يَا مِحْجَنُ، أَلَا تُصَلِّي كَمَا يُصَلِّي سُكْبَةُ؟ فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ مِحْجَنٌ شَيْئًا، وَقَالَ لِي مِحْجَنٌ: أَخَذَ بِيَدِي رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى صَعِدْنَا أُحُدًا فَأَشْرَفَ عَلَى الْمَدِينَةِ وَقَالَ: وَيْلٌ لِأُمِّهَا مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ يَدَعُهَا أَهْلُهَا أَعْمَرَ مَا كَانَتْ، يَجِيءُ الدَّجَّالُ فَيَجِدُ عَلَى كُلِّ بَابٍ مِنْهَا مَلَكًا مُصْلِتًا فَلَا يَدْخُلُهَا».
hadiths.en: 1391 - Yunus narrated to us, saying: Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Abu 'Awana narrated to us, from Abu Bishr, from 'Abd Allah ibn Shaqiq, from Raja', from Mihjan, who said: "Mihjan took me by the hand until we reached the mosque of Basra. There was Buraydah al-Aslami sitting at one of the mosque's doors, and in the mosque was a man called Sukba who prolonged his prayer. Buraydah had a playful streak. Buraydah said: 'O Mihjan, will you not pray as Sukba prays?' Mihjan did not reply to him at all, and said to me: 'The Messenger of God ﷺ took me by the hand until we climbed Uhud and he looked out over Medina and said: Woe to its mother, a town its people will leave at its most flourishing! The Dajjal will come and find on every one of its gates an angel with drawn sword, so he will not enter it.'"

hadiths.ar: 1392 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ ، عَنْ رَجَاءٍ ، عَنْ مِحْجَنٍ ، قَالَ: «أَخَذَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِي حَتَّى انْتَهَيْنَا إِلَى سُدَّةِ الْمَسْجِدِ، فَإِذَا رَجُلٌ يَرْكَعُ وَيَسْجُدُ وَيَرْكَعُ وَيَسْجُدُ، فَقَالَ لِي: مَنْ هَذَا؟، فَقُلْتُ: هَذَا فُلَانٌ، فَجَعَلْتُ أُطْرِيهِ وَأَقُولُ: هَذَا هَذَا! فَقَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: لَا تُسْمِعْهُ فَتُهْلِكَهُ، ثُمَّ انْطَلَقَ بِي حَتَّى بَلَغَ بَابَ حُجْرَةٍ، ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَ يَدَهُ مِنْ يَدِي فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: خَيْرُ دِينِكُمْ أَيْسَرُهُ، قَالَهَا ثَلَاثًا».
hadiths.en: 1392 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Abu 'Awana narrated to us, from Abu Bishr, from 'Abd Allah ibn Shaqiq, from Raja', from Mihjan, who said: "The Messenger of God ﷺ took me by the hand until we reached the portico of the mosque, where a man was bowing and prostrating, bowing and prostrating. He said to me: 'Who is this?' I said: 'This is so-and-so,' and I began to praise him, saying: 'He is such and such!' The Messenger of God ﷺ said to me: 'Do not let him hear you, lest you destroy him.' Then he walked with me until he reached the door of a chamber, then released his hand from mine and said: 'The best of your religion is its easiest,' saying it three times."

hadiths.ar: 1393 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِمْرٍ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عَائِذَ بْنَ عَمْرٍو الْمُزَنِيَّ صَاحِبَ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الدُّبَّاءِ وَالْحَنْتَمِ وَالنَّقِيرِ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ»، قَالَ: قُلْتُ: أَعَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم؟ فَقَالَ: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم.
hadiths.en: 1393 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, he said: Abū Shimr narrated to us, he said: I heard ʿĀʾidh ibn ʿAmr al-Muzanī, a Companion of the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, say: “The Messenger of God, peace be upon him, forbade (the use of) the gourd (dubbāʾ), the green jar (ḥantam), the hollowed palm-trunk (naqīr), and the pitch-coated vessel (muzaffat).” He said: I said: Was it from the Prophet, peace be upon him? He said: From the Prophet, peace be upon him.
en_alternates: 1393 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, he said: Abu Shimr narrated to us, he said: I heard ʿAʾidh ibn ʿAmr al-Muzani, a Companion of the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him), say: «The Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) forbade the dubbāʾ, the ḥantam, the naqīr and the muzaffat» (types of vessels used for fermenting drinks). He said: I said: From the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him)? He said: From the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him).

hadiths.ar: 1394 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ ، قَالَ: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ، فَرَأَى أَبِي فِي الشَّمْسِ فَأَمَرَهُ - أَوْ أَوْمَأَ إِلَيْهِ - أَنِ ادْنُ إِلَى الظِّلِّ».
hadiths.en: 1394 - Yūnus narrated to us, Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Ismāʿīl ibn Abī Khālid, from Qays ibn Abī Ḥāzim, who said: “The Messenger of God, peace be upon him, was delivering a sermon, and he saw my father standing in the sun, so he commanded him – or gestured to him – to come closer to the shade.”
en_alternates: 1394 - Yunus narrated to us; Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Ismaʿil ibn Abi Khalid, from Qays ibn Abi Hazim, who said: «The Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) was delivering a sermon, and he saw my father in the sun, so he commanded him – or gestured to him – to move closer to the shade.»

hadiths.ar: 1395 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ ، سَمِعَ نَافِعَ بْنَ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ ، عَنْ بِشْرِ بْنِ سُحَيْمٍ «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَهُ أَنْ يُنَادِيَ بِمِنًى أَنْ: لَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ إِلَّا نَفْسٌ مُسْلِمَةٌ، وَأَنَّ هَذِهِ أَيَّامُ أَكْلٍ وَشُرْبٍ».
hadiths.en: 1395 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Ḥabīb ibn Abī Thābit, who heard Nāfiʿ ibn Jubayr ibn Muṭʿim, from Bishr ibn Suḥaym: “that the Prophet, peace be upon him, commanded him to announce at Minā that none will enter Paradise except a Muslim soul, and that these are days of eating and drinking.”
en_alternates: 1395 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Habib ibn Abi Thabit, who heard Nafiʿ ibn Jubayr ibn Mutʿim, from Bishr ibn Suhaym: «that the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) commanded him to proclaim at Mina that: Only a Muslim soul will enter Paradise, and these are days of eating and drinking.»

hadiths.ar: 1396 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ التَّمِيمِيُّ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْقُرَشِيِّ «أَنَّ أَبَا حَدْرَدٍ اسْتَعَانَ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي نِكَاحٍ، فَقَالَ: كَمْ أَصْدَقْتَ؟، قَالَ: مِائَتَيْ دِرْهَمٍ، قَالَ: لَوْ كُنْتُمْ تَغْرِفُونَ مِنْ بُطْحَانَ مَا زِدْتُمْ».
hadiths.en: 1396 - Yūnus narrated to us, Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Zuhayr ibn Muḥammad al-Tamīmī narrated to us, from Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd al-Anṣārī, from Muḥammad ibn Ibrāhīm al-Qurashī: “that Abū Ḥadrad sought the help of the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, with a marriage, and he said: How much dowry did you give? He said: Two hundred dirhams. He said: Even if you were scooping from Buṭḥān (a valley) you would not give more.”
en_alternates: 1396 - Yunus narrated to us; Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Zuhayr ibn Muhammad al-Tamimi narrated to us, from Yahya ibn Saʿid al-Ansari, from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim al-Qurashi: «that Abu Hadrad asked the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) for help with a marriage, and he said: How much dowry did you give?
