hadiths.ar: 1724 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ ، عَنْ أُمِّ هَانِئٍ ، قَالَتْ: «مَا رَأَيْتُ بَطْنَ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَطُّ إِلَّا ذَكَرْتُ الْقَرَاطِيسَ الْمَثْنِيَّةَ بَعْضُهَا عَلَى بَعْضٍ».
hadiths.en: 1724 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shayban narrated to us, from Jabir, from Abu Salih, from Umm Hani', who said: "I never saw the belly of the Messenger of God ﷺ without being reminded of sheets of paper folded one upon another."

hadiths.ar: 1725 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ مُرَّةَ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي لَيْلَى ، يَقُولُ: «مَا أَخْبَرَنِي أَحَدٌ أَنَّهُ رَأَى رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي الضُّحَى غَيْرَ أُمِّ هَانِئٍ ، فَإِنَّهَا حَدَّثَتْ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ بَيْتَهَا يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ، فَاغْتَسَلَ، وَصَلَّى ثَمَانِ رَكَعَاتٍ، مَا رَأَيْتُهُ صَلَّى صَلَاةً قَطُّ أَخَفَّ مِنْهَا، غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُتِمُّ الرُّكُوعَ وَالسُّجُودَ».
hadiths.en: 1725 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shu'ba narrated to us, saying: 'Amr ibn Murra informed me, saying: I heard Ibn Abi Layla say: "No one told me that he saw the Messenger of God ﷺ pray the forenoon prayer except Umm Hani', for she narrated that the Prophet ﷺ entered her house on the day of the conquest of Mecca, bathed, and prayed eight rak'as; I never saw him pray a lighter prayer than it, except that he completed the bowing and prostration."

sections.title_ar: مَا رَوَتْ أُمَيْمَةُ بِنْتُ رُقَيْقَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
sections.title_en: What Umayma bint Ruqayqa narrated from the Prophet, peace be upon him
title_en_alternates: What Umayma bint Ruqayqa narrated from the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him)

hadiths.ar: 1726 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا وَرْقَاءُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْيَشْكُرِيُّ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُنْكَدِرِ ، عَنْ أُمَيْمَةَ بِنْتِ رُقَيْقَةَ ، قَالَتْ: «كُنْتُ فِيمَنْ بَايَعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَأَخَذَ عَلَيْنَا أَنْ لَا نَسْرِقَ، الْآيَةَ كُلَّهَا، فَقُلْنَا: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، بَايِعْنَا، فَقَالَ: إِنِّي لَا أُصَافِحُ النِّسَاءَ، وَقَوْلِي لِامْرَأَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ كَقَوْلِي لِمِائَةِ امْرَأَةٍ».
hadiths.en: 1726 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Warqāʾ ibn ʿUmar al-Yashkurī narrated to us, he said: Muḥammad ibn al-Munkadir narrated to us, from Umayma bint Ruqayqa, who said: “I was among those who pledged allegiance to the Prophet, peace be upon him. He took from us (the pledge) that we would not steal – the whole verse. We said: O Messenger of God, take our pledge. He said: I do not shake hands with women; my word to one woman is like my word to a hundred women.”
en_alternates: 1726 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Warqaʾ ibn ʿUmar al-Yashkuri narrated to us, he said: Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir narrated to us, from Umayma bint Ruqayqa, who said: «I was among those who pledged allegiance to the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him); he took from us the pledge that we would not steal – the whole verse – and we said: O Messenger of God, take our pledge! He said: I do not shake hands with women; my word to one woman is like my word to a hundred women.»

sections.title_ar: وَأُخْتُ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ رَوَاحَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
sections.title_en: And the sister of ʿAbd Allāh ibn Rawāḥa, from the Prophet, peace be upon him
title_en_alternates: And the sister of ʿAbd Allah ibn Rawaha, on the authority of the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him)

hadiths.ar: 1727 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ الْيَامِيِّ ، عَنِ امْرَأَةٍ مِنْ عَبْدِ الْقَيْسِ ، عَنْ أُخْتِ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ رَوَاحَةَ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «وَجَبَ الْخُرُوجُ عَلَى كُلِّ ذَاتِ نِطَاقٍ» يَعْنِي فِي الْعِيدَيْنِ.
hadiths.en: 1727 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn al-Nuʿmān, from Ṭalḥa al-Yāmī, from a woman of ʿAbd al-Qays, from the sister of ʿAbd Allāh ibn Rawāḥa, from the Prophet, peace be upon him, who said: “Going out is obligatory upon every woman who wears a waist-wrapper (dhāt niṭāq),” meaning for the two Eids.
en_alternates: 1727 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn al-Nuʿman, from Talha al-Yami, from a woman of ʿAbd al-Qays, from the sister of ʿAbd Allah ibn Rawaha, from the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him), who said: «Going out is obligatory upon every woman who wears a waist-wrapper (niṭāq)» – meaning on the two festivals (ʿīds).

sections.title_ar: وَمَا رَوَتْ جُوَيْرِيَةُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
sections.title_en: And what Juwayriyya narrated from the Prophet, peace be upon him
title_en_alternates: And what Juwayriya narrated from the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him)

hadiths.ar: 1728 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، سَمِعَ أَبَا أَيُّوبَ ، عَنْ جُوَيْرِيَةَ ، «أَنَّهُ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ جُمُعَةٍ وَهِيَ صَائِمَةٌ، فَقَالَ: صُمْتِ أَمْسِ؟ قَالَتْ: لَا، قَالَ: تَصُومِينَ غَدًا؟ قَالَتْ: لَا، قَالَ: فَأَفْطِرِي».
hadiths.en: 1728 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Qatāda, who heard Abū Ayyūb, from Juwayriyya: “that the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, entered upon her on a Friday while she was fasting, and said: Did you fast yesterday? She said: No. He said: Will you fast tomorrow? She said: No. He said: Then break your fast.”
en_alternates: 1728 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Qatada, who heard Abu Ayyub, from Juwayriya: «that the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) entered upon her on a Friday while she was fasting, and said: Did you fast yesterday? She said: No. He said: Will you fast tomorrow? She said: No. He said: Then break your fast.»

sections.title_ar: وَمَا رَوَتِ الرُّبَيِّعُ بِنْتُ مُعَوِّذٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
sections.title_en: And what al-Rubayyiʿ bint Muʿawwidh narrated from the Prophet, peace be upon him
title_en_alternates: And what al-Rubayyiʿ bint Muʿawwidh narrated from the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him)

hadiths.ar: 1729 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ ، قَالَ: «أَرْسَلَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ إِلَى الرُّبَيِّعِ بِنْتِ مُعَوِّذٍ ؛ أَسْأَلُهَا، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ كَثِيرًا مَا يَتَوَضَّأُ عِنْدَهُمْ، فَأَتَيْتُهَا، فَسَأَلْتُهَا، فَقَالَتْ: رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَوَضَّأُ، فَأَخَذَ لِرَأْسِهِ مَاءً جَدِيدًا».
hadiths.en: 1729 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Qays ibn al-Rabīʿ narrated to us, he said: ʿAbd Allāh ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAqīl narrated to us, he said: “ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn sent me to al-Rubayyiʿ bint Muʿawwidh to ask her – for the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, used to perform ablution often at their house. So I came to her and asked her, and she said: I saw the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, perform ablution, and he took fresh water for his head.”
en_alternates: 1729 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Qays ibn al-Rabiʿ narrated to us, he said: ʿAbd Allah ibn Muhammad ibn ʿAqil narrated to us, he said: «ʿAli ibn al-Husayn sent me to al-Rubayyiʿ bint Muʿawwidh to ask her – since the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) often used to perform ablution at their house. I came to her and asked her, and she said: I saw the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) performing ablution, and he took fresh water for his head.»

sections.title_ar: وَمَا رَوَتْ مَيْمُونَةُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
sections.title_en: And What Maymuna Narrated from the Prophet ﷺ

hadiths.ar: 1730 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ بِنْتِ الْحَارِثِ ، «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم اغْتَسَلَ - أَوْ قَالَتْ: تَوَضَّأَ - بِفَضْلِ غُسْلِهَا مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ».
hadiths.en: 1730 - Yunus narrated to us, saying: Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Sharik narrated to us, from Simak ibn Harb, from 'Ikrima, from Ibn 'Abbas, from Maymuna bint al-Harith, "that the Messenger of God ﷺ bathed — or she said: performed ablution — with the water left over from her bath after sexual impurity."

hadiths.ar: 1731 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ شَدَّادِ بْنِ الْهَادِ ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «كَانَ يُصَلِّي عَلَى الْخُمْرَةِ».
hadiths.en: 1731 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shu'ba narrated to us, from Sulayman al-Shaybani, from 'Abd Allah ibn Shaddad ibn al-Had, from Maymuna, that the Messenger of God ﷺ "used to pray on a small mat."

hadiths.ar: 1732 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ ، قَالَ:  «قُلْتُ لِمِقْسَمٍ : إِنِّي أُوتِرُ بِثَلَاثٍ، ثُمَّ أَخْرُجُ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ مَخَافَةَ أَنْ تَفُوتَنِي، فَقَالَ: لَا يَصْلُحُ الْوِتْرُ إِلَّا بِخَمْسٍ أَوْ سَبْعٍ» فَأَخْبَرَتْ بِهِ مُجَاهِدًا وَيَحْيَى بْنَ الْجَزَّارِ، فَقَالَا لِي: سَلْهُ عَمَّنْ؟ فَسَأَلْتُهُ، فَقَالَ: عَنِ الثِّقَةِ ، عَنِ الثِّقَةِ ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ وَعَائِشَةَ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم.
hadiths.en: 1732 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shu'ba narrated to us, from al-Hakam, who said: "I said to Miqsam: 'I pray the witr as three rak'as, and then go out to the prayer for fear that I might miss it.' He said: 'The witr is valid only as five or seven.'" I told Mujahid and Yahya ibn al-Jazzar about it, and they said to me: "Ask him from whom." I asked him, and he said: "From the trustworthy, from the trustworthy, from Maymuna and 'A'isha, from the Prophet ﷺ."

hadiths.ar: 1733 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ ، «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم اغْتَسَلَ عِنْدَهَا، فَأَتَتْهُ بِمِنْدِيلٍ فَرَمَى بِهِ». قَالَ الْأَعْمَشُ : فَذَكَرْتُهُ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ ، فَقَالَ: الْحَدِيثُ هَكَذَا، وَلَا بَأْسَ  بِالْمَسْحِ بِالْمِنْدِيلِ، إِنَّمَا هُوَ عَادَةٌ.
hadiths.en: 1733 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Abu 'Awana narrated to us, from al-A'mash, from Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd, from Kurayb, from Ibn 'Abbas, from Maymuna, "that the Prophet ﷺ bathed at her place, and she brought him a towel, but he threw it aside." Al-A'mash said: I mentioned it to Ibrahim and he said: "The hadith is as such, but there is no harm in wiping with a towel; that was only a habit."

hadiths.ar: 1734 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم «كَانَ إِذَا اغْتَسَلَ تَنَحَّى مِنَ الْمُغْتَسَلِ فَغَسَلَ قَدَمَيْهِ».
hadiths.en: 1734 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, Abu 'Awana narrated to us, from al-A'mash, from Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd, from Kurayb, from Ibn 'Abbas, from Maymuna, that the Prophet ﷺ "when he bathed, would step aside from the place of washing and wash his feet."

hadiths.ar: 1735 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ الْهُذَلِيُّ ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ شَدَّادٍ ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا خَرَجَ مِنْ بَيْتِي، رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ، فَقَالَ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَزِلَّ، أَوْ أَضِلَّ، أَوْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ، أَوْ أَجْهَلَ أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيَّ».
hadiths.en: 1735 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Abu Bakr al-Hudhali narrated to us, from 'Amir, from 'Abd Allah ibn Shaddad, from Maymuna, who said: "When the Messenger of God ﷺ went out of my house, he would raise his head to the sky and say: 'O God, I seek refuge in You from slipping or going astray, from wronging or being wronged, from acting ignorantly or having ignorance directed at me.'"

sections.title_ar: مَا رَوَتْ أَسْمَاءُ بِنْتُ يَزِيدَ الْأَنْصَارِيَّةُ ، رضي الله عنها، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
sections.title_en: What Asma' bint Yazid al-Ansariyya, may God be pleased with her, Narrated from the Prophet ﷺ

hadiths.ar: 1736 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ يَزِيدَ الْأَنْصَارِيَّةِ ، قَالَتْ: «سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ: {إِنَّهُ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَالِحٍ}».
hadiths.en: 1736 - Yunus narrated to us, saying: Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama narrated to us, from Thabit, from Shahr ibn Hawshab, from Asma' bint Yazid al-Ansariyya, who said: "I heard the Prophet ﷺ recite: {Indeed, he is one whose deed is not righteous}."

hadiths.ar: 1737 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، وَخَارِجَةُ ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللهِ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ ، عَنْ شَهْرٍ ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ ، قَالَتْ: سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «مَنْ ذَبَّ عَنْ لَحْمِ أَخِيهِ بِالْمَغِيبَةِ، كَانَ حَقًّا عَلَى اللهِ أَنْ يُعْتِقَهُ مِنَ النَّارِ».
hadiths.en: 1737 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: 'Abd Allah ibn al-Mubarak and Kharija narrated to us, from 'Ubayd Allah ibn Abi Ziyad, from Shahr, from Asma', who said: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: "Whoever defends the honor of his brother in his absence, it is a right upon God to free him from the Fire."

hadiths.ar: 1738 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ شَهْرٍ ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ ، قَالَتْ: «ذَكَرَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الدَّجَّالَ فَقَالَ: إِنَّ قَبْلَ خُرُوجِهِ عَامًا تُمْسِكُ السَّمَاءُ ثُلُثَ قَطْرِهَا، وَالْأَرْضُ ثُلُثَ نَبَاتِهَا، وَالْعَامُ الثَّانِي تُمْسِكُ السَّمَاءُ ثُلُثَيْ قَطْرِهَا، وَالْأَرْضُ ثُلُثَيْ نَبَاتِهَا، وَالْعَامُ الثَّالِثُ تُمْسِكُ السَّمَاءُ قَطْرَهَا وَالْأَرْضُ نَبَاتَهَا، حَتَّى لَا يَبْقَى ذَاتُ ضِرْسٍ، وَلَا ذَاتُ ظِلْفٍ، وَإِنَّ مِنْ أَكْبَرِ فِتْنَتِهِ أَنْ يَقُولَ لِلرَّجُلِ: إِنْ أَحْيَيْتُ لَكَ أُمَّكَ وَأَبَاكَ، أَتَعْلَمُ أَنِّي رَبُّكَ؟ فَيَتَمَثَّلُ لَهُمُ الشَّيَاطِينُ. ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ لِبَعْضِ حَاجَتِهِ، فَجَاءَ وَأَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ يَبْكُونَ، فَأَخَذَ بِعِضَادَتَيِ الْبَابِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: مَهْيَمْ؟ قَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، ذَكَرْتَ الدَّجَّالَ، فَوَاللهِ إِنَّ أَحَدَنَا لَيَعْجِنُ عَجِينَهُ فَمَا يَخْتَبِزُ حَتَّى يَخْشَى أَنْ يَفْتَتِنَ، وَأَنْتَ تَقُولُ: الْأَطْعِمَةُ تُزْوَى إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:  إِنَّهُ يَكْفِي الْمُؤْمِنَ يَوْمَئِذٍ مَا يَكْفِي الْمَلَائِكَةَ قَالُوا: فَإِنَّ الْمَلَائِكَةَ لَا تَأْكُلُ وَلَا تَشْرَبُ، وَلَكِنَّهَا تُقَدِّسُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: طَعَامُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍ التَّسْبِيحُ، فَإِنْ يَخْرُجْ وَأَنَا فِيكُمْ، فَأَنَا حَجِيجُهُ، وَإِنْ يَخْرُجْ بَعْدِي، فَاللهُ خَلِيفَتِي عَلَى كُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ».
hadiths.en: 1738 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Hisham narrated to us, from Qatada, from Shahr, from Asma', who said: "The Messenger of God ﷺ mentioned the Dajjal and said: 'In the year before his emergence, the sky will withhold a third of its rain and the earth a third of its vegetation. In the second year the sky will withhold two thirds of its rain and the earth two thirds of its vegetation. In the third year the sky will withhold all its rain and the earth all its vegetation, until no creature with molars or cloven hooves remains. Among the greatest of his trials is that he will say to a man: If I bring your mother and father back to life, will you know that I am your Lord? And devils will take their shape for them.' Then the Messenger of God ﷺ went out on some errand, and came back while the household was weeping. He took hold of the two doorposts and said: 'What is the matter?' They said: 'O Messenger of God, you mentioned the Dajjal. By God, one of us kneads his dough and does not get to bake it for fear of being tempted, and you say that food will be gathered to him.' The Messenger of God ﷺ said: 'On that day what suffices the angels will suffice the believer.' They said: 'But the angels neither eat nor drink; they glorify.' The Messenger of God ﷺ said: 'The food of the believers on that day will be glorification. If he emerges while I am among you, I will be his adversary; and if he emerges after me, God is my successor over every Muslim.'"

sections.title_ar: مَا رَوَتْ أُمُّ كُرْزٍ الْكَعْبِيَّةُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
sections.title_en: What Umm Kurz al-Kaʿbiyya narrated from the Prophet, peace be upon him
title_en_alternates: What Umm Kurz al-Kaʿbiyya narrated from the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him)

hadiths.ar: 1739 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ الْمَكِّيِّ ، عَنْ سِبَاعِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أُمِّ كُرْزٍ الْكَعْبِيَّةِ ، قَالَتْ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «أَقِرُّوا الطَّيْرَ عَلَى مَكِنَاتِهَا» قَالَ: يَعْنِي الطِّيَرَةَ.
hadiths.en: 1739 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Abī Yazīd al-Makkī, from Sibāʿ ibn Thābit, from Umm Kurz al-Kaʿbiyya, who said: I heard the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, say: “Leave the birds in their nesting places (makināt),” he said: meaning omens drawn from birds (ṭiyara).
en_alternates: 1739 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Sufyan ibn ʿUyayna narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allah ibn Abi Yazid al-Makki, from Sibaʿ ibn Thabit, from Umm Kurz al-Kaʿbiyya, who said: I heard the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) say: «Leave the birds in their nesting places» – he said: meaning omens drawn from birds (ṭiyara).

sections.title_ar: مَا رَوَتْ أُمُّ قَيْسٍ بِنْتُ مِحْصَنٍ الْأَنْصَارِيَّةُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
sections.title_en: What Umm Qays bint Mihsan al-Ansariyya Narrated from the Prophet ﷺ

hadiths.ar: 1740 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ الْمَدَنِيُّ، مَوْلَى نَافِعٍ مَوْلَى أُمِّ قَيْسٍ بِنْتِ مِحْصَنٍ الْأَسَدِيِّ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَتْنِي أُمُّ قَيْسٍ بِنْتُ مِحْصَنٍ قَالَتْ: «لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنِي وَرَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم آخِذٌ بِيَدِي فِي بَعْضِ سِكَكِ الْمَدِينَةِ، وَمَا فِيهَا بَيْتٌ، حَتَّى انْتَهَيْنَا  إِلَى بَقِيعِ الْغَرْقَدِ، فَقَالَ يَا أُمَّ قَيْسٍ فَقُلْتُ: لَبَّيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ وَسَعْدَيْكَ، قَالَ: تَرَيْنَ هَذِهِ الْمَقْبَرَةَ؟ قَالَتْ: نَعَمْ، يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، قَالَ: يُبْعَثُ مِنْهَا سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا، وُجُوهُهُمْ كَالْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ، يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ، فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، وَأَنَا؟ قَالَ وَأَنْتَ فَقَامَ آخَرُ، فَقَالَ: وَأَنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، قَالَ: سَبَقَكَ بِهَا عُكَّاشَةُ».
hadiths.en: 1740 - Yunus narrated to us, saying: Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Abu 'Asim al-Madani, the client of Nafi', the client of Umm Qays bint Mihsan al-Asadi, narrated to us, from Nafi', who said: Umm Qays bint Mihsan informed me, saying: "I remember the Messenger of God ﷺ taking me by the hand in one of the lanes of Medina, in which there was not a single house, until we reached Baqi' al-Gharqad. He said: 'O Umm Qays.' I said: 'At your service, O Messenger of God, ever at your command.' He said: 'Do you see this cemetery?' She said: 'Yes, O Messenger of God.' He said: 'Seventy thousand will be raised from it, their faces like the moon on the night of the full moon, entering Paradise without reckoning.' A man stood and said: 'O Messenger of God, and I?' He said: 'And you.' Another stood and said: 'And I, O Messenger of God?' He said: 'Ukkasha has beaten you to it.'"

hadiths.ar: 1741 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا زَمْعَةُ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ ، عَنْ أُمِّ قَيْسٍ ، أَنَّهَا أَخْبَرَتْهُ، «أَنَّ صَبِيًّا بَالَ فِي حِجْرِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَلَمْ يَبْلُغْ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ الطَّعَامَ، فَدَعَا رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَاءٍ فَنَضَحَهُ عَلَيْهِ، وَلَمْ يَغْسِلْهُ غَسْلًا».  قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ: فَمَضَتِ السُّنَّةُ أَنْ يُنْضَحَ بَوْلُ مَنْ لَمْ يَأْكُلْ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ مِنَ الصِّبْيَانِ، وَمَضَتِ السُّنَّةِ أَنْ يُغْسَلَ بَوْلُ مَنْ أَكَلَ الطَّعَامَ مِنَ الصِّبْيَانِ.
hadiths.en: 1741 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Zam'a narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from 'Ubayd Allah ibn 'Abd Allah, from Umm Qays, that she informed him: "A boy who had not yet reached the age of eating solid food urinated in the lap of the Prophet ﷺ. The Messenger of God ﷺ called for water and sprinkled it over the spot, and did not wash it thoroughly." Al-Zuhri said: "The Sunna has established that the urine of boys who have not eaten solid food is sprinkled, and the Sunna has established that the urine of boys who have eaten solid food is washed."

sections.title_ar: مَا رَوَتْ أَسْمَاءُ بِنْتُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
sections.title_en: What Asma' bint Abi Bakr Narrated from the Prophet ﷺ

hadiths.ar: 1742 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ الْقُرِّيِّ ، قَالَ: «دَخَلْنَا عَلَى أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ، فَسَأَلْنَاهَا عَنْ مُتْعَةِ النِّسَاءِ، فَقَالَتْ: فَعَلْنَاهَا عَلَى عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم».
hadiths.en: 1742 - Yunus narrated to us, saying: Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shu'ba narrated to us, from Muslim al-Qurri, who said: "We visited Asma' bint Abi Bakr and asked her about temporary marriage with women. She said: 'We did it in the time of the Prophet ﷺ.'"

hadiths.ar: 1743 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ الْمُنْذِرِ ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ، «أَنَّ امْرَأَةً سَأَلَتْ - يَعْنِي النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ دَمِ الْحَيْضِ يُصِيبُ الثَّوْبَ، فَقَالَ: تَقْرُصِيهِ بِالْمَاءِ، وَانْضَحِي مَا حَوْلَهُ».
hadiths.en: 1743 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama narrated to us, from Hisham ibn 'Urwa, from Fatima bint al-Mundhir, from Asma' bint Abi Bakr, "that a woman asked — meaning the Prophet ﷺ — about menstrual blood that gets on a garment. He said: 'Rub it with water and sprinkle what is around it.'"

hadiths.ar: 1744 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ ثَابِتِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، «أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ قُتَيْلَةَ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، وَهِيَ أُمُّ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ،  فَقَدِمَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ فِي الْمُدَّةِ الَّتِي كَانَتْ بَيْنَ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبَيْنَ كُفَّارِ قُرَيْشٍ، فَأَهْدَتْ إِلَى أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ قُرْطًا وَأَشْيَاءَ، فَكَرِهَتْ أَنْ تَقْبَلَ مِنْهَا، حَتَّى أَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللهُ عز وجل: {لا يَنْهَاكُمُ اللهُ عَنِ الَّذِينَ لَمْ يُقَاتِلُوكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ}».
hadiths.en: 1744 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Ibn al-Mubarak narrated to us, from Mus'ab ibn Thabit ibn 'Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr, from 'Amir ibn 'Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr, from his father, "that Abu Bakr divorced his wife Qutayla in the pre-Islamic period — she was the mother of Asma' bint Abi Bakr. She came to them during the period of the truce between the Messenger of God ﷺ and the disbelievers of Quraysh, and brought Asma' bint Abi Bakr a gift of an earring and other things. She disliked accepting from her until she came to the Messenger of God ﷺ and mentioned it to him. So God, Mighty and Majestic, revealed: {God does not forbid you from those who do not fight you because of religion}."

hadiths.ar: 1745 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَرْبُ بْنُ شَدَّادٍ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ ، أَنَّ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ أَخْبَرَهُ  أَنَّ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ أَخْبَرَتْهُ «أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ: لَيْسَ شَيْءٌ أَغْيَرَ مِنَ اللهِ عز وجل».
hadiths.en: 1745 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Harb ibn Shaddad narrated to us, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, who said: Abu Salama informed me that 'Urwa ibn al-Zubayr informed him that Asma' bint Abi Bakr informed him "that she heard the Prophet ﷺ say on the pulpit: 'Nothing is more jealous than God, Mighty and Majestic.'"

hadiths.ar: 1746 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْأَسْوَدُ بْنُ شَيْبَانَ ، عَنْ أَبِي نَوْفَلِ بْنِ أَبِي عَقْرَبٍ ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ، «أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ لِلْحَجَّاجِ: أَمَا إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَدَّثَنَا أَنَّ فِي ثَقِيفَ كَذَّابًا وَمُبِيرًا فَأَمَّا الْكَذَّابُ فَقَدْ رَأَيْنَاهُ، وَأَمَّا الْمُبِيرُ فَلَا إِخَالُكَ إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ».
hadiths.en: 1746 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: al-Aswad ibn Shayban narrated to us, from Abu Nawfal ibn Abi 'Aqrab, from Asma' bint Abi Bakr, "that she said to al-Hajjaj: 'The Messenger of God ﷺ told us that in Thaqif there would be a great liar and a destroyer. As for the liar, we have seen him; as for the destroyer, I think it is none other than you.'"

hadiths.ar: 1747 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا طَلْحَةُ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ، مَوْلَى أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ، «أَنَّ أَسْمَاءَ كَانَتْ تَقُولُ لِأَهْلِهَا لَيْلَةَ الْمُزْدَلِفَةِ: أَغَابَ الْقَمَرُ؟ أَغَابَ الْقَمَرُ؟ فَإِذَا قَالُوا: نَعَمْ، قَالَتْ: قُومُوا، هَكَذَا كَانَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَبْعَثُنَا».
hadiths.en: 1747 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Talha narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah, the freedman of Asma' bint Abi Bakr, "that Asma' used to say to her household on the night of Muzdalifa: 'Has the moon set? Has the moon set?' When they said: 'Yes,' she would say: 'Rise.' Thus did the Messenger of God ﷺ send us on."

hadiths.ar: 1748 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، أَنَّ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ، قَالَتْ: «يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، إِنَّ أُمِّي أَتَتْنِي فِي عَهْدِ قُرَيْشٍ، وَهِيَ رَاغِبَةٌ مُشْرِكَةٌ، أَفَأَصِلُهَا؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ، صِلِي أُمَّكِ».
hadiths.en: 1748 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi al-Zinad narrated to us, from Hisham ibn 'Urwa, from his father, that Asma' bint Abi Bakr said: "O Messenger of God, my mother came to me in the time of the treaty with Quraysh, wanting something from me, though she is a polytheist. Shall I maintain ties with her?' He said: 'Yes, maintain ties with your mother.'"

sections.title_ar: مَا رَوَتْ بِنْتُ حَارِثَةَ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم.
sections.title_en: What the daughter of Ḥāritha ibn al-Nuʿmān narrated from the Prophet, peace be upon him.
title_en_alternates: What the daughter of Haritha ibn al-Nuʿman narrated from the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him).

hadiths.ar: 1749 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ خُبَيْبٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَعْنٍ ، عَنْ بِنْتِ حَارِثَةَ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ ، قَالَتْ: «لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنَا وَتَنُّورُنَا وَتَنُّورُ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاحِدٌ، وَمَا أَخَذْتُ قاف - يَعْنِي سُورَةَ ق - إِلَّا مِنْ فِيِّ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يَخْطُبُ».
hadiths.en: 1749 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Khubayb, from Ibn Maʿn, from the daughter of Ḥāritha ibn al-Nuʿmān al-Anṣārī, who said: “I remember that our oven and the oven of the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, were one, and I only learned Qāf – meaning Sūrat Qāf – from the mouth of the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, while he was delivering the sermon.”
en_alternates: 1749 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Khubayb, from Ibn Maʿn, from the daughter of Haritha ibn al-Nuʿman al-Ansari, who said: «I saw that our oven and the oven of the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) were one, and I did not learn Qaf – meaning Surat Qaf – except from the mouth of the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) as he was delivering the sermon.»

sections.title_ar: مَا رَوَتْ فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتُ قَيْسٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
sections.title_en: What Fatima bint Qays Narrated from the Prophet ﷺ

hadiths.ar: 1750 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي الْجَهْمِ ، قَالَ: «دَخَلْتُ أَنَا وَأَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ عَلَى فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ فِي مِلْكِ آلِ الزُّبَيْرِ، فَسَأَلْنَاهَا عَنِ الْمُطَلَّقَةِ ثَلَاثًا، هَلْ لَهَا نَفَقَةٌ؟ فَقَالَتْ: طَلَّقَنِي زَوْجِي ثَلَاثًا، لَمْ يَجْعَلْ لِي سُكْنَى، وَلَا نَفَقَةً، فَأَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ، فَقُلْتُ:  إِنَّهُ لَمْ يَجْعَلْ لِي سُكْنَى، وَلَا نَفَقَةً، قَالَ: صَدَقَ ثُمَّ قَالَ: اعْتَدِّي فِي بَيْتِ أُمِّ شَرِيكٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ: إِنَّ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ يَأْتُونَهَا، وَلَكِنِ اعْتَدِّي فِي بَيْتِ ابْنِ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ، فَإِنَّهُ رَجُلٌ ضَرِيرُ الْبَصَرِ، وَعَسَى أَنْ تُلْقِينَ عَنْكِ ثِيَابَكِ أَوْ بَعْضَ ثِيَابِكِ قَالَتْ: فَفَعَلْتُ، فَلَمَّا انْقَضَتْ عِدَّتِي خَطَبَنِي أَبُو الْجَهْمِ - رَجُلٌ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ - وَمُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، فَأَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: أَمَّا أَبُو الْجَهْمِ فَهُوَ رَجُلٌ شَدِيدٌ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ، وَأَمَّا مُعَاوِيَةُ فَرَجُلٌ لَا مَالَ لَهُ قَالَتْ: ثُمَّ خَطَبَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، فَتَزَوَّجْتُهُ، فَبَارَكَ اللهُ لِي فِي أُسَامَةَ».
hadiths.en: 1750 - Yunus narrated to us, saying: Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shu'ba narrated to us, saying: Abu Bakr ibn Abi al-Jahm informed me, saying: "Abu Salama ibn 'Abd al-Rahman ibn 'Awf and I visited Fatima bint Qays on the property of the family of al-Zubayr, and asked her about a woman divorced three times: does she have maintenance? She said: 'My husband divorced me three times and did not give me lodging or maintenance. I came to the Messenger of God ﷺ and mentioned that to him, saying: He did not give me lodging or maintenance. He said: He has spoken truly. Then he said: Observe your waiting period in the house of Umm Sharik. Then he said: The Emigrants visit her; rather, observe your waiting period in the house of Ibn Umm Maktum, for he is a blind man, and you may take off your clothes or some of your clothes. She said: I did so. When my waiting period ended, Abu al-Jahm — a man of Quraysh — and Mu'awiya ibn Abi Sufyan proposed to me. I came to the Messenger of God ﷺ and mentioned that to him, and the Messenger of God ﷺ said: As for Abu al-Jahm, he is a man hard on women; and as for Mu'awiya, he is a man who has no wealth. She said: Then Usama ibn Zayd proposed to me, and I married him, and God blessed me through Usama.'"

hadiths.ar: 1751 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا قُرَّةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا سَيَّارٌ أَبُو الْحَكَمِ ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ ، قَالَ: «دَخَلْنَا عَلَى فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ فَأَتْحَفَتْنَا بِرُطَبٍ يُقَالُ لَهُ: ابْنُ طَابٍ، وَسَقَتْنَا سَوِيقَ سُلْتٍ، فَسَأَلْنَاهَا عَنِ الْمُطَلَّقَةِ ثَلَاثًا: أَيْنَ تَعْتَدُّ؟ فَقَالَتْ: أَذِنَ لِي رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ أَعْتَدَّ فِي أَهْلِي - أَيْ: أَتَحَوَّلَ - وَيَوْمَئِذٍ نُودِيَ فِي النَّاسِ: الصَّلَاةَ جَامِعَةً، فَخَرَجْتُ فِيمَنْ خَرَجَ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ، وَكُنْتُ فِي الصَّفِّ الْمُقَدَّمِ، مِمَّا يَلِي الصَّفَّ الْمُؤَخَّرَ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ، فَسَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: إِنَّ بَنِي عَمٍّ لِتَمِيمٍ الدَّارِيِّ رَكِبُوا الْبَحْرَ، وَإِنَّ سَفِينَتَهُمْ قَذَفَتْهُمْ إِلَى سَاحِلٍ مِنْ سَوَاحِلِ الْبَحْرِ، وَهُنَاكَ دَابَّةٌ يُوَارِيهَا شَعَرُهَا، فَلَمَّا دَخَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا، قَالَتْ: أَنَا الْجَسَّاسَةُ، ثُمَّ قَالَتْ: إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ الدَّيْرِ مَنْ هُوَ إِلَى رُؤْيَتِكُمْ بِالْأَشْوَاقِ، فَدَخَلْنَا، فَإِذَا رَجُلٌ مُكَبَّلٌ فِي الْحَدِيدِ بِضَرُورَةٍ، فَقَالَ:  أَخَرَجَ صَاحِبُكُمْ؟ يَعْنِي النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْنَا: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: فَاتَّبِعُوهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: أَخْبِرُونِي عَنْ نَخْلِ بَيْسَانَ، أَيُطْعِمُ؟ قُلْنَا: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: أَخْبِرُونِي عَنْ بُحَيْرَةِ الطَّبَرِيَّةِ، أَكَثِيرَةُ الْمَاءِ هِيَ؟ قُلْنَا: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: فَأَخْبِرُونِي عَنْ عَيْنِ زُغَرَ، أَكَثِيرَةُ الْمَاءِ؟ قُلْنَا: نَعَمْ، فَقَالَ: أَمَا إِنِّي لَوْ قَدْ خَرَجْتُ لَوَطِئْتُ الْبِلَادَ كُلَّهَا غَيْرَ مَكَّةَ وَطَيْبَةَ قَالَتْ فَاطِمَةُ: فَأَنَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ بِمِخْصَرَتِهِ: أَلَا وَهَذِهِ طَيْبَةُ - يُومِئُ إِلَى أَرْضِ الْمَدِينَةِ - وَمَكَّةُ مَكَّةُ».
hadiths.en: 1751 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Qurra ibn Khalid narrated to us: Sayyar Abu al-Hakam narrated to us, from al-Sha'bi, who said: "We visited Fatima bint Qays and she treated us to fresh dates called Ibn Tab and gave us barley gruel to drink. We asked her about a woman divorced three times: where does she observe her waiting period? She said: 'The Messenger of God ﷺ permitted me to observe my waiting period with my family — that is, to move. On that day the call was made among the people: Prayer in congregation! I went out among the women who went out and was in the front row of the women, adjoining the last row of the men. I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: The cousins of Tamim al-Dari sailed the sea, and their ship cast them up on a shore of the sea. There was a creature there whose hair covered it. When we went in to it, it said: I am the Spy. Then it said: In that monastery is one who is longing to see you. We entered, and there was a man shackled in iron, in a state of distress. He said: Has your companion emerged? — meaning the Prophet ﷺ. We said: Yes. He said: Follow him. Then he said: Tell me about the date palms of Baysan: do they bear fruit? We said: Yes. He said: Tell me about the Lake of Tiberias: does it have much water? We said: Yes. He said: Tell me about the spring of Zughar: does it have much water? We said: Yes. He said: Were I to emerge, I would tread all lands except Mecca and Tayba. Fatima said: I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ say, with his staff: Behold, this is Tayba — pointing to the land of Medina — and Mecca is Mecca.'"

sections.title_ar: مَا رَوَتْ سَوْدَةُ بِنْتُ زَمْعَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
sections.title_en: What Sawda bint Zamʿa narrated from the Prophet, peace be upon him
title_en_alternates: What Sawda bint Zamʿa narrated from the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him)

hadiths.ar: 1752 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ، عَنْ صَالِحٍ مَوْلَى التَّوْءَمَةِ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ، قَالَ «: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم  لِأَزْوَاجِهِ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ: إِنَّمَا هِيَ هَذِهِ، ثُمَّ ظُهُورَ الْحُصُرِ قَالَ: فَكُنَّ كُلُّهُنَّ يُسَافِرْنَ إِلَّا زَيْنَبَ وَسَوْدَةَ، فَإِنَّهُمَا قَالَتَا: لَا تُحَرِّكُنَا دَابَّةٌ بَعْدَمَا سَمِعْنَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم».
hadiths.en: 1752 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Ibn Abī Dhiʾb narrated to us, from Ṣāliḥ, freedman of al-Tawʾama, from Abū Hurayra, who said: “The Messenger of God, peace be upon him, ⦗p. 219⦘ said to his wives during the Farewell Pilgrimage: This is the (last) one; then (stay at home) on the backs of the mats.” He said: So all of them would travel (for Hajj) except Zaynab and Sawda, for they said: No animal will ever move us again after what we heard from the Messenger of God, peace be upon him.
en_alternates: 1752 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Ibn Abi Dhiʾb narrated to us, from Salih, the freedman of al-Tawʾama, from Abu Hurayra, who said: «The Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) said to his wives during the Farewell Pilgrimage: It is only this (pilgrimage), and then the backs of the mats (i.e., staying at home). He said: All of them used to travel except Zaynab and Sawda, for they said: No beast will move us after we have heard that from the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him).»

sections.title_ar: وَمَا رَوَتْ ضُبَاعَةُ بِنْتُ الزُّبَيْرِ وَأُمُّ الْفَضْلِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
sections.title_en: And what Duba'a bint al-Zubayr and Umm al-Fadl narrated from the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him)

hadiths.ar: 1753 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَبِيبُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ هَرِمٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ ، وَعِكْرِمَةَ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَ ضُبَاعَةَ بِنْتَ الزُّبَيْرِ أَنْ تَشْتَرِطَ فِي الْحَجِّ، فَفَعَلَتْ ذَلِكَ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم.»
hadiths.en: 1753 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Habib ibn Yazid narrated to us, from ʿAmr ibn Harim, from Saʿid ibn Jubayr and ʿIkrima, from Ibn ʿAbbas: «that the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) commanded Duba'a bint al-Zubayr to stipulate a condition in the Hajj, and she did that on the command of the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him).»

hadiths.ar: 1754 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ الثَّوْرِيُّ ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ أَبِي النَّضْرِ ، عَنْ عُمَيْرٍ، مَوْلَى أُمِّ الْفَضْلِ ، قَالَ: «تَمَارَى النَّاسُ فِي صِيَامِ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ بِعَرَفَاتٍ، فَقَالَتْ أُمُّ الْفَضْلِ : أَنَا أَعْلَمُ لَكُمْ ذَلِكَ، فَبَعَثَتْ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِإِنَاءٍ فِيهِ لَبَنٌ فَشَرِبَ».
hadiths.en: 1754 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Sufyan al-Thawri narrated to us, from Salim Abu al-Nadr, from ʿUmayr, the freedman of Umm al-Fadl, who said: «People disputed about whether the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) was fasting on the day of ʿArafa at ʿArafat, and Umm al-Fadl said: I will find out for you. So she sent a vessel containing milk to the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him), and he drank.»

sections.title_ar: مَا رَوَتْ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم.
sections.title_en: What Umm Sulaym narrated from the Prophet, peace be upon him.

hadiths.ar: 1755 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ الْجَزَرِيِّ ، عَنِ ابْنِ بِنْتِ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ، عَنْ جَدَّتِهِ أُمِّ سُلَيْمٍ ، قَالَتْ: «رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَرِبَ مِنْ فِيِّ قِرْبَةٍ فَقَطَعْتُهَا، وَقُلْتُ: لَا يَشْرَبُ مِنْهَا أَحَدٌ بَعْدَهُ».
hadiths.en: 1755 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Sharīk narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Karīm al-Jazarī, from the son of Anas ibn Mālik's daughter, from his grandmother Umm Sulaym, who said: “I saw the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, drink from the mouth of a waterskin, so I cut it off (to keep the piece), and I said: No one will drink from it after him.”

hadiths.ar: 1756 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ ، قَالَ: «اخْتَلَفَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ وَزَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ إِذَا حَاضَتْ، وَقَدْ طَافَتْ بِالْبَيْتِ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ، فَقَالَ زَيْدٌ: يَكُونُ آخِرُ عَهْدِهَا بِالْبَيْتِ، وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: تَنْفِرُ إِذَا شَاءَتْ، فَقَالَتِ الْأَنْصَارُ: لَنْ نُتَابِعَكَ يَا ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، وَأَنْتَ تُخَالِفُ زَيْدًا، فَقَالَ: سَلُوا صَاحِبَتَكُمْ أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ ، فَقَالَتْ: حِضْتُ بَعْدَمَا طُفْتُ بِالْبَيْتِ، فَأَمَرَنِي رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ أَنْفِرَ، وَحَاضَتْ صَفِيَّةُ، فَقَالَتْ لَهَا عَائِشَةُ: حَبَسْتِينَا، فَأَمَرَهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ تَنْفِرَ».
hadiths.en: 1756 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Hishām narrated to us, from Qatāda, from ʿIkrima, who said: “Ibn ʿAbbās and Zayd ibn Thābit disagreed about a woman who has her period after she has circumambulated the House on the Day of Sacrifice. Zayd said: Her last act should be at the House. And Ibn ʿAbbās said: She may depart whenever she wishes. The Anṣār said: We will not follow you, Ibn ʿAbbās, when you contradict Zayd. He said: Ask your companion Umm Sulaym. She said: I got my period after I had circumambulated the House, and the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, commanded me to depart. And Ṣafiyya got her period, and ʿĀʾisha said to her: You have detained us. So the Prophet, peace be upon him, commanded her to depart.”

sections.title_ar: مَا رَوَتْ زَيْنَبُ الثَّقَفِيَّةُ رضي الله عنها عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
sections.title_en: What Zaynab al-Thaqafiyya, may God be pleased with her, Narrated from the Prophet ﷺ

hadiths.ar: 1757 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللهِ ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ الْأَشَجِّ ، عَنْ بُسْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَتْنِي زَيْنَبُ الثَّقَفِيَّةُ، امْرَأَةُ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ، «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَهَا أَنْ لَا تَمَسَّ الطِّيبَ إِذَا خَرَجَتْ إِلَى صَلَاةِ الْعِشَاءِ الْآخِرَةِ».
hadiths.en: 1757 - Yunus narrated to us, saying: Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Ibrahim ibn Sa'd narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn 'Abd Allah narrated to me, from Bukayr ibn 'Abd Allah ibn al-Ashajj, from Busr ibn Sa'id, who said: Zaynab al-Thaqafiyya, the wife of 'Abd Allah ibn Mas'ud, narrated to me, "that the Messenger of God ﷺ commanded her not to touch perfume when she went out to the late evening prayer."

hadiths.ar: 1758 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا وَائِلٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ الثَّقَفِيَّةِ - امْرَأَةِ عَبْدِ اللهِ - «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لِلنِّسَاءِ: تَصَدَّقْنَ وَلَوْ مِنْ حُلِيِّكُنَّ فَقَالَتْ زَيْنَبُ لِعَبْدِ اللهِ: أَيُجْزِئُ عَنِّي أَنْ أَضَعَ صَدَقَتِي فِيكَ وَفِي بَنِي أَخِي أَوْ أُخْتِي أَيْتَامٍ؟ وَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللهِ خَفِيفَ ذَاتِ الْيَدِ، فَقَالَ: سَلِي عَنْ ذَاكَ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَتْ زَيْنَبُ: فَأَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَإِذَا امْرَأَةٌ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ يُقَالُ لَهَا: زَيْنَبُ، جَاءَتْ تَسْأَلُ عَمَّا جِئْتُ أَسْأَلُ عَنْهُ، فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْنَا بِلَالٌ، فَقُلْنَا لَهُ: سَلْ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَا تُخْبِرْهُ مَنْ نَحْنُ: أَيُجْزِئُ عَنِّي أَنْ أَضَعَ صَدَقَتِي فِي بَنِي أَخِي أَيْتَامٍ، أَوْ بَنِي أُخْتِي أَيْتَامٍ فِي حَجْرِي؟ فَأَتَى رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لَهُ، فَقَالَ: أَيُّ الزَّيَانِبِ هِيَ؟ فَقَالَ: زَيْنَبُ امْرَأَةُ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، وَزَيْنَبُ امْرَأَةٌ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: أَخْبِرْهُمَا أَنَّ لَهُمَا أَجْرَيْنِ؛ أَجْرَ  الْقَرَابَةِ وَأَجْرَ الصَّدَقَةِ».
hadiths.en: 1758 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, saying: Shu'ba narrated to us, from al-A'mash, who said: I heard Abu Wa'il narrate from 'Amr ibn al-Harith, from Zaynab al-Thaqafiyya — the wife of 'Abd Allah — "that the Messenger of God ﷺ said to the women: 'Give charity, even from your jewelry.' Zaynab said to 'Abd Allah: 'Does it suffice for me to put my charity on you and on the orphan sons of my brother or sister?' 'Abd Allah was of limited means, and he said: 'Ask the Messenger of God ﷺ about that.' Zaynab said: I went to the Messenger of God ﷺ, and there was a woman of the Ansar, also called Zaynab, who had come to ask about what I had come to ask. Bilal came out to us and we said to him: 'Ask the Messenger of God ﷺ, and do not tell him who we are: Does it suffice for me to put my charity on the orphan sons of my brother, or the orphan sons of my sister who are in my care?' He went to the Messenger of God ﷺ and mentioned that to him. He said: 'Which Zaynabs are they?' Bilal said: 'Zaynab, the wife of 'Abd Allah ibn Mas'ud, and Zaynab, a woman of the Ansar.' The Messenger of God ﷺ said to him: 'Tell them both that they will have two rewards: the reward of kinship and the reward of charity.'"

sections.title_ar: أُمُّ حُصَيْنٍ الْأَحْمَسِيَّةُ رضي الله عنها عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
sections.title_en: Umm Husayn al-Ahmasiyya (may God be pleased with her), on the authority of the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him)

hadiths.ar: 1759 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ الْأَحْمَسِيِّ ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَتْنِي جَدَّتِي أُمُّ حُصَيْنٍ الْأَحْمَسِيَّةُ ، قَالَتْ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «إِنِ اسْتُعْمِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ عَبْدًا حَبَشِيًّا، مَا قَادَكُمْ بِكِتَابِ اللهِ، فَاسْمَعُوا لَهُ وَأَطِيعُوا».
hadiths.en: 1759 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Yahya ibn Husayn al-Ahmasi, who said: My grandmother Umm Husayn al-Ahmasiyya informed me, she said: I heard the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) say: «If an Abyssinian slave is put in charge of you, then as long as he leads you by the Book of God, listen to him and obey.»

hadiths.ar: 1760 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ ، عَنْ جَدَّتِهِ ، «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَعَا لِلْمُحَلِّقِينَ ثَلَاثًا وَلِلْمُقَصِّرِينَ مَرَّةً».
hadiths.en: 1760 - Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Yahya ibn Husayn, from his grandmother: «that the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) prayed for those who shave their heads three times, and for those who shorten their hair once.»

sections.title_ar: وَأُمُّ كُلْثُومٍ بِنْتُ عُقْبَةَ رضي الله عنها عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
sections.title_en: And Umm Kulthūm bint ʿUqba, may God be pleased with her, from the Prophet, peace be upon him
title_en_alternates: And Umm Kulthum bint ʿUqba (may God be pleased with her), on the authority of the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him)

hadiths.ar: 1761 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ أُمِّ كُلْثُومٍ بِنْتِ عُقْبَةَ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «لَيْسَ الْكَاذِبُ مَنْ أَصْلَحَ بَيْنَ اثْنَيْنِ، وَقَالَ خَيْرًا، أَوْ نَمَى خَيْرًا».
hadiths.en: 1761 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Ibn al-Mubārak narrated to us, from Maʿmar, from al-Zuhrī, from Ḥumayd ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from his mother Umm Kulthūm bint ʿUqba, that the Prophet, peace be upon him, said: “The one who reconciles two people and says something good, or conveys something good, is not a liar.”
en_alternates: 1761 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Ibn al-Mubarak narrated to us, from Maʿmar, from al-Zuhri, from Humayd ibn ʿAbd al-Rahman, from his mother Umm Kulthum bint ʿUqba, that the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) said: «The one who reconciles between two people is not a liar: he says something good, or conveys something good.»

sections.title_ar: وَبُسْرَةُ بِنْتُ صَفْوَانَ رضي الله عنها عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
sections.title_en: And Busra bint Ṣafwān, may God be pleased with her, from the Prophet, peace be upon him
title_en_alternates: And Busra bint Safwan (may God be pleased with her), on the authority of the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him)

hadiths.ar: 1762 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ أَوْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ ، «أَنَّ مَرْوَانَ، أَرْسَلَ إِلَى بُسْرَةَ بِنْتِ صَفْوَانَ يَسْأَلُهَا، فَحَدَّثَتْ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: مَنْ مَسَّ ذَكَرَهُ فَلْيَتَوَضَّأْ».
hadiths.en: 1762 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh or Muḥammad ibn Abī Bakr ibn ʿAmr ibn Ḥazm, from ʿUrwa ibn al-Zubayr: “that Marwān sent for Busra bint Ṣafwān to ask her, and she narrated from the Prophet, peace be upon him, that he said: Whoever touches his private part, let him perform ablution.”
en_alternates: 1762 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allah or Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr ibn ʿAmr ibn Hazm, from ʿUrwa ibn al-Zubayr: «that Marwan sent to Busra bint Safwan to ask her, and she narrated from the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) that he said: Whoever touches his private part, let him perform ablution.»

sections.title_ar: وَقَيْلَةُ بِنْتُ مَخْرَمَةَ رضي الله عنها عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
sections.title_en: And Qayla bint Makhrama, may God be pleased with her, from the Prophet, peace be upon him
title_en_alternates: And Qayla bint Makhrama (may God be pleased with her), on the authority of the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him)

hadiths.ar: 1763 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ حَسَّانَ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَتْنِي جَدَّتَايَ، دُحَيْبَةُ وَصَفِيَّةُ بِنْتَا عُلَيْبَةَ ، عَنْ رَبِيبَتِهِمَا وَجَدَّةِ أَبِيهِمَا قَيْلَةَ بِنْتِ مَخْرَمَةَ ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ: «صَلَّى بِنَا رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْفَجْرَ حِينَ انْشَقَّ الْفَجْرُ، وَالنُّجُومُ شَابِكَةٌ فِي السَّمَاءِ، مَا تَكَادُ تَعَارَفُ مَعَ ظُلْمَةِ اللَّيْلِ، وَالرِّجَالُ مَا تَكَادُ تَعَارَفُ».
hadiths.en: 1763 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: ʿAbd Allāh ibn Ḥassān al-ʿAnbarī narrated to us, he said: My two grandmothers, Duḥayba and Ṣafiyya, daughters of ʿUlayba, narrated to me, from their foster-daughter and their father's grandmother Qayla bint Makhrama, that she said: “The Messenger of God, peace be upon him, led us in the dawn prayer when the dawn broke, while the stars were thick in the sky, so that we could hardly recognize one another in the darkness of the night, and the men could hardly recognize one another.”
en_alternates: 1763 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: ʿAbd Allah ibn Hassan al-ʿAnbari narrated to us, he said: My two grandmothers, Duhayba and Safiyya, daughters of ʿUlayba, narrated to me, from their ward, the grandmother of their father, Qayla bint Makhrama, that she said: «The Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) led us in the dawn prayer as soon as dawn broke, while the stars were still dense in the sky, such that one could hardly recognize anyone in the darkness of the night, and the men could hardly recognize one another.»

sections.title_ar: وَأُمُّ بُجَيْدٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
sections.title_en: And Umm Bujayd, from the Prophet, peace be upon him
title_en_alternates: And Umm Bujayd, on the authority of the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him)

hadiths.ar: 1764 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ بُجَيْدٍ ، عَنْ جَدَّتِهِ ، قَالَتْ: «قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، يَجِيءُ السَّائِلُ فَيَقُومُ عَلَى بَابِي، وَلَيْسَ عِنْدِي مَا أَدْفَعُ إِلَيْهِ، قَالَ: أَعْطِيهِ وَلَوْ ظِلْفًا مُحْرَقَةً».
hadiths.en: 1764 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Ibn Abī Dhiʾb narrated to us, from Saʿīd ibn Abī Saʿīd al-Maqburī, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Bujayd, from his grandmother, who said: “I said: O Messenger of God, a beggar comes and stands at my door, and I have nothing to give him. He said: Give him something, even a burnt hoof.”
en_alternates: 1764 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Ibn Abi Dhiʾb narrated to us, from Saʿid ibn Abi Saʿid al-Maqburi, from ʿAbd al-Rahman ibn Bujayd, from his grandmother, who said: «I said: O Messenger of God, the beggar comes and stands at my door, and I have nothing to give him. He said: Give him, even a burnt hoof.»

sections.title_ar: وَأُمُّ جُنْدُبٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
sections.title_en: And Umm Jundub, from the Prophet, peace be upon him
title_en_alternates: And Umm Jundub, on the authority of the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him)

hadiths.ar: 1765 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْأَحْوَصِ ، يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ جَدَّتِي - أَوْ أُمِّي - تُحَدِّثُ «أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَ الْجَمْرَةِ وَقَدِ ازْدَحَمَ النَّاسُ، فَقَالَ: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ، لَا تَقْتُلُوا أَنْفُسَكُمُ،  ارْمُوا بِمِثْلِ حَصَى الْخَذْفِ».
hadiths.en: 1765 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Yazīd ibn Abī Ziyād, who said: I heard Sulaymān ibn ʿAmr ibn al-Aḥwaṣ say: I heard my grandmother – or my mother – narrating: “that she heard the Prophet, peace be upon him, at the jamra when the people were crowding, and he said: O people, do not kill one another, ⦗p. 236⦘ throw pebbles the size of those used for flicking (ḥaṣā al-khadhf).”
en_alternates: 1765 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Yazid ibn Abi Ziyad, who said: I heard Sulayman ibn ʿAmr ibn al-Ahwas say: I heard my grandmother – or my mother – narrating: «that she heard the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) at the jamra when the people were crowding, and he said: O people, do not kill yourselves; throw stones the size of pebbles for flicking.»

sections.title_ar: وَأُنَيْسَةُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
sections.title_en: And Unaysa, from the Prophet, peace be upon him
title_en_alternates: And Unaysa, on the authority of the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him)

hadiths.ar: 1766 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ خُبَيْبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَتْنِي عَمَّتِي أُنَيْسَةُ ، قَالَتْ: «كَانَ بِلَالٌ وَابْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ يُؤَذِّنَانِ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: إِنَّ بِلَالًا يُؤَذِّنُ بِلَيْلٍ، فَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّى يُؤَذِّنَ ابْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ فَكُنَّا نَحْبِسُ ابْنَ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ عَنِ الْأَذَانِ فَنَقُولُ: كَمَا أَنْتَ حَتَّى نَتَسَحَّرَ، كَمَا أَنْتَ حَتَّى نَتَسَحَّرَ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ بَيْنَ أَذَانِهِمَا إِلَّا أَنْ يَنْزِلَ هَذَا وَيَصْعَدَ هَذَا».
hadiths.en: 1766 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Khubayb ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, who said: My paternal aunt Unaysa narrated to me, saying: “Bilāl and Ibn Umm Maktūm used to give the call to prayer for the Prophet, peace be upon him, and the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, said: Bilāl calls the adhān by night, so eat and drink until Ibn Umm Maktūm calls the adhān. We would hold Ibn Umm Maktūm back from calling the adhān, saying: Stay as you are until we finish the pre-dawn meal, stay as you are until we finish the pre-dawn meal. And there was no gap between their two calls except that this one would come down and that one would go up.”
en_alternates: 1766 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Khubayb ibn ʿAbd al-Rahman, who said: My aunt Unaysa narrated to me, she said: «Bilal and Ibn Umm Maktum used to give the call to prayer for the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him), and the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) said: Bilal calls the adhān at night, so eat and drink until Ibn Umm Maktum calls the adhān. We would hold Ibn Umm Maktum back from the adhān and say: Wait, until we finish the pre-dawn meal; wait, until we finish the pre-dawn meal. And there was nothing between their calls except that this one would come down and that one would go up.»

sections.title_ar: وَأُمُّ مَعْقِلٍ الْأَشْجَعِيَّةُ رضي الله عنها عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
sections.title_en: And Umm Maʿqil al-Ashjaʿiyya, may God be pleased with her, from the Prophet, peace be upon him

hadiths.ar: 1767 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا بَكْرِ بْنَ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ الْقُرَشِيَّ ، يَقُولُ: «أَرْسَلَ مَرْوَانُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ إِلَى أُمِّ مَعْقِلٍ - امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ أَشْجَعَ - فَقَالَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ: كَانَتْ عَلَيَّ عُمْرَةٌ، وَإِنَّ زَوْجِي جَعَلَ بَكْرًا لَهُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ، فَطَلَبْتُ إِلَيْهِ أَنْ يُعْطِيَنِيهِ أَعْتَمِرُ عَلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ: إِنِّي جَعَلْتُهُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ، فَأَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: إِنَّ الْحَجَّ وَالْعُمْرَةَ مِنْ سَبِيلِ اللهِ فَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يُعْطِيَهَا تَعْتَمِرُ عَلَيْهِ. وَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: عُمْرَةٌ فِي رَمَضَانَ كَحَجَّةٍ أَوْ قَالَ: تُجْزِئُ بِحَجَّةٍ» قَالَ شُعْبَةُ: فَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ: إِنَّمَا قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِتِلْكَ الْمَرْأَةِ خَاصَّةً.
hadiths.en: 1767 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Ibrāhīm ibn al-Muhājir, who said: I heard Abū Bakr ibn al-Ḥārith ibn Hishām al-Qurashī say: “Marwān ibn al-Ḥakam sent for Umm Maʿqil – a woman of Ashjaʿ – and the woman said: I owed an ʿumra, and my husband had designated a young camel of his in the cause of God. I asked him to give it to me so that I could perform ʿumra on it, but he said: I have designated it in the cause of God. So I came to the Prophet, peace be upon him, and the Prophet, peace be upon him, said: Hajj and ʿumra are part of the cause of God. So he ordered him to give it to her to perform ʿumra on it. And the Prophet, peace be upon him, said: An ʿumra in Ramaḍān is like a Hajj – or he said: it is equivalent to a Hajj.” Shuʿba said: Abū Bishr narrated to me from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr, who said: The Prophet, peace be upon him, said that only to that particular woman.

sections.title_ar: وَابْنَةُ خَبَّابٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
sections.title_en: And the daughter of Khabbāb, from the Prophet, peace be upon him
title_en_alternates: And the daughter of Khabbab, on the authority of the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him)

hadiths.ar: 1768 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ ، عَنِ ابْنَةِ خَبَّابٍ ، «أَنَّهَا أَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِشَاةٍ، فَاعْتَقَلَهَا، فَحَلَبَهَا، وَقَالَ: ائْتِينِي بِأَعْظَمِ إِنَاءٍ لَكُمْ فَأَتَيْنَاهُ بِجَفْنَةِ  الْعَجِينِ، فَحَلَبَ فِيهَا حَتَّى مَلَأَهَا، ثُمَّ قَالَ: اشْرَبُوا أَنْتُمْ وَجِيرَانُكُمْ».
hadiths.en: 1768 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from the daughter of Khabbāb: “that she came to the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, with a ewe; he held her fast and milked her, and said: Bring me the largest vessel you have. So we brought him a large dough bowl ⦗p. 240⦘, and he milked into it until he filled it, then said: Drink, you and your neighbors.”
en_alternates: 1768 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from the daughter of Khabbab: «that she came to the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) with a sheep; he restrained it and milked it, and said: Bring me the largest vessel you have. We brought him a kneading bowl, and he milked into it until he filled it, then said: Drink, you and your neighbors.»

sections.title_ar: وَفُرَيْعَةُ أُخْتُ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
sections.title_en: And Furayʿa, sister of Abū Saʿīd, from the Prophet, peace be upon him
title_en_alternates: And Furayʿa, sister of Abu Saʿid, on the authority of the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him)

hadiths.ar: 1769 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ ، عَنْ فُرَيْعَةَ أُخْتِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ ، «أَنَّ زَوْجَهَا تَبِعَ أَعْلَاجًا فَقَتَلُوهُ، وَهِيَ فِي قَرْيَةٍ مِنْ قُرَى الْمَدِينَةِ، فَأَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ، وَاسْتَأْذَنَتْ أَنْ تَأْتِيَ أَخَوَاتِهَا فَتَعْتَدَّ عِنْدَهُمْ، فَأَذِنَ لَهَا، ثُمَّ دَعَاهَا، أَوْ دُعِيَتْ لَهُ، فَقَالَ: امْكُثِي فِي الْبَيْتِ الَّذِي أَتَاكِ فِيهِ نَعْيُ زَوْجِكِ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ الْكِتَابُ أَجَلَهُ».
hadiths.en: 1769 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Saʿd ibn Isḥāq, from Zaynab, from Furayʿa, sister of Abū Saʿīd: “that her husband had followed some (foreign) slaves and they killed him, while she was in one of the villages of Medina. She came to the Prophet, peace be upon him, and told him about that, and asked permission to go to her sisters and observe her waiting period (ʿidda) with them. He permitted her, then called her – or she was called to him – and said: Stay in the house in which news of your husband's death reached you, until the prescribed term (al-kitāb) reaches its end.”
en_alternates: 1769 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Saʿd ibn Ishaq, from Zaynab, from Furayʿa, the sister of Abu Saʿid: «that her husband followed some foreign men (aʿlāj) and they killed him, and she was in one of the villages of Medina. She came to the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him), mentioned that to him, and asked permission to go to her sisters and observe her waiting period (ʿidda) with them. He gave her permission; then he called her, or she was called to him, and he said: Stay in the house in which the news of your husband's death reached you, until the prescribed period reaches its end.»

sections.title_ar: وَأُمُّ رُومَانَ رضي الله عنها عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
sections.title_en: And Umm Rūmān, may God be pleased with her, from the Prophet, peace be upon him

hadiths.ar: 1770 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَتْنِي أُمُّ رُومَانَ أُمُّ عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَتْ: «بَيْنَا أَنَا قَاعِدَةٌ إِذْ دَخَلَتْ عَلَيَّ امْرَأَةٌ فَقَالَتْ: فَعَلَ اللهُ بِفُلَانٍ كَذَا وَكَذَا، فَقُلْتُ: وَمَا لَهُ؟ قَالَتْ: إِنَّهُ أَفْشَى الْحَدِيثَ - يَعْنِي ذَكَرَ عَائِشَةَ - فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ: سَمِعَ بِهَذَا رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم؟، قَالَتْ: نَعَمْ، قَالَتْ: فَسَمِعَ بِهَذَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ؟ قَالَتْ: نَعَمْ، فَأَخَذَهَا شَيْءٌ، مَا قَامَتْ إِلَّا بِحُمَّى، فَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْهَا ثِيَابَهَا، فَدَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَقَالَ:  مَا شَأْنُ هَذِهِ؟ فَقُلْتُ: أَخَذَتْهَا حُمَّى بِنَافِضٍ، قَالَتْ: فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: فَلَعَلَّهُ مِنْ أَجْلِ حَدِيثٍ حُدِّثَتْ بِهِ فَقَعَدَتْ عَائِشَةُ، فَقَالَتْ: وَاللهِ لَئِنْ حَلَفْتُ لَا تُصَدِّقُونِي، وَلَئِنْ قُلْتُ لَا تَقْبَلُوا مِنِّي، وَمَا مَثَلِي وَمَثَلُكُمْ إِلَّا كَمَثَلِ يَعْقُوبَ وَبَنِيهِ، {وَاللهُ الْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَى مَا تَصِفُونَ}، قَالَ: فَأَنْزَلَ اللهُ عز وجل عُذْرَهَا، فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ: بِحَمْدِ اللهِ لَا بِحَمْدِكَ وَلَا بِحَمْدِ أَحَدٍ».
hadiths.en: 1770 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Abū ʿAwāna narrated to us, from Ḥuṣayn, from Abū Wāʾil, from Masrūq, who said: Umm Rūmān, the mother of ʿĀʾisha, narrated to me, saying: “While I was sitting, a woman came in to me and said: May God do such-and-such to so-and-so. I said: What has he done? She said: He spread the talk – meaning he mentioned ʿĀʾisha. ʿĀʾisha said: Did the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, hear of this? She said: Yes. She said: And did Abū Bakr hear of this? She said: Yes. Something seized her, and she only rose with a fever, so I covered her with her garments. Then the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, came in and said: What is the matter with this one? I said: She has been seized by a fever with shivering. The Messenger of God, peace be upon him, said: Perhaps it is because of a report that was told to her. ʿĀʾisha sat up and said: By God, if I swear, you will not believe me, and if I say (anything), you will not accept it from me; my likeness and yours is only like that of Jacob and his sons: {and God is the One whose help is sought against what you describe} (Qur’an 12:18). He said: Then God, Mighty and Majestic, revealed her innocence, and ʿĀʾisha said: Praise be to God – not to you, nor to anyone else.”

sections.title_ar: وَأُمُّ عُمَارَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
sections.title_en: And Umm ʿUmāra, from the Prophet, peace be upon him
title_en_alternates: And Umm ʿUmara, on the authority of the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him)

hadiths.ar: 1771 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي حَبِيبُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ مَوْلَاةً لَنَا يُقَالُ لَهَا لَيْلَى ، تُحَدِّثُ عَنْ جَدَّتِهِ أُمِّ عُمَارَةَ الْأَنْصَارِيَّةِ ، أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «مَا مِنْ صَائِمٍ يُؤْكَلُ عِنْدَهُ، إِلَّا صَلَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ حَتَّى يَشْبَعُوا وَقَالَ مَرَّةً: حَتَّى يَفْرُغُوا». آخِرُ أَحَادِيثِ النِّسَاءِ.
hadiths.en: 1771 - Yūnus narrated to us, he said: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, he said: Ḥabīb ibn Zayd al-Anṣārī informed me, he said: I heard a freedwoman of ours called Laylā narrating from his grandmother Umm ʿUmāra al-Anṣāriyya, that she heard the Prophet, peace be upon him, say: “There is no fasting person in whose presence food is eaten except that the angels pray for him until they are satisfied” – and once he said: “until they have finished.” End of the Hadiths of the Women.
en_alternates: 1771 - Yunus narrated to us, he said: Abu Dawud narrated to us, he said: Shuʿba narrated to us, he said: Habib ibn Zayd al-Ansari informed me, he said: I heard a freedwoman of ours called Layla narrating from his grandmother Umm ʿUmara al-Ansariyya, that she heard the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) say: «There is no fasting person in whose presence food is eaten, but the angels invoke blessings upon him until they have eaten their fill» – and once he said: «until they have finished.» The end of the hadiths of the women.

sections.title_ar: مَا أَسْنَدَ جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللهِ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ
sections.title_en: What Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh al-Anṣārī Reported as Traced to the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)

sections.title_ar: مَا رَوَى عَنْهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ
sections.title_en: What Was Narrated from Jābir by Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn

hadiths.ar: 1772 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ، قَالَ: «خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللهِ  صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ الْفَتْحِ صَائِمًا حَتَّى أَتَى كُرَاعَ الْغَمِيمِ، وَالنَّاسُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُشَاةً وَرُكْبَانًا، وَذَلِكَ فِي رَمَضَانَ، فَقِيلَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ: إِنَّ نَاسًا قَدِ اشْتَدَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الصَّوْمُ، وَإِنَّمَا يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ كَيْفَ فَعَلْتَ، فَدَعَا رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِقَدَحٍ فِيهِ مَاءٌ، فَرَفَعَهُ وَشَرِبَ وَالنَّاسُ يَنْظُرُونَ، فَصَامَ بَعْضُ النَّاسِ وَأَفْطَرَ بَعْضٌ، فَأُخْبِرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ بَعْضَهُمْ صَائِمٌ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: أُولَئِكَ الْعُصَاةُ».
hadiths.en: 1772 - Yūnus narrated to us: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Wuhayb narrated to us, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from Jābir, who said: "The Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) set out in the year of the Conquest fasting, until he reached Kurāʿ al-Ghamīm, with the people accompanying the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him), some on foot and some riding. That was in Ramadan. It was said: O Messenger of God, fasting has become very hard on some people, and they are only watching to see what you do. So the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) called for a cup of water, raised it and drank while the people looked on. Some people then fasted and some broke their fast. It was reported to the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) that some of them were still fasting, and the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) said: Those are the disobedient."

hadiths.ar: 1773 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ ، قَالَ: «أَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْمَدِينَةِ تِسْعًا لَمْ يَحُجَّ، ثُمَّ أَذِنَ لِلنَّاسِ فِي الْحَجِّ، وَفِيهَا نَاسٌ كَثِيرٌ يُرِيدُونَ الْخُرُوجَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم،  فَخَرَجَ، حَتَّى إِذَا أَتَى ذَا الْحُلَيْفَةِ، وَلَدَتْ أَسْمَاءُ بِنْتُ عُمَيْسٍ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ، فَأَرْسَلَتْ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَسْأَلُهُ، فَقَالَ: اغْتَسِلِي وَاسْتَثْفِرِي، ثُمَّ أَهِلِّي فَفَعَلَتْ، قَالَ: فَلَمَّا اطْمَأَنَّ صَدْرُ نَاقَةِ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى ظَاهِرِ الْبَيْدَاءِ أَهَلَّ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَهْلَلْنَا، لَا نَنْوِي إِلَّا الْحَجَّ، قَالَ جَابِرٌ: فَنَظَرْتُ مَدَّ بَصَرِي وَمِنْ وَرَائِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي مِنَ النَّاسِ مُشَاةً وَرُكْبَانًا، فَخَرَجْنَا لَا نَعْرِفُ إِلَّا الْحَجَّ، فَأَقْبَلَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ فَانْطَلَقْنَا لَا نَعْرِفُ إِلَّا الْحَجَّ، لَهُ خَرَجْنَا، وَرَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَعَنَا، وَالْقُرْآنُ يَنْزِلُ عَلَيْهِ، وَهُوَ يَعْلَمُ تَأْوِيلَهُ، وَإِنَّمَا يَعْمَلُ بِمَا أُمِرَ بِهِ، حَتَّى قَدِمْنَا مَكَّةَ، فَبَدَأَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْحَجَرِ فَاسْتَلَمَهُ، ثُمَّ طَافَ سَبْعًا، رَمَلَ فِي ذَلِكَ ثَلَاثًا وَمَشَى أَرْبَعًا، ثُمَّ تَلَا هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ: {وَاتَّخِذُوا مِنْ مَقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُصَلًّى}، قَالَ: صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ - قَالَ أَبِي: وَكَانَ يَسْتَحِبُّ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ  فِيهِمَا بِالتَّوْحِيدِ؛ {قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ} وَ {قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ} وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ذَلِكَ فِي حَدِيثِ جَابِرٍ، ثُمَّ رَجَعَ إِلَى حَدِيثِ جَابِرٍ - قَالَ: ثُمَّ أَتَى الرُّكْنَ فَاسْتَلَمَهُ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ خَرَجَ إِلَى الصَّفَا، قَالَ: نَبْدَأُ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللهُ بِهِ، وَقَالَ: {إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللهِ}، قَالَ: فَرَقِيَ عَلَى الصَّفَا حَتَّى بَدَا لَهُ الْبَيْتُ، وَكَبَّرَ ثَلَاثًا وَقَالَ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ثُمَّ يَدْعُو بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ نَزَلَ فَمَشَى، حَتَّى أَتَى بَطْنَ الْمَسِيلِ سَعَى حَتَّى أَصْعَدَ قَدَمَيْهِ فِي الْمَسِيلِ، ثُمَّ مَشَى حَتَّى أَتَى الْمَرْوَةَ، فَصَعِدَ حَتَّى بَدَا لَهُ الْبَيْتُ، فَكَبَّرَ ثَلَاثًا، وَقَالَ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ هَكَذَا كَمَا فَعَلَ - يَعْنِي عَلَى الصَّفَا - ثُمَّ نَزَلَ، فَقَالَ: مَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ مَعَهُ الْهَدْيُ فَلْيَحِلَّ وَلْيَجْعَلْهَا عُمْرَةً، فَلَوْ أَنِّي اسْتَقْبَلْتُ مِنْ أَمْرِي مَا اسْتَدْبَرْتُ، لَجَعَلْتُهَا عُمْرَةً فَأَحَلُّوا، وَقَدِمَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ مِنَ الْيَمَنِ، فَرَأَى النَّاسَ قَدْ حَلُّوا، فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِأَيِّ شَيْءٍ أَهْلَلْتَ؟ قَالَ: قُلْتُ: اللَّهُمَّ أُهِلُّ بِمَا أَهَلَّ بِهِ رَسُولُكَ، قَالَ: فَإِنَّ مَعِيَ الْهَدْيَ فَلَا تَحِلَّ قَالَ: فَدَخَلَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَى فَاطِمَةَ، وَقَدِ اكْتَحَلَتْ وَلَبِسَتْ ثِيَابًا صَبِيغًا، فَأَنْكَرَ  ذَلِكَ؛ فَقَالَ: مَنْ أَمَرَكِ بِهَذَا؟ فَقَالَتْ: أَمَرَنِي بِهِ أَبِي - فَقَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ: فَكَانَ عَلِيٌّ يُحَدِّثُ بِالْعِرَاقِ، قَالَ: ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُحَرِّشًا عَلَى فَاطِمَةَ فِي الَّذِي ذَكَرَتْ، فَقَالَ: صَدَقَتْ، أَنَا أَمَرْتُهَا قَالَهَا رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَلَاثًا - فَلَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ، نَحَرَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَلَاثًا وَسِتِّينَ بَدَنَةً، وَنَحَرَ عَلِيٌّ مَا غَبَرَ، وَكَانَتْ مِائَةَ بَدَنَةٍ، فَأَخَذَ مِنْ كُلِّ بَدَنَةٍ قِطْعَةً، فَطَبَخَ فَأَكَلَ هُوَ وَعَلِيٌّ، وَشَرِبَا مِنَ الْمَرَقَةِ، وَقَالَ سُرَاقَةُ بْنُ مَالِكِ بْنِ جُعْشُمٍ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، أَلِعَامِنَا هَذَا أَمْ لِلْأَبَدِ؟ قَالَ: لَا، بَلْ لِلْأَبَدِ، دَخَلَتِ الْعُمْرَةُ فِي الْحَجِّ وَشَبَّكَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ أَصَابِعِهِ».
hadiths.en: 1773 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Wuhayb ibn Khālid narrated to us: Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib narrated to us, from his father, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, who said: "The Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) stayed in Madinah for nine years without performing Ḥajj, then he announced to the people that he would perform Ḥajj, and many people came to Madinah wishing to go out with the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him). He set out, and when he reached Dhū al-Ḥulayfah, Asmāʾ bint ʿUmays gave birth to Muḥammad ibn Abī Bakr al-Ṣiddīq, and she sent to the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) to ask him. He said: Bathe, bind yourself with a cloth, then enter iḥrām. She did so. He said: When the chest of the camel of the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) settled upon the open plain of al-Baydāʾ, the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) declared the talbiyah, and we declared it, intending nothing but Ḥajj. Jābir said: I looked as far as my sight reached, before me, behind me, to my right and to my left, at people on foot and riding. We set out knowing nothing but Ḥajj, and the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) came saying: At Your service, O God, at Your service; at Your service, You have no partner, at Your service. Indeed all praise, blessing and sovereignty belong to You; You have no partner. So we set off knowing nothing but Ḥajj; for it we went out, with the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) among us, the Qur'an being revealed to him and he knowing its interpretation, acting only on what he was commanded, until we reached Makkah. The Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) began with the Stone, kissed/touched it, then circumambulated seven times, jogging in three of them and walking in four. Then he recited this verse: 'And take, [O believers], from the standing place of Abraham a place of prayer' (Qur'an 2:125). He prayed two units — my father said: and it was recommended to recite in them the two sūrahs of divine oneness, 'Say: O disbelievers' and 'Say: He is God, [who is] One,' though he did not mention that in Jābir's ḥadīth; then he returned to Jābir's ḥadīth — He said: Then he came to the Corner and touched it. Then he went out to al-Ṣafā, saying: We begin with what God began with. And he said: 'Indeed, al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah are among the symbols of God' (Qur'an 2:158). He climbed al-Ṣafā until the House appeared to him, and he said the takbīr three times and said: There is no god but God alone, with no partner; His is the sovereignty and His is the praise; He gives life and causes death; in His hand is all good, and He is over all things competent. Then he made supplication between these [repetitions]. Then he descended and walked until he reached the bottom of the valley, where he ran until he climbed out of the valley with his feet, then walked until he reached al-Marwah and climbed until the House appeared to him, and said the takbīr three times and said: There is no god but God alone, with no partner — as he had done at al-Ṣafā. Then he came down and said: Whoever has no sacrificial animal with him, let him come out of iḥrām and make it an ʿUmrah. If I had known at the start of my affair what I came to know later, I would have made it an ʿUmrah. So they came out of iḥrām. ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib arrived from Yemen and saw that the people had come out of iḥrām. The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said to him: With what intention did you enter iḥrām? He said: I said: O God, I have declared the same as Your Messenger has declared. He said: I have the sacrificial animal with me, so do not come out of iḥrām. Then ʿAlī entered upon Fāṭimah, who had applied kohl and put on dyed garments, and he disapproved of that. He said: Who commanded you to do this? She said: My father commanded me. — Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī said: ʿAlī used to narrate in Iraq: I went to the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) to complain about Fāṭimah because of what I had mentioned. He said: She has told the truth; I commanded her. The Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) said it three times. — When it was the Day of Sacrifice, the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) sacrificed sixty-three camels, and ʿAlī sacrificed the rest, which made one hundred camels. He took a piece from each camel and it was cooked, and he and ʿAlī ate of it and drank of the broth. Surāqah ibn Mālik ibn Juʿshum said: O Messenger of God, is this for this year of ours or for ever? He said: No, for ever. The ʿUmrah has entered into the Ḥajj — and the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) interlaced his fingers."

hadiths.ar: 1774 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «شَفَاعَتِي لِأَهْلِ الْكَبَائِرِ مِنْ أُمَّتِي»، قَالَ: فَقَالَ لِي جَابِرٌ: مَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكَبَائِرِ فَمَا لَهُ وَلِلشَّفَاعَةِ.
hadiths.en: 1774 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Muḥammad ibn Thābit narrated to us, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, who said: The Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) said: "My intercession is for those of my nation who committed major sins." He said: Jābir said to me: "Whoever is not among those who committed major sins, what need has he of intercession?"

sections.title_ar: مَا رَوَى عَنْهُ عَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ
sections.title_en: What Was Narrated from Jābir by ʿAbd Allāh ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAqīl

hadiths.ar: 1775 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ ، قَالَ: «مَشَيْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى امْرَأَةٍ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ، فَذَبَحَتْ لَهُ شَاةً، وَأَتَتْنَا بِالطَّعَامِ، فَأَكَلَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَكَلْنَا، ثُمَّ قُمْنَا إِلَى الظُّهْرِ، لَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ أَحَدٌ مِنَّا، ثُمَّ أَتَيْنَا بِبَقِيَّةِ الشَّاةِ، فَتَعَشَّيْنَا مِنْهَا، وَحَضَرَتِ الْعَصْرُ، فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقُمْنَا فَصَلَّيْنَا، لَمْ يَمَسَّ أَحَدٌ مِنَّا مَاءً».
hadiths.en: 1775 - Yūnus narrated to us: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Zāʾidah narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAqīl, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, who said: "I walked with the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) to a woman of the Anṣār, who slaughtered a sheep for him and brought us food.
