hadiths.en: 1873 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Khārijah ibn Muṣʿab narrated to us, from Ḥarām ibn ʿUthmān, from Abū ʿAtīq, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, that the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) said: "There is no continuous fasting (wiṣāl) in fasting."

hadiths.ar: 1874 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْيَمَانُ أَبُو حُذَيْفَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْسٍ ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «لَا وِصَالَ فِي الصَّوْمِ».
hadiths.en: 1874 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: al-Yamān Abū Ḥudhayfah narrated to us, from Abū ʿAbs, from Jābir, that the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) said: "There is no continuous fasting (wiṣāl) in fasting."

hadiths.ar: 1875 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ الْقَيْسِيُّ ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي يَشْكُرَ ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «غِفَارُ غَفَرَ اللهُ لَهَا، وَأَسْلَمُ سَالَمَهَا اللهُ».
hadiths.en: 1875 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: al-Ḥajjāj ibn Ḥassān al-Qaysī narrated to us, from a man of Banū Yashkur, from Jābir, who said: I heard the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) say: "Ghifār — may God forgive them; and Aslam — may God keep them safe."

hadiths.ar: 1876 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْيَمَانُ أَبُو حُذَيْفَةَ ، وَخَارِجَةُ بْنُ مُصْعَبٍ ، فَأَمَّا خَارِجَةُ فَحَدَّثَنَا عَنْ حَرَامِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ ، عَنْ أَبِي عَتِيقٍ ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ، وَأَمَّا الْيَمَانُ ، فَحَدَّثَنَا عَنْ أَبِي عَبْسٍ ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ  صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «لَا رَضَاعَ بَعْدَ فِصَالٍ، وَلَا يُتْمَ بَعْدَ احْتِلَامٍ، وَلَا عِتْقَ إِلَّا بَعْدَ مِلْكٍ، وَلَا طَلَاقَ إِلَّا بَعْدَ النِّكَاحِ، وَلَا يَمِينَ فِي قَطِيعَةٍ، وَلَا تَعَرُّبَ بَعْدَ هِجْرَةٍ، وَلَا هِجْرَةَ بَعْدَ الْفَتْحِ، وَلَا يَمِينَ لِوَلَدٍ مَعَ وَالِدٍ، وَلَا يَمِينَ لِامْرَأَةٍ مَعَ زَوْجٍ، وَلَا يَمِينَ لِعَبْدٍ مَعَ سَيِّدِهِ، وَلَا نَذْرَ فِي مَعْصِيَةِ اللهِ، وَلَوْ أَنَّ أَعْرَابِيًّا حَجَّ عَشْرَ حِجَجٍ ثُمَّ هَاجَرَ، كَانَتْ عَلَيْهِ حَجَّةٌ إِنِ اسْتَطَاعَ إِلَيْهِ سَبِيلًا، وَلَوْ أَنَّ صَبِيًّا حَجَّ عَشْرَ حِجَجٍ ثُمَّ احْتَلَمَ، كَانَتْ عَلَيْهِ حَجَّةٌ إِنِ اسْتَطَاعَ إِلَيْهِ سَبِيلًا، وَلَوْ أَنَّ عَبْدًا حَجَّ عَشْرَ حِجَجٍ ثُمَّ عُتِقَ، كَانَتْ عَلَيْهِ حَجَّةٌ إِنِ اسْتَطَاعَ إِلَيْهِ سَبِيلًا».
hadiths.en: 1876 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: al-Yamān Abū Ḥudhayfah and Khārijah ibn Muṣʿab narrated to us — as for Khārijah, he narrated to us from Ḥarām ibn ʿUthmān, from Abū ʿAtīq, from Jābir; and as for al-Yamān, he narrated to us from Abū ʿAbs, from Jābir — that the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) said: "There is no nursing after weaning, no orphanhood after puberty, no manumission except after ownership, no divorce except after marriage, no oath concerning the severing of kinship ties, no returning to Bedouin life after emigration, no emigration after the conquest, no oath of a child against his father, no oath of a wife against her husband, no oath of a slave against his master, and no vow in disobedience to God. If a Bedouin performed Ḥajj ten times and then emigrated, he would still owe a Ḥajj if he is able to find a way to it; if a child performed Ḥajj ten times and then reached puberty, he would still owe a Ḥajj if he is able to find a way to it; and if a slave performed Ḥajj ten times and then was freed, he would still owe a Ḥajj if he is able to find a way to it."

hadiths.ar: 1877 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ ، عَنْ نُبَيْحٍ الْعَنَزِيِّ ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «إِذَا غَابَ الرَّجُلُ فَلَا  يَأْتِي أَهْلَهُ طُرُوقًا».
hadiths.en: 1877 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from al-Aswad ibn Qays, from Nubayḥ al-ʿAnazī, from Jābir, that the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: "When a man has been away, let him not come to his family at night unexpectedly."

hadiths.ar: 1878 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ، «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمَّا أَصَابَهُ الْكَرْبُ يَوْمَ الْأَحْزَابِ، أَلْقَى رِدَاءَهُ، وَقَامَ مُتَجَرِّدًا، وَرَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ مَدًّا، وَدَعَا وَلَمْ يُصَلِّ قَالَ: ثُمَّ أَتَانَا، فَفَعَلَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ وَصَلَّى».
hadiths.en: 1878 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Ibn Abī Dhiʾb narrated to us, from a man of Banū Salimah, from Jābir: "When distress afflicted the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) on the day of the Confederates, he threw off his cloak, stood bare-shouldered, raised his hands outstretched and made supplication, and did not pray. He said: Then he came to us and did the same and prayed."

hadiths.ar: 1879 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو قَزَعَةَ الْبَاهِلِيُّ ، وَاسْمُهُ سُوَيْدُ بْنُ حُجَيْرٍ، عَنْ مُهَاجِرٍ الْمَكِّيِّ ، قَالَ: «قُلْتُ لِجَابِرٍ : الرَّجُلُ يَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ إِذَا نَظَرَ إِلَى الْكَعْبَةِ؟ قَالَ: مَا كُنْتُ أَرَى أَحَدًا يَفْعَلُ  هَذَا إِلَّا الْيَهُودَ، خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، أَفَكُنَّا نَفْعَلُهُ»؟.
hadiths.en: 1879 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Shuʿbah narrated to us, who said: Abū Qazaʿah al-Bāhilī, whose name is Suwayd ibn Ḥujayr, narrated to me, from Muhājir al-Makkī, who said: "I said to Jābir: May a man raise his hands when he sees the Kaʿbah? He said: I never saw anyone do this except the Jews. We went out with the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) — did we do it?"

hadiths.ar: 1880 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ ، عَنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ، قَالَ: «كُنَّا نُصَلِّي مَعَ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَغْرِبَ، ثُمَّ نَأْتِي بَنِي سَلِمَةَ، فَلَوْ رَمَيْنَا رَأَيْنَا مَوَاقِعَ نَبْلِنَا».
hadiths.en: 1880 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Ibn Abī Dhiʾb narrated to us, from Saʿīd ibn Abī Saʿīd al-Maqburī, from al-Qaʿqāʿ ibn Ḥakīm, from Jābir, who said: "We used to pray Maghrib with the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him), then go to Banū Salimah, and if we shot [an arrow], we could see where our arrows fell."

hadiths.ar: 1881 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عُتْبَةُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ ، عَنْ حَرْمَلَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُصَبِّحِ الْحِمْصِيِّ ، قَالَ:  «كُنَّا نَسِيرُ فِي صَائِفَةٍ، وَعَلَى النَّاسِ مَالِكُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللهِ الْخَثْعَمِيُّ، فَأَتَى عَلَى جَابِرٍ وَهُوَ يَمْشِي يَقُودُ بَغْلًا لَهُ، فَقَالَ لَهُ: أَلَا تَرْكَبُ وَقَدْ حَمَلَكَ اللهُ؟ فَقَالَ جَابِرٌ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: مَنِ اغْبَرَّتْ قَدَمَاهُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ عز وجل حَرَّمَهُ اللهُ عَلَى النَّارِ وَأُصْلِحُ لِي دَابَّتِي، وَأَسْتَغْنِي عَنْ قَوْمِي، فَوَثَبَ النَّاسُ عَنْ دَوَابِّهِمْ، فَمَا رَأَيْتُ نَازِلًا أَكْثَرَ مِنْ يَوْمِئِذٍ».
hadiths.en: 1881 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Mubārak narrated to us: ʿUtbah ibn Ḥakīm narrated to us, from Ḥarmalah, from Abū al-Muṣabbiḥ al-Ḥimṣī, who said: "We were marching on a summer campaign, with Mālik ibn ʿAbd Allāh al-Khathʿamī in command of the people. He came upon Jābir, who was walking, leading a mule of his, and said to him: Will you not ride, since God has provided you a mount? Jābir said: I heard the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) say: Whoever's feet become dusty in the cause of God, Mighty and Majestic, God will forbid him to the Fire. [Mālik said:] Fix my mount for me, and I do not need my people. The people leapt down from their mounts, and I never saw more people dismounted than on that day."

sections.title_ar: وَمَا رَوَى أَبُو سُفْيَانَ طَلْحَةُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ
sections.title_en: And What Abū Sufyān Ṭalḥah ibn Nāfiʿ Narrated from Jābir

hadiths.ar: 1882 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سَلَّامٌ ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «مَا مِنْ مُؤْمِنٍ وَلَا مُؤْمِنَةٍ، وَلَا مُسْلِمٍ وَلَا مُسْلِمَةٍ، يَمْرَضُ مَرَضًا، إِلَّا حَطَّ اللهُ عز وجل عَنْهُ خَطَايَاهُ».
hadiths.en: 1882 - Yūnus narrated to us: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Sallām narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, that the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) said: "There is no believing man or believing woman, nor Muslim man or Muslim woman, who falls ill with an illness except that God, Mighty and Majestic, removes their sins from them."

hadiths.ar: 1883 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْمُثَنَّى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا طَلْحَةُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ جَابِرًا ، يَقُولُ: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «إِنَّ الْخَلَّ نِعْمَ الْأُدُمُ هُوَ».
hadiths.en: 1883 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: al-Muthannā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us: Ṭalḥah ibn Nāfiʿ narrated to us, who said: I heard Jābir say: The Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) said: "Vinegar is an excellent condiment."

hadiths.ar: 1884 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سَلَّامٌ ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ، «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ عَلَى أُمِّ مُبَشِّرٍ وَهِيَ فِي نَخْلٍ لَهَا، فَقَالَ: مَنْ غَرَسَ هَذَا، أَكَافِرٌ أَمْ مُؤْمِنٌ؟ فَقَالَتْ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، بَلْ مُؤْمِنٌ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: مَا مِنْ مُؤْمِنٍ يَغْرِسُ غَرْسًا أَوْ يَزْرَعُ زَرْعًا، فَتَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ بَهِيمَةٌ أَوْ سَبُعٌ أَوْ طَيْرٌ، إِلَّا كَانَ لَهُ صَدَقَةً».
hadiths.en: 1884 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Sallām narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir: "The Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) entered upon Umm Mubashshir while she was in a palm grove of hers and said: Who planted this, a disbeliever or a believer? She said: O Messenger of God, a believer. The Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) said: There is no believer who plants a plant or sows a crop and then a beast, a predator or a bird eats from it, except that it is charity for him."

hadiths.ar: 1885 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سَلَّامٌ ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّ أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ يَأْكُلُونَ فِيهَا، وَيَشْرَبُونَ، لَا يَتْفُلُونَ، وَلَا يَمْتَخِطُونَ، وَلَا يَبُولُونَ، وَلَا يَتَغَوَّطُونَ، إِنَّمَا حَاجَةُ أَحَدِهِمْ جُشَاءٌ، رِيحُ كَرِيحِ الْمِسْكِ».
hadiths.en: 1885 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Sallām narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, who said: The Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) said: "The people of Paradise will eat and drink in it; they will not spit, blow their noses, urinate or defecate. Rather, their need will be a belch, [with] a scent like the scent of musk."

hadiths.ar: 1886 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سَلَّامٌ ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ، «أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، أَيُّ الْإِسْلَامِ خَيْرٌ؟ قَالَ: أَنْ يَسْلَمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِكَ وَيَدِكَ أَوْ قَالَ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ قَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، فَأَيُّ الشُّهَدَاءِ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ: أَنْ يُعْقَرَ جَوَادُكَ وَيُهَرَاقَ دَمُكَ. قَالَ: فَأَيُّ الصَّلَاةِ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ: طُولُ الْقُنُوتِ».
hadiths.en: 1886 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Sallām narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir: "A man said: O Messenger of God, which Islam is best? He said: That Muslims be safe from your tongue and hand — or he said: Whoever from whose tongue and hand Muslims are safe. He said: O Messenger of God, which martyrs are most excellent? He said: One whose horse is hamstrung and whose blood is spilled. He said: Which prayer is most excellent? He said: Long standing in devotion (qunūt)."

hadiths.ar: 1887 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ، «أَنَّ أَهْلَ الطَّائِفِ قَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، إِنَّ أَرْضَنَا أَرْضٌ بَارِدَةٌ، فَمَا يُجْزِئُنَا مِنْ غُسْلِ الْجَنَابَةِ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: أَمَّا أَنَا فَأُفْرِغُ عَلَى رَأْسِي ثَلَاثًا».
hadiths.en: 1887 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Hushaym narrated to us, from Abū Bishr, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir: "The people of Ṭāʾif said: O Messenger of God, our land is a cold land, so what suffices us for the bath of sexual impurity? The Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) said: As for me, I pour water over my head three times."

hadiths.ar: 1888 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سَلَّامٌ ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ ، قَالَ: «سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ قَبْلَ مَوْتِهِ بِثَلَاثٍ: لَا يَمُوتَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَّا وَهُوَ يُحْسِنُ الظَّنَّ بِاللهِ عز وجل».
hadiths.en: 1888 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Sallām narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, who said: "I heard the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) say three days before his death: Let none of you die except while thinking well of God, Mighty and Majestic."

sections.title_ar: وَمَا رَوَى نُبَيْحٌ الْعَنَزِيُّ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ
sections.title_en: And What Nubayḥ al-ʿAnazī Narrated from Jābir

hadiths.ar: 1889 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ نُبَيْحًا الْعَنَزِيَّ ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ جَابِرٍ ، «أَنَّ قَتْلَى أُحُدٍ حُمِلُوا حِينَ قُتِلُوا مِنْ مَضَاجِعِهِمْ، فَنَادَى مُنَادِي النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ رُدُّوا الْقَتْلَى إِلَى مَضَاجِعِهَا وَقَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ مَرَّةً: إِلَى مَصَارِعِهَا. قَالَ: فَلَمَّا وَفَّيْتُ الرَّجُلَ التَّمْرَ الَّذِي كَانَ لَهُ عَلَى أَبِي، جِئْتُ أَسْعَى كَأَنِّي شَرَارَةٌ».
hadiths.en: 1889 - Yūnus narrated to us: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from al-Aswad ibn Qays, who said: I heard Nubayḥ al-ʿAnazī narrating from Jābir: "The slain of Uḥud were carried from their resting places when they were killed, and the Prophet's (peace and blessings be upon him) announcer called out that the slain should be returned to their resting places" — and Abū Dāwūd once said: to their places of falling. He said: "When I had paid the man the dates that were owed to him by my father, I came hurrying as though I were a spark."

sections.title_ar: وَمَا رَوَى سَعِيدُ بْنُ مِينَا، عَنْ جَابِرٍ
sections.title_en: And What Saʿīd ibn Mīnāʾ Narrated from Jābir

hadiths.ar: 1890 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سَلِيمُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ مِينَا ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم «نَهَى عَنْ بَيْعِ الثَّمَرَةِ حَتَّى تُشَقِّحَ قِيلَ: وَمَا تُشَقِّحُ؟ قَالَ: تَحْمَرُّ وَتَصْفَرُّ».
hadiths.en: 1890 - Yūnus narrated to us: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Sulaym ibn Ḥayyān narrated to us, from Saʿīd ibn Mīnāʾ, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, that the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) "forbade selling fruit until it turns reddish or yellowish (tushaqqiḥ). It was said: What is tushaqqiḥ? He said: It turns red and yellow."

hadiths.ar: 1891 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سَلِيمُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ الْهُذَلِيُّ ،  قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مِينَا الْمَكِّيُّ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللهِ ، يَقُولُ: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «نَهَى عَنِ الْمُحَاقَلَةِ وَالْمُزَابَنَةِ وَالْمُخَابَرَةِ».
hadiths.en: 1891 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Sulaym ibn Ḥayyān al-Hudhalī narrated to us: Saʿīd ibn Mīnāʾ al-Makkī narrated to us, who said: I heard Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh say: The Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) "forbade muḥāqalah, muzābanah and mukhābarah."

hadiths.ar: 1892 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سَلِيمُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ مِينَا ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «كَبَّرَ عَلَى النَّجَاشِيِّ أَرْبَعًا».
hadiths.en: 1892 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Sulaym ibn Ḥayyān narrated to us, from Saʿīd ibn Mīnāʾ, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh al-Anṣārī, that the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) "said the takbīr four times over al-Najāshī."

hadiths.ar: 1893 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سَلِيمُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ مِينَا ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّمَا مَثَلِي وَمَثَلُكُمْ كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ أَوْقَدَ نَارًا، فَجَاءَتِ الْجَنَادِبُ وَالْفَرَاشُ يَقَعْنَ فِيهَا، وَهُوَ يَذُبُّهُنَّ عَنْهَا، وَأَنَا آخِذٌ بِحُجَزِكُمْ أَنْ تَهَافَتُوا فِي النَّارِ، وَأَنْتُمْ تَفَلَّتُونَ مِنْ يَدِي».
hadiths.en: 1893 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Sulaym ibn Ḥayyān narrated to us, from Saʿīd ibn Mīnāʾ, from Jābir, who said: The Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) said: "My likeness and your likeness is that of a man who kindled a fire, and locusts and moths came and began to fall into it while he tried to drive them away from it. I am taking hold of your waists to keep you from tumbling into the Fire, while you slip from my hands."

hadiths.ar: 1894 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سَلِيمُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ مِينَا ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَثَلِي وَمَثَلُ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ، كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ بَنَى دَارًا، فَأَكْمَلَهَا وَأَحْسَنَهَا، إِلَّا مَوْضِعَ لَبِنَةٍ، فَكَانَ مَنْ دَخَلَهَا وَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهَا قَالَ: مَا أَحْسَنَهَا إِلَّا مَوْضِعَ هَذِهِ اللَّبِنَةِ! فَأَنَا مَوْضِعُ اللَّبِنَةِ، خُتِمَ بِيَ الْأَنْبِيَاءُ».
hadiths.en: 1894 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Sulaym ibn Ḥayyān narrated to us, from Saʿīd ibn Mīnāʾ, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, who said: The Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) said: "My likeness and the likeness of the prophets is that of a man who built a house and completed it and made it beautiful, except for the place of one brick. Whoever entered it and looked at it would say: How beautiful it is, except for the place of this brick! I am the place of the brick; the prophets were sealed with me."

sections.title_ar: وَمَا رَوَى عَامِرٌ الشَّعْبِيُّ عَنْ جَابِرٍ
sections.title_en: And What ʿĀmir al-Shaʿbī Narrated from Jābir

hadiths.ar: 1895 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ سَيَّارٍ ، سَمِعَ الشَّعْبِيَّ ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم «نَهَى أَنْ يَطْرُقَ الرَّجُلُ أَهْلَهُ لَيْلًا؛ حَتَّى تَمْتَشِطَ الشَّعِثَةُ، وَتَسْتَحِدَّ الْمُغِيبَةُ».
hadiths.en: 1895 - Yūnus narrated to us: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Sayyār, who heard al-Shaʿbī, from Jābir, that the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) "forbade a man to come to his family at night [unexpectedly], until the disheveled woman has combed her hair and the woman whose husband was absent has shaved [her pubic hair]."

hadiths.ar: 1896 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي عَاصِمٌ الْأَحْوَلُ ، قَالَ: قَرَأْتُ عَلَى الشَّعْبِيِّ كِتَابًا عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ فِيهِ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم «نَهَى أَنْ تُنْكَحَ الْمَرْأَةُ عَلَى عَمَّتِهَا وَعَلَى خَالَتِهَا»، قَالَ الشَّعْبِيُّ: سَمِعْتُ هَذَا مِنْ جَابِرٍ.
hadiths.en: 1896 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Shuʿbah narrated to us, who said: ʿĀṣim al-Aḥwal informed me, who said: I read to al-Shaʿbī a letter from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh in which it said that the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) "forbade a woman to be married together with her paternal aunt or her maternal aunt." Al-Shaʿbī said: I heard this from Jābir.

hadiths.ar: 1897 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ ، قَالَ: «بِعْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعِيرًا، فَأَفْقَرَنِي ظَهْرَهُ سَفَرِي إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ».
hadiths.en: 1897 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Sharīk narrated to us, from al-Mughīrah, from al-Shaʿbī, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, who said: "I sold a camel to the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him), and he allowed me the use of its back for my journey to Madinah."

sections.title_ar: وَمَا رَوَى يَزِيدُ بْنُ صُهَيْبٍ الْفَقِيرُ عَنْ جَابِرٍ
sections.title_en: And What Yazīd ibn Ṣuhayb al-Faqīr Narrated from Jābir

hadiths.ar: 1898 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ صُهَيْبٍ الْفَقِيرِ ، قَالَ: «سَأَلْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللهِ عَنِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ فِي السَّفَرِ أَقْصُرُهُمَا؟ قَالَ جَابِرٌ: إِنَّ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ فِي السَّفَرِ لَيْسَتَا بِقَصْرٍ، إِنَّمَا الْقَصْرُ رَكْعَةٌ عِنْدَ الْقِتَالِ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ أَنْشَأَ يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّهُ كَانَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَ الْقِتَالِ، إِذْ حَضَرَتِ الصَّلَاةُ، فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَصَفَّ طَائِفَةً خَلْفَهُ، وَقَامَتْ طَائِفَةٌ وُجُوهُهَا قِبَلَ وُجُوهِ الْعَدُوِّ، فَصَلَّى بِهِمْ رَكْعَةً، وَسَجَدَ بِهِمْ سَجْدَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ صَلَّوْا خَلْفَهُ انْطَلَقُوا فَقَامُوا مَقَامَ أُولَئِكَ، فَجَاءَ أُولَئِكَ فَصَفُّوا خَلْفَ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَصَلَّى بِهِمْ رَكْعَةً، وَسَجَدَ بِهِمْ سَجْدَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَلَسَ، فَسَلَّمَ وَسَلَّمَ الَّذِينَ خَلْفَهُ، وَسَلَّمُوا أُولَئِكَ، فَكَانَتْ لِرَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم  رَكْعَتَيْنِ، وَلِلْقَوْمِ رَكْعَةً رَكْعَةً ثُمَّ قَرَأَ يَزِيدُ: {وَإِذَا كُنْتَ فِيهِمْ فَأَقَمْتَ لَهُمُ الصَّلاةَ}».
hadiths.en: 1898 - Yūnus narrated to us: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: al-Masʿūdī narrated to us, from Yazīd ibn Ṣuhayb al-Faqīr, who said: "I asked Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh about the two units on a journey: is it a shortening? Jābir said: The two units on a journey are not a shortening; the shortening is one unit during fighting. He said: Then he began to narrate that he was with the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) during fighting when the prayer time came. The Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) stood and arranged one group behind him, while another group stood facing the enemy. He prayed one unit with them and prostrated twice with them. Then those who had prayed behind him went and took the place of the others, and those came and lined up behind the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him), and he prayed one unit with them and prostrated twice with them. Then the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) sat and gave the salām, and those behind him gave the salām, and those others gave the salām. So the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) had two units, and the people one unit each. Then Yazīd recited: 'And when you [O Prophet] are among them and lead them in prayer...' (Qur'an 4:102)."

sections.title_en: And What Mujāhid Narrated from Jābir

hadiths.ar: 1899 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ الضَّحَّاكِ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الضَّبِّيُّ ، عَنْ أَبِي يَحْيَى الْقَتَّاتِ ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مِفْتَاحُ الصَّلَاةِ الْوُضُوءُ، وَمِفْتَاحُ الْجَنَّةِ الصَّلَاةُ».
hadiths.en: 1899 - Yūnus narrated to us: Ibrāhīm ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn al-Ḍaḥḥāk narrated to us: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Sulaymān ibn Muʿādh al-Ḍabbī narrated to us, from Abū Yaḥyā al-Qattāt, from Mujāhid, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, who said: The Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) said: "The key to prayer is ablution, and the key to Paradise is prayer."

hadiths.ar: 1900 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُتْبَةَ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ صُهَيْبٍ ، قَالَ: «رَأَيْتُ وَهْبَ بْنَ كَيْسَانَ يَسْجُدُ عَلَى قِصَاصِ الشَّعَرِ، قَالَ: فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي جَابِرٌ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَفْعَلُهُ».
hadiths.en: 1900 - Yūnus narrated to us: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Abū ʿUtbah narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Ḥamzah ibn Ṣuhayb, who said: "I saw Wahb ibn Kaysān prostrating on the hairline of his forehead. He said: I asked him about that, and he said: Jābir narrated to me that the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) used to do it."

hadiths.ar: 1901 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا نَضْرَةَ يَقُولُ: «قُلْتُ لِجَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ: إِنَّ ابْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ يَنْهَى عَنِ الْمُتْعَةِ، وَإِنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ يَأْمُرُ بِهَا، قَالَ جَابِرٌ : عَلَى يَدَيَّ دَارَ الْحَدِيثُ، تَمَتَّعْنَا عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا كَانَ عُمَرُ خَطَبَ فَقَالَ: إِنَّ اللهَ عز وجل كَانَ يُحِلُّ لِنَبِيِّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا شَاءَ، وَإِنَّ الْقُرْآنَ قَدْ نَزَلَ مَنَازِلَهُ، فَافْصِلُوا حَجَّكُمْ مِنْ عُمْرَتِكُمْ، وَأَبِتُّوا نِكَاحَ هَذِهِ النِّسَاءِ، فَلَا أُوتَى بِرَجُلٍ تَزَوَّجَ امْرَأَةً إِلَى أَجَلٍ إِلَّا رَجَمْتُهُ».
hadiths.en: 1901 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, who said: I heard Abū Naḍrah say: "I said to Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh: Ibn al-Zubayr forbids the Mutʿah, while Ibn ʿAbbās commands it. Jābir said: The ḥadīth passed through my hands: we performed the Mutʿah in the time of the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him). When ʿUmar became caliph, he gave a sermon and said: God, Mighty and Majestic, used to permit His Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) whatever He willed, and the Qur'an has come down to its proper places, so separate your Ḥajj from your ʿUmrah, and finalize the marriages of these women [in the right way]; I will not be brought a man who married a woman for a fixed term but I will stone him."

hadiths.ar: 1902 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الصَّلْتُ بْنُ دِينَارٍ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نَضْرَةَ ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ، قَالَ: «مَرَّ طَلْحَةُ بِالنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: شَهِيدٌ يَمْشِي عَلَى ظَهْرِ الْأَرْضِ».
hadiths.en: 1902 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: al-Ṣalt ibn Dīnār narrated to us: Abū Naḍrah narrated to us, from Jābir, who said: "Ṭalḥah passed by the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him), and he said: A martyr walking on the face of the earth."

hadiths.ar: 1903 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الصَّلْتُ بْنُ دِينَارٍ ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّ أَعْمَالَكُمْ تُعْرَضُ عَلَى عَشَائِرِكُمْ وَأَقْرِبَائِكُمْ فِي قُبُورِهِمْ، فَإِنْ كَانَ خَيْرًا اسْتَبْشَرُوا بِهِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ قَالُوا: اللَّهُمَّ أَلْهِمْهُمْ أَنْ يَعْمَلُوا بِطَاعَتِكَ».
hadiths.en: 1903 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: al-Ṣalt ibn Dīnār narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, who said: The Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) said: "Your deeds are presented to your clans and relatives in their graves. If they are good, they rejoice at it, and if they are otherwise, they say: O God, inspire them to act in obedience to You."

hadiths.ar: 1904 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ الْيَشْكُرِيِّ ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ، قَالَ: «نَحَرْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ سَبْعِينَ بَقَرَةً أَوْ سَبْعِينَ بَدَنَةً؛ الْبَقَرَةُ عَنْ سَبْعَةٍ».
hadiths.en: 1904 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, from Abū Bishr, from Sulaymān al-Yashkurī, from Jābir, who said: "We sacrificed with the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) on the day of al-Ḥudaybiyah seventy cows or seventy camels — a cow for seven."

hadiths.ar: 1905 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ ، عَنْ نَصْرِ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «نَهَى أَنْ يُجَصَّصَ الْقَبْرُ أَوْ يُبْنَى عَلَيْهِ».
hadiths.en: 1905 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Mubārak ibn Faḍālah narrated to us, from Naṣr ibn Rāshid, from Jābir, that the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) "forbade plastering a grave or building over it."

hadiths.ar: 1906 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سَلَّامٌ ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي كَرِبٍ ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «وَيْلٌ لِلْعَرَاقِيبِ مِنَ النَّارِ».
hadiths.en: 1906 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Sallām narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from Saʿīd ibn Abī Karib, from Jābir, who said: I heard the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) say: "Woe to the heels from the Fire."

hadiths.ar: 1907 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ ثَوْبَانَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي جَابِرٌ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «كَانَ يُصَلِّي عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ نَحْوَ الْمَشْرِقِ تَطَوُّعًا، فَإِذَا أَرَادَ الْمَكْتُوبَةَ نَزَلَ فَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ».
hadiths.en: 1907 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Hishām narrated to us, from Yaḥyā ibn Abī Kathīr, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Thawbān, who said: Jābir narrated to me, that the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) "used to pray voluntary prayers on his mount toward the east, and when he wanted to pray an obligatory prayer he would dismount and face the qiblah."

hadiths.ar: 1908 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ ، عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ، «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَكَلَ عِنْدَهُمْ رُطَبًا وَشَرِبَ مَاءً، وَقَالَ: هَذَا مِنَ النَّعِيمِ الَّذِي تُسْأَلُونَ عَنْهُ».
hadiths.en: 1908 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Ḥammād narrated to us, from ʿAmmār ibn Abī ʿAmmār, from Jābir: "The Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) ate fresh dates with them and drank water, and said: This is of the blessings about which you will be asked."

hadiths.ar: 1909 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ سُرَاقَةَ ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «كَانَ يُصَلِّي فِي غَزْوَةٍ قِبَلَ الْمَشْرِقِ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ».
hadiths.en: 1909 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Ibn Abī Dhiʾb narrated to us, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Surāqah, from Jābir, that the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) "prayed on a military expedition toward the east on his mount."

hadiths.ar: 1910 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا خَارِجَةُ بْنُ مُصْعَبٍ ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللهِ بْنِ مِقْسَمٍ ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ، قَالَ: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَغْتَسِلُ بِالصَّاعِ فَقَالَ لَهُ ابْنُ الْحَنَفِيَّةِ: إِنَّ شَعَرِي كَثِيرٌ، فَقَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَكْثَرَ شَعَرًا مِنْكَ وَأَطْيَبَ».
hadiths.en: 1910 - Abū Dāwūd narrated to us: Khārijah ibn Muṣʿab narrated to us, from Zayd ibn Aslam, from ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Miqsam, from Jābir, who said: "The Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) used to bathe with a ṣāʿ. Ibn al-Ḥanafiyyah said to him: My hair is thick. He said: The Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) had more hair than you and was better."

sections.title_ar: وَمَا أَسْنَدَ عَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رحمه الله عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
sections.title_en: What Abdullah ibn Umar ibn al-Khattab, may Allah have mercy on him, narrated from the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)

sections.title_ar: مَا رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ
sections.title_en: What Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Husayn narrated from Abdullah ibn Umar

hadiths.ar: 1911 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ ، قَالَ: «بَيْنَمَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ يُحَدِّثُ وَابْنُ عُمَرَ عِنْدَهُ، فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَيْرٍ فِي حَدِيثِهِ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ  صلى الله عليه وسلم: مَثَلُ الْمُنَافِقِ كَشَاةٍ بَيْنَ رَبَضَيْنِ، إِذَا أَتَتْ هَؤُلَاءِ نَطَحَتْهَا، وَإِنْ أَتَتْ هَؤُلَاءِ نَطَحَتْهَا فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ : لَيْسَ كَذَاكَ، إِنَّمَا قَالَ: بَيْنَ غَنَمَيْنِ فَاخْتَلَفَا فِي غَنَمَيْنِ وَ رَبَضَيْنِ، فَاخْتَلَطَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ، وَقَالَ: لَوْلَا أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ أَقُلْ».
hadiths.en: Yunus told us: Abu Dawud told us: al-Mas'udi told us: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Husayn told us, he said: “While Ubayd ibn Umayr was narrating, and Ibn Umar was with him, Ibn Umayr said in his narration: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: ‘The likeness of the hypocrite is that of a sheep between two pens (rabadayn): when it goes to this one, it butts it, and when it goes to that one, it butts it.’ Ibn Umar said: ‘It is not so; he only said: between two flocks (ghanamayn).’ They differed over ‘two flocks’ and ‘two pens’, and Ibn Umar became confused, and said: ‘Had I not heard the Prophet (ﷺ), I would not have said it.’”

sections.title_ar: مَا رَوَى سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ
sections.title_en: What Salim ibn Abdullah narrated from his father

hadiths.ar: 1912 - قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ ، عَنْ نَوْفَلٍ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «مَنْ تَرَكَ الصَّلَاةَ فَكَأَنَّمَا وُتِرَ أَهْلَهُ وَمَالَهُ». قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ: فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِسَالِمٍ ، فَقَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: مَنْ تَرَكَ صَلَاةَ الْعَصْرِ … .
hadiths.en: He said: Ibn Abi Dhi'b told us, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Bakr ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Harith ibn Hisham, from Nawfal, who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: “Whoever neglects the prayer, it is as if he has been robbed of his family and his wealth.” Al-Zuhri said: I mentioned that to Salim, and he said: My father narrated to me that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Whoever misses the ʿAsr prayer … .

hadiths.ar: 1913 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «إِذَا مَرَّتْ بِأَحَدِكُمْ جِنَازَةٌ فَلْيَقُمْ حَتَّى تُخَلِّفَهُ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Ibn Abi Dhi'b told us, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from Ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “When a funeral passes by any one of you, let him stand until it has gone past him.”

hadiths.ar: 1914 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَنْ بَاعَ نَخْلًا قَدْ أُبِّرَتْ، فَلَمْ يَشْتَرِطِ الْمُشْتَرِي الثَّمَرَةَ، فَلَا شَيْءَ لَهُ، وَمَنْ بَاعَ عَبْدًا وَلَهُ مَالٌ فَلَمْ يَشْتَرِطْ مَالَهُ، فَلَا شَيْءَ لَهُ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Ibn Abi Dhi'b told us, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from Ibn Umar, who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Whoever sells palm trees that have been pollinated, and the buyer does not stipulate the fruit, then he has no claim to it; and whoever sells a slave who has property, and the buyer does not stipulate his property, then he has no claim to it.”

hadiths.ar: 1915 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، «أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، مَا يَلْبَسُ الْمُحْرِمُ؟ قَالَ: لَا يَلْبَسُ الْقَمِيصَ، وَلَا الْعِمَامَةَ، وَلَا السَّرَاوِيلَ، وَلَا ثَوْبًا مَسَّهُ وَرْسٌ وَلَا زَعْفَرَانٌ، وَلَا يَلْبَسُ الْخُفَّيْنِ، إِلَّا أَنْ لَا يَجِدَ نَعْلَيْنِ فَيَقْطَعَهُمَا إِلَى أَسْفَلَ مِنَ الْكَعْبَيْنِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Ibn Abi Dhi'b told us, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from Ibn Umar: “A man said: O Messenger of Allah, what may the muhrim (pilgrim in ihram) wear? He said: He may not wear the shirt, nor the turban, nor trousers, nor any garment touched by wars or saffron, and he may not wear leather socks unless he cannot find sandals, in which case he should cut them down to below the ankles.”

hadiths.ar: 1916 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «لَا تَبْتَاعُوا الثِّمَارَ حَتَّى يَبْدُوَ صَلَاحُهَا».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Ibrahim ibn Sa'd told us, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from Ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Do not buy fruit until its ripeness is evident.”

hadiths.ar: 1917 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ سَعْدٍ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «إِنَّ الَّذِي تَفُوتُهُ صَلَاةُ الْعَصْرِ كَأَنَّمَا وُتِرَ أَهْلَهُ وَمَالَهُ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Ibn Sa'd told us, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from Ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “The one who misses the ʿAsr prayer, it is as if he has been robbed of his family and his wealth.”

hadiths.ar: 1918 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ سَعْدٍ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، قَالَ: «أُوتِيَ نَبِيُّكُمْ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَفَاتِيحَ الْغَيْبِ إِلَّا الْخَمْسَ، ثُمَّ تَلَا هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ: {إِنَّ اللهَ عِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ} إِلَى آخِرِهَا».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Ibn Sa'd told us, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from Ibn Umar, who said: “Your Prophet (ﷺ) was given the keys of the unseen except the five.” Then he recited this verse: {Indeed, Allah has knowledge of the Hour} to its end.

hadiths.ar: 1919 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ سَعْدٍ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «صُومُوا لِرُؤْيَتِهِ، وَأَفْطِرُوا لِرُؤْيَتِهِ، فَإِنْ غُمَّ عَلَيْكُمْ فَاقْدُرُوا لَهُ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Ibn Sa'd told us, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from Ibn Umar, who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Fast when you see it (the crescent), and break your fast when you see it; and if it is overcast for you, then estimate it.”

hadiths.ar: 1920 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ سَعْدٍ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «رَأَيْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمُوسَى وَعِيسَى - صَلَوَاتُ اللهِ عَلَيْهِمْ - بِبَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ - يَعْنِي حَيْثُ أُسْرِيَ بِهِ - فَرَأَيْتُ مُوسَى رَجُلًا ضَرْبًا آدَمَ بَيْنَ الرَّجُلَيْنِ، كَأَنَّهُ مِنْ رِجَالِ شَنُوءَةَ، وَرَأَيْتُ عِيسَى رَجُلًا أَحْمَرَ كَأَنَّمَا أُخْرِجَ مِنْ  دِيمَاسٍ، وَأَنَا أَشْبَهُ بَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ بِهِ، وَأُتِيتُ بِإِنَاءِ خَمْرٍ وَإِنَاءِ لَبَنٍ، فَأَخَذْتُ اللَّبَنَ، فَقَالَ جِبْرِيلُ عليه السلام: هُدِيتَ لِلْفِطْرَةِ، لَوْ أَخَذْتَ الْخَمْرَ غَوَتْ أُمَّتُكَ». قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ: فَكَانَ سَعِيدٌ يُحَدِّثُنَا هَذَا، وَقَدْ أَخْبَرَنَا سَالِمٌ أَنَّ أَبَاهُ قَالَ: وَاللهِ مَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِعِيسَى: أَحْمَرُ وَلَكِنَّهُ قَالَ: لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنِي فِي الْمَنَامِ كَأَنِّي أَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ، فَرَأَيْتُ عِيسَى رَجُلًا بَيْنَ الرَّجُلَيْنِ، كَأَنَّ رَأْسَهُ يَنْطِفُ مَاءً، أَوْ يُهَرَاقُ مَاءً، فَالْتَفَتُّ فَإِذَا رَجُلٌ أَحْمَرُ، جَعْدُ الرَّأْسِ أَعْوَرُ الْعَيْنِ الْيُمْنَى، كَأَنَّ عَيْنَهُ عِنَبَةٌ طَافِيَةٌ، فَقِيلَ: هَذَا الدَّجَّالُ، أَقْرَبُ النَّاسِ شَبَهًا بِابْنِ قَطَنٍ الْخُزَاعِيِّ مِنْ بَنِي الْمُصْطَلِقِ. قَالَ  الزُّهْرِيُّ: وَتُوُفِّيَ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ.
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Ibn Sa'd told us, from al-Zuhri, who said: Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib informed me, he said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “I saw Ibrahim, Musa and Isa — may the blessings of Allah be upon them — at Bayt al-Maqdis, meaning when he was taken on the Night Journey. I saw Musa as a man of medium build, brown-skinned, between the two (tall and short), as if he were one of the men of Shanu'ah. And I saw Isa as a ruddy man, as if he had just come out of a bathhouse (dimas), and I am the one who most resembles the descendants of Ibrahim. And I was brought a vessel of wine and a vessel of milk, and I took the milk. Jibril (peace be upon him) said: You have been guided to the fitrah; had you taken the wine, your community would have gone astray.” Al-Zuhri said: Sa'id used to narrate this to us, but Salim informed us that his father said: “By Allah, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not say about Isa that he was ‘ruddy’; rather he said: I saw myself in a dream as if I were circumambulating the House, and I saw a man between the two (tall and short) whose head seemed to drip water, or water was being poured from it. I turned, and there was a ruddy man, with curly hair, blind in the right eye, as if his eye were a floating grape. It was said: This is the Dajjal. The closest of people in resemblance to him is Ibn Qatan al-Khuza'i of Banu al-Mustaliq.” Al-Zuhri said: He died in the Jahiliyyah (pre-Islamic era).

hadiths.ar: 1921 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «أُسَامَةُ أَحَبُّ النَّاسِ إِلَيَّ وَلَمْ يَسْتَثْنِ فَاطِمَةَ وَلَا غَيْرَهَا».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammad ibn Salamah told us, from Musa ibn Uqbah, from Salim, from his father, who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: “Usamah is the most beloved of people to me,” and he did not except Fatimah or anyone else.

hadiths.ar: 1922 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا زَمْعَةُ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لَا يُلْدَغُ مُؤْمِنٌ مِنْ جُحْرٍ مَرَّتَيْنِ». قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ : لَا يُعَاقَبُ عَلَى ذَنْبِهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا فَيُعَاقِبُهُ فِي الْآخِرَةِ.
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Zam'ah told us, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from Ibn Umar, who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “A believer is not stung from the same hole twice.” Abu Dawud said: (Meaning) he is not punished for his sin in this world and then punished for it again in the Hereafter.

hadiths.ar: 1923 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا زَمْعَةُ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّ اللهَ عز وجل يَنْهَاكُمْ أَنْ تَحْلِفُوا بِآبَائِكُمْ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: فَمَا حَلَفْتُ بِهَا مُنْذُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ هَذَا؛ ذَاكِرًا وَلَا نَاسِيًا».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Zam'ah told us, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from Ibn Umar, who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Indeed Allah, Mighty and Majestic, forbids you to swear by your fathers.” Umar said: “I have not sworn by them since I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say this, neither intentionally nor forgetfully.”

hadiths.ar: 1924 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا زَمْعَةُ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، قَالَ: «صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِنًى صَلَاةَ السَّفَرِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى أَبُو بَكْرٍ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى بَعْدَهُ عُمَرُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى بَعْدَهُ عُثْمَانُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ إِنَّ عُثْمَانَ أَتَمَّ بَعْدُ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Zam'ah told us, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from Ibn Umar, who said: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prayed the travelers' prayer at Mina, two rak'ahs; then Abu Bakr prayed two rak'ahs; then after him Umar prayed two rak'ahs; then after him Uthman prayed two rak'ahs; then later Uthman completed the prayer (four rak'ahs).”

hadiths.ar: 1925 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، أَوْ غَيْرِهِ ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ - شَكَّ أَبُو دَاوُدَ - عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، قَالَ: «إِنْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيَأْمُرُنَا بِالتَّخْفِيفِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ لَيَؤُمُّنَا فِي الصُّبْحِ بِالصَّافَّاتِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Ibn Abi Dhi'b told us, from al-Zuhri or someone else, from Salim — Abu Dawud was uncertain — from Ibn Umar, who said: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to command us to make the prayer brief, and he used to lead us in the dawn prayer with (Surah) al-Saffat.”

hadiths.ar: 1926 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، قَالَ: «رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبَا بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ يَمْشُونَ أَمَامَ الْجِنَازَةِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah told us, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from Ibn Umar, who said: “I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), Abu Bakr and Umar walking in front of the funeral.”

hadiths.ar: 1927 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، قَالَ: «سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ: مَنْ جَاءَ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ فَلْيَغْتَسِلْ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Abd al-Aziz ibn Abi Salamah told us, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from Ibn Umar, who said: “I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the pulpit saying: Whoever comes to the Friday prayer, let him bathe.”

hadiths.ar: 1928 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «إِنَّ بِلَالًا يُؤَذِّنُ بِلَيْلٍ، فَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّى يُؤَذِّنَ ابْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ قَالَ: وَكَانَ  ضَرِيرًا، فَكَانَ يُقَالُ لَهُ: أَذِّنْ فَقَدْ أَصْبَحْتَ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Abd al-Aziz ibn Abi Salamah told us, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from Ibn Umar, that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: “Bilal calls the adhan during the night, so eat and drink until Ibn Umm Maktum calls the adhan.” He said: He was blind, and it would be said to him: “Call the adhan, for it is already morning.”

hadiths.ar: 1929 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ سَعْدٍ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم. قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنَا صَخْرُ بْنُ جُوَيْرِيَةَ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «إِنَّمَا مَثَلُكُمْ وَقَالَ ابْنُ سَعْدٍ: إِنَّمَا بَقَاؤُكُمْ فِيمَنْ مَضَى مِنَ الْأُمَمِ  قَبْلَكُمْ كَمَا بَيْنَ صَلَاةِ الْعَصْرِ إِلَى غُرُوبِ الشَّمْسِ، أُوتِيَ أَهْلُ التَّوْرَاةِ التَّوْرَاةَ، فَعَمِلُوا إِلَى نِصْفِ النَّهَارِ، فَأُعْطُوا قِيرَاطًا قِيرَاطًا، وَأُوتِيَ النَّصَارَى الْإِنْجِيلَ، فَعَمِلُوا إِلَى الْعَصْرِ، فَأُعْطُوا قِيرَاطًا قِيرَاطًا، وَأُوتِينَا الْقُرْآنَ فَعَمِلْنَا مِنْ صَلَاةِ الْعَصْرِ إِلَى غُرُوبِ الشَّمْسِ، فَأُعْطِينَا قِيرَاطَيْنِ قِيرَاطَيْنِ، فَقَالَ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابَيْنِ: يَا رَبَّنَا، أَعْطَيْتَنَا قِيرَاطًا قِيرَاطًا وَعَمِلْنَا أَكْثَرَ مِنْ عَمَلِهِمْ، وَأَعْطَيْتَهُمْ قِيرَاطَيْنِ قِيرَاطَيْنِ؟ فَقَالَ: هَلْ ظَلَمْتُكُمْ مِنْ أَجْرِكُمْ شَيْئًا؟ فَقَالُوا: لَا، قَالَ: فَإِنَّهُ فَضْلِي أُوتِيهِ مَنْ أَشَاءُ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Ibn Sa'd told us, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from Ibn Umar, from the Prophet (ﷺ). He said: And Sakhr ibn Juwayriyah told us, from Nafi', that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Your likeness” — and Ibn Sa'd said: “Your remaining” — “among the nations that came before you is like the time between the ʿAsr prayer and sunset. The people of the Torah were given the Torah, and they worked until midday, and were given one qirat each. The Christians were given the Gospel, and they worked until the ʿAsr prayer, and were given one qirat each. And we were given the Qur'an, and we worked from the ʿAsr prayer until sunset, and we were given two qirats each. The People of the two Books said: Our Lord, You gave us one qirat each though we worked more than they did, and You gave them two qirats each? He said: Have I wronged you in any of your reward? They said: No. He said: Then it is My bounty, which I give to whom I will.”

hadiths.ar: 1930 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ بُدَيْلٍ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «الشُّؤْمُ  فِي ثَلَاثَةٍ، فِي الدَّارِ وَالْمَرْأَةِ وَالْفَرَسِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Abdullah ibn Budayl told us, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from Ibn Umar, who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Ill omen is in three things: the house, the woman, and the horse.”

sections.title_ar: وَحَمْزَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ
sections.title_en: Hamzah ibn Abdullah ibn Umar, from his father

hadiths.ar: 1931 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ ، عَنْ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ: «كَانَتْ لِيَ امْرَأَةٌ كُنْتُ أُحِبُّهَا، وَكَانَ أَبِي يَكْرَهُهَا، فَقَالَ لِي: طَلِّقْهَا،  فَأَبَيْتُ، فَأَتَى رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لَهُ، فَقَالَ: طَلِّقْهَا فَطَلَّقْتُهَا».
hadiths.en: Yunus told us: Abu Dawud told us: Ibn Abi Dhi'b told us, from al-Harith, from Hamzah ibn Abdullah ibn Umar, from his father, who said: “I had a wife whom I loved, but my father disliked her. He said to me: Divorce her. I refused, so he went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and mentioned that to him. He said: Divorce her. So I divorced her.”

hadiths.ar: 1932 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ أَوْ يُونُسَ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «مَا أَصَابَ اللهُ، عز وجل، أَهْلَ قَرْيَةٍ أَوْ قَوْمًا بِعَذَابٍ إِلَّا عَمَّهُمْ، ثُمَّ يُبْعَثُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَلَى نِيَّاتِهِمْ، أَوْ عَلَى أَعْمَالِهِمْ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Ibn al-Mubarak told us, from Ma'mar or Yunus, from al-Zuhri, from Hamzah ibn Abdullah, from his father, that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: “Whenever Allah, Mighty and Majestic, afflicts the people of a town or a people with punishment, it befalls all of them; then they will be resurrected on the Day of Resurrection according to their intentions,” or he said, “according to their deeds.”

sections.title_ar: وَعُبَيْدُ اللهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ
sections.title_en: Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Umar, from his father

hadiths.ar: 1933 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ: «كَانَتْ تَلْبِيَةُ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ»، وَزَادَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ : لَبَّيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ، وَالْخَيْرُ فِي يَدَيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ وَالرَّغْبَاءُ إِلَيْكَ وَالْعَمَلُ.
hadiths.en: Yunus told us: Abu Dawud told us: Hushaym told us, from Abu Bishr, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Umar, from his father, who said: “The talbiyah of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was: Labbayka Allahumma labbayk, labbayka la sharika laka labbayk, innal-hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk, la sharika lak (Here I am, O Allah, here I am; here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Indeed all praise, favor and sovereignty are Yours; You have no partner).” And Ibn Umar added: “Labbayk, labbayk, labbayka wa sa'dayk, wal-khayru fi yadayk, labbayka war-raghba'u ilayka wal-'amal (Here I am, here I am, here I am and at Your service; all good is in Your hands; here I am, and the longing is to You, and the deed).

sections.title_ar: وَمَا رَوَى نَافِعٌ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ
sections.title_en: What Nafi' narrated from Ibn Umar

hadiths.ar: 1934 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا طَلْحَةُ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لَعَنَ اللهُ الْوَاصِلَةَ  وَالْمُسْتَوْصِلَةَ وَالْوَاشِمَةَ وَالْمُسْتَوْشِمَةَ».
hadiths.en: Yunus told us: Abu Dawud told us: Talhah told us, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Allah has cursed the woman who adds hair extensions and the one who has them added, and the woman who tattoos and the one who has herself tattooed.”

hadiths.ar: 1935 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْعُمَرِيُّ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، أَنَّهُ «كَانَ يُصَلِّي عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ وَهُوَ مُسَافِرٌ حَيْثُ تَوَجَّهَتْ رَاحِلَتُهُ، وَيُخْبِرُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: al-Umari told us, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, that he “used to pray on his mount while traveling, in whatever direction his mount faced, and he would report that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to do that.”

hadiths.ar: 1936 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْعُمَرِيُّ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «صَلَاةٌ فِي مَسْجِدِي أَفْضَلُ مِنْ أَلْفِ صَلَاةٍ فِيمَا سِوَاهُ إِلَّا الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: al-Umari told us, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “A prayer in this mosque of mine is better than a thousand prayers in any other, except the Sacred Mosque (al-Masjid al-Haram).”

hadiths.ar: 1937 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْعُمَرِيُّ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «مَنْ حَمَلَ عَلَيْنَا السِّلَاحَ فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: al-Umari told us, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Whoever takes up arms against us is not one of us.”

hadiths.ar: 1938 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمَّا بَنَى الْمَسْجِدَ جَعَلَ بَابًا لِلنِّسَاءِ، وَقَالَ: لَا يَلِجَنَّ مِنْ هَذَا الْبَابِ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ أَحَدٌ». قَالَ نَافِعٌ: فَمَا رَأَيْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ دَاخِلًا مِنْ ذَلِكَ الْبَابِ وَلَا خَارِجًا مِنْهُ.
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Abdullah ibn Nafi' told us, from his father, from Ibn Umar: “When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) built the mosque, he made a door for women, and said: None of the men should enter through this door.” Nafi' said: “I never saw Ibn Umar enter through that door or leave through it.”

hadiths.ar: 1939 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ بْنُ أَسْمَاءَ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «إِذَا كَانَ نَفَرٌ ثَلَاثَةٌ، فَلَا يَتَنَاجَى اثْنَانِ دُونَ الثَّالِثِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Juwayriyah ibn Asma' told us, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “When there are three people, two should not whisper together to the exclusion of the third.”

hadiths.ar: 1940 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «نَهَى عَنْ بَيْعِ الثَّمَرَةِ حَتَّى يَبْدُوَ صَلَاحُهَا، نَهَى عَنْ ذَلِكَ الْبَائِعَ وَالْمُشْتَرِيَ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Juwayriyah told us, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) “forbade the sale of fruit until its ripeness is evident; he forbade it to both the seller and the buyer.”

hadiths.ar: 1941 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ إِذَا مَاتَ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ مَقْعَدُهُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ وَمَقْعَدُهُ مِنَ النَّارِ، بِالْغَدَاةِ وَبِالْعَشِيِّ، إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ فَمِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ فَمِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Juwayriyah told us, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “When any of you dies, his place is shown to him, in the morning and the evening, in Paradise and in Hellfire: if he is of the people of Paradise, then (it is shown) from the people of Paradise; and if he is of the people of Hellfire, then from the people of Hellfire.”

hadiths.ar: 1942 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَطَعَ نَخْلَ بَنِي النَّضِيرِ وَحَرَقَ، وَهُوَ الَّذِي قَالَ فِيهِ حَسَّانُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ: وَهَانَ عَلَى سَرَاةِ بَنِي لُؤَيٍّ … حَرِيقٌ بِالْبُوَيْرَةِ مُسْتَطِيرُ.»
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Juwayriyah told us, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) cut down and burned the palm trees of Banu al-Nadir, and it was about this that Hassan ibn Thabit said: ‘It was easy for the nobles of Banu Lu'ayy … a blazing fire spreading at al-Buwayrah.’”

hadiths.ar: 1943 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «الْمُؤْمِنُ يَأْكُلُ فِي مِعًى وَاحِدٍ، وَالْكَافِرُ يَأْكُلُ فِي سَبْعَةِ أَمْعَاءٍ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Juwayriyah told us, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: “The believer eats in one intestine, and the disbeliever eats in seven intestines.”

hadiths.ar: 1944 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: «اسْتَغْفَرَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلْمُحَلِّقِينَ ثَلَاثًا أَوْ مَرَّتَيْنِ، فَقِيلَ لَهُ: وَالْمُقَصِّرِينَ؟ فَقَالَ: وَالْمُقَصِّرِينَ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Juwayriyah told us, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, who said: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked forgiveness for those who shave their heads three times, or twice. It was said to him: And for those who shorten? He said: And for those who shorten.”

hadiths.ar: 1945 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَا يُصَلِّي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ، وَلَا الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْمَغْرِبِ إِلَّا فِي أَهْلِهِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Ibn Abi Dhi'b told us, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, who said: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not pray the two rak'ahs after the Friday prayer, nor the two rak'ahs after the Maghrib, except at home.”

hadiths.ar: 1946 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَهَلَّ حِينَ اسْتَوَتْ بِهِ رَاحِلَتُهُ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Ibn Abi Dhi'b told us, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: “The Prophet (ﷺ) began the talbiyah when his mount stood upright with him.”

hadiths.ar: 1947 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: «كَانَ تَلْبِيَةُ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Ibn Abi Dhi'b told us, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, who said: “The talbiyah of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was: Labbayka Allahumma labbayk, labbayka la sharika laka labbayk, innal-hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk, la sharika lak.”

hadiths.ar: 1948 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ «أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، مَا يَلْبَسُ الْمُحْرِمُ؟ قَالَ: لَا يَلْبَسُ الْقَمِيصَ، وَلَا الْعِمَامَةَ، وَلَا السَّرَاوِيلَ، وَلَا الْخُفَّيْنِ، إِلَّا أَنْ لَا يَجِدَ نَعْلَيْنِ، فَلْيَلْبَسْ خُفَّيْنِ، يَقْطَعُهُمَا إِلَى أَسْفَلَ مِنَ الْكَعْبَيْنِ، وَلَا يَلْبَسُ ثَوْبًا مَسَّهُ وَرْسٌ وَلَا زَعْفَرَانٌ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Ibn Abi Dhi'b told us, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: “A man said: O Messenger of Allah, what may the muhrim wear? He said: He may not wear the shirt, nor the turban, nor trousers, nor leather socks, unless he cannot find sandals, in which case let him wear leather socks, cutting them down to below the ankles; and he may not wear a garment touched by wars or saffron.”

hadiths.ar: 1949 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْعُمَرِيُّ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ «أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَأْتِي مَسْجِدَ قُبَاءٍ رَاكِبًا وَمَاشِيًا، وَيَذْكُرُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: al-Umari told us, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: “He used to come to the mosque of Quba both riding and walking, and he would mention that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to do that.”

hadiths.ar: 1950 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «مَا حَقُّ امْرِئٍ مُسْلِمٍ لَهُ مَالٌ يُوصِي فِيهِ، يَبِيتُ فَوْقَ لَيْلَتَيْنِ، إِلَّا وَوَصِيَّتُهُ مَكْتُوبَةٌ عِنْدَهُ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Juwayriyah told us, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: “It is not right for a Muslim who has property over which he wishes to make a bequest to spend two nights without his will being written down with him.”

hadiths.ar: 1951 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِهِ.
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammad ibn Zayd told us, from Ayyub, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, from the Prophet (ﷺ), similarly.

hadiths.ar: 1952 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا صَخْرُ بْنُ جُوَيْرِيَةَ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «إِذَا قَالَ الرَّجُلُ لِأَخِيهِ: يَا كَافِرُ، فَقَدْ بَاءَ بِهِ أَحَدُهُمَا، إِنْ كَانَ الَّذِي قِيلَ لَهُ كَافِرٌ فَهُوَ كَافِرٌ، وَإِلَّا رَجَعَ إِلَى مَنْ قَالَ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Sakhr ibn Juwayriyah told us, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: “If a man says to his brother: ‘O disbeliever,’ then one of them has earned it: if the one to whom it was said is a disbeliever, then he is; otherwise it returns to the one who said it.”

hadiths.ar: 1953 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا صَخْرٌ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَى نُخَامَةً فِي قِبْلَةِ الْمَسْجِدِ وَهُوَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ، فَحَكَّهَا وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ، فَلَمَّا صَلَّى تَغَيَّظَ عَلَى النَّاسِ، فَقَالَ: إِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ إِذَا كَانَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ فَإِنَّ اللهَ، عز وجل، قِبَلَ وَجْهِهِ، فَلَا يَتَنَخَّمَنَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ قِبَلَ وَجْهِهِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Sakhr told us, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw phlegm on the qiblah wall of the mosque while he was praying, so he scraped it off while standing. When he had finished praying, he was angry with the people and said: When any of you is in prayer, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, is before his face, so none of you should spit in front of his face during prayer.”

hadiths.ar: 1954 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ،  فَقِيلَ لِابْنِ عَوْنٍ: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم؟ قَالَ: أَمَّا عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ فَلَا شَكَّ فِيهِ، قَالَ: «الْخَيْلُ مَعْقُودٌ فِي نَوَاصِيهَا الْخَيْرُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Ibn Awn told us, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar. Ibn Awn was asked: (Is it) from the Prophet (ﷺ)? He said: As for it being from Ibn Umar, there is no doubt about it. He said: “Good is tied to the forelocks of horses until the Day of Resurrection.”

hadiths.ar: 1955 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْعُمَرِيُّ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، رَفَعَهُ مِثْلَهُ.
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: al-Umari told us, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, raising it (to the Prophet), similarly.

hadiths.ar: 1956 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا طَلْحَةُ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، قَالَ:  «جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، فَقَالَ: يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنْتُمْ نَظَرْتُمْ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِأَعْيُنِكُمْ؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: وَكَلَّمْتُمُوهُ بِأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ هَذِهِ؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: وَبَايَعْتُمُوهُ بِأَيْمَانِكُمْ هَذِهِ؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: طُوبَى لَكُمْ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: أَفَلَا أُخْبِرُكَ عَنْ شَيْءٍ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْهُ؟ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: طُوبَى لِمَنْ رَآنِي وَآمَنَ بِي، وَطُوبَى لِمَنْ لَمْ يَرَنِي وَآمَنَ بِي ثَلَاثًا».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Talhah told us, from Nafi', who said: “A man came to Ibn Umar and said: O Abu Abd al-Rahman, did you look upon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with your own eyes? He said: Yes. He said: And did you speak to him with these tongues of yours? He said: Yes. He said: And did you pledge allegiance to him with these right hands of yours? He said: Yes. He said: Blessed are you, O Abu Abd al-Rahman. He said: Shall I not tell you of something I heard from him? I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: Blessed is the one who saw me and believed in me, and blessed (three times) is the one who did not see me and believed in me.”

hadiths.ar: 1957 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي رَوَّادٍ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم اتَّخَذَ خَاتَمًا، فَجَعَلَ فَصَّ الْخَاتَمِ مِمَّا يَلِي بَطْنَ كَفِّهِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Abd al-Aziz ibn Abi Rawwad told us, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a ring and placed its stone on the side facing the palm of his hand.”

hadiths.ar: 1958 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ ، وَالْعُمَرِيُّ عَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ ، وَعَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ - كُلُّهُمْ - عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَطَعَ فِي مِجَنٍّ قُوِّمَ ثَلَاثَةَ دَرَاهِمَ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Malik ibn Anas, al-Umari Abdullah ibn Umar, and Abdullah ibn Nafi' told us — all of them — from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) cut off the hand (of a thief) for (stealing) a shield valued at three dirhams.”

hadiths.ar: 1959 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ فَلْيَغْتَسِلْ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hisham told us, from Ayyub, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “When any of you comes to the Friday prayer, let him bathe.”

hadiths.ar: 1960 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْعُمَرِيُّ ، وَابْنُ نَافِعٍ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: «دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ الْكَعْبَةَ، فَأَغْلَقَ عَلَيْهِ الْبَابَ، وَدَخَلَ مَعَهُ الْفَضْلُ بْنُ الْعَبَّاسِ، وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ، وَأُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، وَبِلَالٌ فَلَمَّا خَرَجُوا سَابَقْتُ النَّاسَ فَسَبَقْتُهُمْ، فَقُلْتُ لِبِلَالٍ : أَيْنَ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم؟ قَالَ: بَيْنَ الْعَمُودَيْنِ الْمُقَدَّمَيْنِ حِيَالَ الْجَزْعَةِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: al-Umari and Ibn Nafi' told us, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, who said: “On the day of the conquest of Makkah, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) entered the Ka'bah and closed the door behind him; with him entered al-Fadl ibn al-Abbas, Uthman ibn Talhah, Usamah ibn Zayd and Bilal. When they came out, I raced the people and got ahead of them. I said to Bilal: Where did the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) pray? He said: Between the two front pillars, opposite the jaz'ah (the black-and-white stone).”

hadiths.ar: 1961 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ ، عَنْ  نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «خَطَبَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: إِذَا رَاحَ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ فَلْيَغْتَسِلْ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us, from al-Hakam, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, who said: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) gave a sermon and said: When any of you goes to the Friday prayer, let him bathe.”

hadiths.ar: 1962 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا نَافِعٌ ، قَالَ: «انْطَلَقْتُ مَعَ ابْنِ عُمَرَ إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فِي حَاجَةٍ لِابْنِ عُمَرَ، فَحَدَّثَ يَوْمَئِذٍ - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُمَرَ - أَنَّ رَجُلًا سَلَّمَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ، فَانْطَلَقَ، فَلَمَّا كَادَ أَنْ يَغِيبَ تَنَاوَلَ الْحَائِطَ، فَقَالَ بِيَدِهِ، ثُمَّ مَسَحَ بِوَجْهِهِ وَيَدَيْهِ، ثُمَّ عَادَ الثَّانِيَةَ، فَمَسَحَ إِلَى ذِرَاعَيْهِ، ثُمَّ رَدَّ عَلَى الرَّجُلِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: مَا مَنَعَنِي أَنْ أَرُدَّ عَلَيْكَ، إِلَّا أَنِّي كُنْتُ غَيْرَ طَاهِرٍ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Muhammad ibn Thabit al-Abdi told us: Nafi' told us, he said: “I went with Ibn Umar to Ibn Abbas for a need of Ibn Umar's. That day he — meaning Ibn Umar — narrated that a man greeted the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with salam, and he did not return it. The man went off, and when he was about to disappear from sight, he (the Prophet) reached for the wall and struck it with his hand, then wiped his face and his hands. Then he did it a second time and wiped up to his forearms. Then he returned the greeting to the man and said: Nothing prevented me from returning your greeting except that I was not in a state of purity.”

hadiths.ar: 1963 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُتْبَةَ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لِأَصْحَابِهِ: أَيُّ النَّاسِ خَيْرٌ؟ قَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، رَجُلٌ يُعْطِي مَالَهُ وَنَفْسَهُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: نِعْمَ الرَّجُلُ هَذَا، وَلَيْسَ بِهِ، وَلَكِنَّ أَفْضَلَ النَّاسِ رَجُلٌ يُعْطِي جُهْدَهُ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Abu Utbah told us, from Abdullah ibn Dinar, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to his companions: Which of the people is best? They said: O Messenger of Allah, a man who gives his wealth and himself. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: What a fine man this is, but he is not the one; rather the best of people is a man who gives what he is able to (his utmost effort).”

hadiths.ar: 1964 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ ، وَعُبَيْدِ اللهِ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: «طَلَّقْتُ امْرَأَتِي وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ، فَذَكَرَ عُمَرُ ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَقَالَ: لِيُرَاجِعْهَا حَتَّى تَطْهُرَ، ثُمَّ تَحِيضَ، ثُمَّ تَطْهُرَ، فَإِنَّهَا الْعِدَّةُ الَّتِي أَمَرَ اللهُ، عز وجل، بِهَا».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammad ibn Salamah told us, from Ayyub and Ubaydullah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, who said: “I divorced my wife while she was menstruating. Umar mentioned that to the Prophet (ﷺ), and he said: Let him take her back until she is pure, then she menstruates, then she is pure again; for that is the waiting period that Allah, Mighty and Majestic, commanded.”

hadiths.ar: 1965 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «غِفَارُ غَفَرَ اللهُ لَهَا، وَأَسْلَمُ سَالَمَهَا اللهُ، وَعُصَيَّةُ الَّذِينَ عَصَوُا اللهَ وَرَسُولَهُ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Abdullah ibn Nafi' told us, from his father, from Abdullah ibn Umar, who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: “Ghifar — may Allah forgive them; Aslam — may Allah keep them safe; and Usayyah — those who disobeyed Allah and His Messenger.”

hadiths.ar: 1966 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ  عُمَرَ قَالَ: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُسَافَرَ بِالْقُرْآنِ؛ مَخَافَةَ أَنْ يَنَالَهُ الْعَدُوُّ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Juwayriyah told us, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, who said: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade traveling with the Qur'an, for fear that the enemy might get hold of it.”

hadiths.ar: 1967 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُتِيَ بِيَهُودِيٍّ وَيَهُودِيَّةٍ قَدْ زَنَيَا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: مَا تَجِدُونَ فِي كِتَابِكُمْ؟ قَالُوا: لَا نَجِدُ الرَّجْمَ، فَقَالَ ابْنُ سَلَامٍ: كَذَبُوا، الرَّجْمُ فِي كِتَابِهِمْ، قَالَ: فَدَعَا ابْنَ صُورِيَا، فَجَعَلَ يَقْرَأُ حَتَّى إِذَا انْتَهَى إِلَى مَوْضِعِ الرَّجْمِ، وَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَى مَوْضِعِ الرَّجْمِ، فَقَالَ ابْنُ سَلَامٍ: ارْفَعْ يَدَكَ، فَرَفَعَهَا، فَإِذَا آيَةُ الرَّجْمِ، فَقَالَ: يَا مُحَمَّدُ،  الرَّجْمُ فِي كِتَابِنَا، فَرَجَمَهُمَا رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْبَلَاطِ، قَالَ: فَجَعَلَ الْيَهُودِيُّ يَقِيهَا بِنَفْسِهِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Juwayriyah told us, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: “A Jewish man and a Jewish woman who had committed adultery were brought to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: What do you find in your Book? They said: We do not find stoning. Ibn Salam said: They lie; stoning is in their Book. He said: So he (the Prophet) summoned Ibn Suriya, who began to read until, when he reached the place of stoning, he put his hand over the place of stoning. Ibn Salam said: Lift your hand. He lifted it, and there was the verse of stoning. He said: O Muhammad, stoning is in our Book. So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had them both stoned at al-Balat. He said: And the Jewish man kept shielding her with his own body.”

hadiths.ar: 1968 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَنْ شَرِبِ الْخَمْرَ فِي الدُّنْيَا لَمْ يَشْرَبْهُ فِي الْآخِرَةِ، إِلَّا أَنْ يَتُوبَ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Juwayriyah told us, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Whoever drinks wine in this world will not drink it in the Hereafter, unless he repents.”

hadiths.ar: 1969 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْعُمَرِيُّ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ  عُمَرَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «كَانَ يَخْطُبُ خُطْبَتَيْنِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ، يَفْصِلُ فِيهِمَا بِالْجُلُوسِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: al-Umari told us, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) “used to give two sermons on Friday, separating them by sitting.”

hadiths.ar: 1970 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْشَرٍ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: «عُرِضْتُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ، فَلَمْ أُقْبَلْ وَأَنَا ابْنُ ثَلَاثَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً، وَعُرِضْتُ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ وَأَنَا ابْنُ أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ فَلَمْ أُقْبَلْ، وَعُرِضْتُ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ وَأَنَا ابْنُ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ  فَقُبِلْتُ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Abu Ma'shar told us, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, who said: “I was presented to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the day of Badr, and I was not accepted, as I was thirteen years old. I was presented to him on the day of Uhud when I was fourteen, and I was not accepted. And I was presented to him on the day of the Trench when I was fifteen, and I was accepted.”

hadiths.ar: 1971 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الرَّبِيعُ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «كُلُّ بَيِّعَيْنِ فَلَا بَيْعَ بَيْنَهُمَا حَتَّى يَتَفَرَّقَا، إِلَّا أَنْ يَكُونَ بَيْعُهُمَا بَيْعَ خِيَارٍ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: al-Rabi' told us, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Every two parties to a sale have no binding sale between them until they separate, unless their sale is a sale with option (khiyar).”

sections.title_ar: وَمَا رَوَى بِشْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ النَّدْبِيُّ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا
sections.title_en: What Bishr ibn Harb al-Nadbi narrated from Ibn Umar, may Allah be pleased with them both

hadiths.ar: 1972 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ النَّدْبِيُّ ، قَالَ: «سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ عَنِ الصَّرْفِ؛ الدِّرْهَمِ بِالدِّرْهَمَيْنِ، فَقَالَ: عَيْنُ الرِّبَا، عَيْنُ الرِّبَا، فَلَا تَقْرَبْهُ، هَلْ سَمِعْتَ مَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: خُذُو الْمِثْلَ بِالْمِثْلِ».
hadiths.en: Yunus told us: Abu Dawud told us: Hammad ibn Zayd told us: Bishr ibn Harb al-Nadbi told us, he said: “I asked Ibn Umar about currency exchange — one dirham for two dirhams. He said: It is outright usury, outright usury, so do not go near it. Have you not heard what the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Take like for like?”

hadiths.ar: 1973 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ بِشْرِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ رحمه الله يَقُولُ: «طَلَّقْتُ امْرَأَتِي وَهِيَ  حَائِضٌ، فَقَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: رَاجِعْهَا حَتَّى تَطْهُرَ، ثُمَّ تَحِيضَ، ثُمَّ تَطْهُرَ، فَإِنْ شِئْتَ فَطَلِّقْ، وَإِنْ شِئْتَ فَأَمْسِكْ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ: فَطَلَّقْتُهَا، وَلَوْ شِئْتُ لَأَمْسَكْتُهَا».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammad ibn Salamah told us, from Bishr ibn Harb, who said: I heard Ibn Umar, may Allah have mercy on him, say: “I divorced my wife while she was menstruating, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: Take her back until she is pure, then she menstruates, then she is pure; then if you wish, divorce, and if you wish, keep her. Ibn Umar said: So I divorced her, and had I wished I would have kept her.”

hadiths.ar: 1974 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ ، سَمِعَ ابْنَ عُمَرَ يَذْكُرُ نَحْوَهُ.
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammad ibn Salamah told us, from Anas ibn Sirin, who heard Ibn Umar mention something similar.

hadiths.ar: 1975 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَمْرٍو الْأَزْدِيُّ أَوِ الْعَبْدِيُّ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَمْرٍو النَّدْبِيُّ ، قَالَ: «سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ فِي السَّفَرِ، فَقَالَ: أَوَتَأْخُذُ عَنِّي إِنْ حَدَّثْتُكَ؟ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا خَرَجَ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْمَدِينَةِ، لَمْ يَزَلْ يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ حَتَّى يَرْجِعَ إِلَيْهَا».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Abu Amr al-Azdi or al-Abdi told us: Abu Amr al-Nadbi told us, he said: “I asked Ibn Umar about the prayer while traveling. He said: Will you accept it from me if I narrate to you? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), whenever he left this city (Madinah), would continue to pray two rak'ahs until he returned to it.”

sections.title_ar: الزُّبَيْرُ بْنُ الْعَرَبِيِّ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ
sections.title_en: Al-Zubayr ibn al-Arabi from Ibn Umar

hadiths.ar: 1976 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الزُّبَيْرُ بْنُ الْعَرَبِيِّ ، قَالَ: «سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ عَنِ الْمُزَاحَمَةِ عَلَى الْحَجَرِ، فَقَالَ: رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْتَلِمُهُ وَيُقَبِّلُهُ فَقُلْتُ: أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ أُغْلَبْ أَوْ أُزْحَمْ؟ قَالَ: اجْعَلْ (أَرَأَيْتَ) مَعَ ذَلِكَ الْكَوْكَبِ، رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُقَبِّلُهُ وَيَسْتَلِمُهُ».
hadiths.en: Yunus told us: Abu Dawud told us: Hammad ibn Zayd told us: al-Zubayr ibn al-Arabi told us, he said: “I asked Ibn Umar about crowding at the Black Stone. He said: I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) touch it and kiss it. I said: What if I am overpowered or crowded? He said: Put ‘what if’ (a-ra'ayta) away in Yemen (i.e., leave it aside). I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) kiss it and touch it.”

sections.title_ar: وَعَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ مُرَّةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ
sections.title_en: Abdullah ibn Murrah from Ibn Umar

hadiths.ar: 1977 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «نَهَى عَنِ النَّذْرِ وَقَالَ: إِنَّهُ لَا يَأْتِي بِخَيْرٍ، إِنَّمَا يُسْتَخْرَجُ بِهِ مِنَ الْبَخِيلِ».
hadiths.en: Yunus told us: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us, from Mansur, from Abdullah ibn Murrah, from Ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) “forbade making vows and said: It does not bring any good; it is only a means of extracting (something) from the miser.”

sections.title_ar: وَالْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ سَلْمَانَ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ
sections.title_en: Al-Mughirah ibn Salman from Ibn Umar
