hadiths.ar: 2074 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ: أَنْبَأَنَا قَتَادَةُ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُتِيَ بِلَحْمٍ، فَقَالَ: مَا هَذَا؟ قَالَ: هَذَا شَيْءٌ تُصُدِّقَ بِهِ عَلَى بَرِيرَةَ، قَالَ: هُوَ لَنَا هَدِيَّةٌ، وَعَلَيْهَا صَدَقَةٌ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us: Qatadah informed us, from Anas: “Some meat was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said: What is this? They said: This is something given in charity to Barirah. He said: It is a gift for us, and charity for her.”

hadiths.ar: 2075 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «مَا مِنْ نَبِيٍّ إِلَّا وَقَدْ أَنْذَرَ أُمَّتَهُ الْأَعْوَرَ الْكَذَّابَ، أَلَا وَإِنَّهُ أَعْوَرُ، وَإِنَّ اللهَ تبارك وتعالى لَيْسَ بِأَعْوَرَ، مَكْتُوبٌ بَيْنَ عَيْنَيْهِ كَافِرٌ، يَقْرَؤُهُ كُلُّ مُؤْمِنٍ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: “There was no prophet but that he warned his community about the one-eyed liar (the Dajjal). Beware, he is one-eyed, and your Lord, Blessed and Exalted, is not one-eyed. Between his eyes is written ‘kafir’ (disbeliever), which every believer can read.”

hadiths.ar: 2076 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ لَهُ عِنْدَ اللهِ خَيْرٌ يُحِبُّ أَنْ يَرْجِعَ إِلَى الدُّنْيَا، إِلَّا الشَّهِيدُ، فَإِنَّهُ وَدَّ لَوْ أَنَّهُ رَجَعَ فَقُتِلَ عَشْرَ مَرَّاتٍ، لِمَا يَرَى مِنْ فَضْلِ الشَّهَادَةِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: “There is no servant who has something good with Allah who would wish to return to the world, except the martyr; he wishes he could return and be killed ten times, because of the excellence of martyrdom that he sees.”

hadiths.ar: 2077 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لِمُعَاذٍ: اعْلَمْ أَنَّهُ مَنْ مَاتَ يَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، وَأَنِّي رَسُولُ اللهِ، أُدْخِلَ الْجَنَّةَ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us, from Qatadah, from Anas: “The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Mu'adh: Know that whoever dies bearing witness that there is no god but Allah and that I am the Messenger of Allah will be admitted to Paradise.”

hadiths.ar: 2078 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، وَهِشَامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ،  عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «يَخْرُجُ مِنَ النَّارِ مَنْ قَالَ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، وَكَانَ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ مَا يَزِنُ شَعِيرَةً، وَيَخْرُجُ مِنَ النَّارِ مَنْ قَالَ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، وَكَانَ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ مَا يَزِنُ بُرَّةً، وَيَخْرُجُ مِنَ النَّارِ مَنْ قَالَ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، وَكَانَ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ مَا يَزِنُ - قَالَ هِشَامٌ: ذَرَّةً  وَقَالَ شُعْبَةُ ذُرَةً» -.
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah and Hisham told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: “Whoever says ‘There is no god but Allah’ and has in his heart good equal to the weight of a barley grain will come out of the Fire; and whoever says ‘There is no god but Allah’ and has in his heart good equal to the weight of a wheat grain will come out of the Fire; and whoever says ‘There is no god but Allah’ and has in his heart good equal to the weight of” — Hisham said: “a speck (dharrah)”, and Shu'bah said: “a grain of corn (dhurah)”.

hadiths.ar: 2079 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: يَقُولُ اللهُ عز وجل: «إِنْ تَقَرَّبَ مِنِّي عَبْدِي شِبْرًا تَقَرَّبْتُ مِنْهُ ذِرَاعًا، وَإِنْ تَقَرَّبَ مِنِّي ذِرَاعًا تَقَرَّبْتُ مِنْهُ بَاعًا».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says: “If My servant draws near to Me by a hand's span, I draw near to him by an arm's length; and if he draws near to Me by an arm's length, I draw near to him by a fathom.”

hadiths.ar: 2080 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، وَهِشَامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ضَحَّى بِكَبْشَيْنِ أَمْلَحَيْنِ أَقْرَنَيْنِ، وَيُسَمِّي وَيُكَبِّرُ، وَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُهُ وَاضِعًا صِفَاحَهُمَا عَلَى قَدَمَيْهِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah and Hisham told us, from Qatadah, from Anas: “The Prophet (ﷺ) sacrificed two horned rams, black-and-white in color, saying the name of Allah and the takbir; and I saw him placing his foot on their sides.”

hadiths.ar: 2081 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، «أَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ قَالَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، اسْتَعْمَلْتَ فُلَانًا وَلَمْ تَسْتَعْمِلْنِي، فَقَالَ: إِنَّكُمْ سَتَرَوْنَ بَعْدِي أَثَرَةً، فَاصْبِرُوا حَتَّى تَلْقَوْنِي عَلَى الْحَوْضِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us, from Qatadah, from Anas: “A man of the Ansar said to the Prophet (ﷺ): O Messenger of Allah, you appointed so-and-so but did not appoint me. He said: After me you will see favoritism (to others over you), so be patient until you meet me at the Pond (al-Hawd).”

hadiths.ar: 2082 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: «جَلَدَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْخَمْرِ بِالْجَرِيدِ وَالنِّعَالِ وَجَلَدَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَرْبَعِينَ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ عُمَرُ، وَدَنَا النَّاسُ مِنَ الرِّيفِ وَالْقُرَى، قَالَ: مَا  تَرَوْنَ فِي حَدِّ الْخَمْرِ؟ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ: أَرَى أَنْ تَجْعَلَهُ كَأَخَفِّ الْحُدُودِ، فَجَلَدَ عُمَرُ ثَمَانِينَ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hisham told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, who said: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) flogged for (drinking) wine with palm branches and sandals, and Abu Bakr flogged forty. When Umar's time came and people had come close to the countryside and villages, he said: What do you think about the punishment for wine? Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf said: I think you should make it like the lightest of the prescribed punishments. So Umar flogged eighty.”

hadiths.ar: 2083 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: «قَالَ أَصْحَابُ النَّبِيِّ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، إِنَّ أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ يُسَلِّمُونَ عَلَيْنَا، فَكَيْفَ نَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِمْ؟ قَالَ: قُولُوا: وَعَلَيْكُمْ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, who said: “The Companions of the Prophet said to the Prophet (ﷺ): O Messenger of Allah, the People of the Book greet us with salam; how should we respond to them? He said: Say: ‘And upon you.’”

hadiths.ar: 2084 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: «رُخِّصَ لِعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، وَالزُّبَيْرِ فِي الْقَمِيصِ الْحَرِيرِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, who said: “A concession was granted to Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf and al-Zubayr regarding silk shirts.”

hadiths.ar: 2085 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، «أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَالزُّبَيْرَ، شَكَيَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْقَمْلَ، فَرَخَّصَ لَهُمَا  فِي قَمِيصِ الْحَرِيرِ. قَالَ أَنَسٌ: فَكِلَاهُمَا قَدْ رَأَيْتُ عَلَيْهِ قَمِيصَ حَرِيرٍ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammam told us, from Qatadah, from Anas: “Abd al-Rahman and al-Zubayr complained to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about lice, so he granted them a concession to wear silk shirts.” Anas said: “I saw a silk shirt on both of them.”

hadiths.ar: 2086 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «إِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ إِذَا كَانَ فِي صِلَاتِهِ، فَإِنَّهُ يُنَاجِي رَبَّهُ، فَلَا يَبْزُقَنَّ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ، وَلَا عَنْ يَمِينِهِ، وَلَكِنْ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ، وَتَحْتَ قَدَمِهِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: “When one of you is in his prayer, he is conversing privately with his Lord, so let him not spit in front of him, nor to his right, but to his left, under his foot.”

hadiths.ar: 2087 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا قَتَادَةُ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ: أَنْتَ سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْهُ؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ، نَحْنُ سَأَلْنَاهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ، قَالَ: «صَلَّيْتُ خَلْفَ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَخَلْفَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، وَخَلْفَ عُمَرَ، وَخَلْفَ عُثْمَانَ، فَكَانُوا يَسْتَفْتِحُونَ بِـ {الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ}».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us: Qatadah informed us, from Anas — he (Shu'bah) said: I said to him: Did you hear it from him? He said: Yes, we asked him about that. He said: “I prayed behind the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and behind Abu Bakr, and behind Umar, and behind Uthman, and they would begin (the recitation) with {Praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds}.”

hadiths.ar: 2088 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «كَانَ يُحِبُّ الدُّبَّاءَ، فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتُ ذَلِكَ جَعَلْتُ أَضَعُهُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us: Qatadah told us, from Anas, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) “loved gourd (dubba'), so when I saw that, I would place it before him.”

hadiths.ar: 2089 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «اعْتَدِلُوا فِي السُّجُودِ، وَلَا يَبْسُطَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ ذِرَاعَيْهِ انْبِسَاطَ الْكَلْبِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Be moderate in prostration, and let none of you stretch out his forearms like a dog.”

hadiths.ar: 2090 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، «أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ عَوْفٍ، تَزَوَّجَ امْرَأَةً مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ عَلَى وَزْنِ نَوَاةٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، فَأَجَازَ ذَلِكَ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us, from Qatadah, from Anas: “Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf married a woman of the Ansar for the weight of a date-stone in gold, and he (the Prophet) approved that.”

hadiths.ar: 2091 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، قَالَ:  حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسٌ ، قَالَ: «كَانَ فَزَعٌ بِالْمَدِينَةِ، فَرَكِبَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرَسًا لِأَبِي طَلْحَةَ يُقَالُ لَهُ: مَنْدُوبٌ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ فَزَعٍ، وَإِنْ وَجَدْنَاهُ لَبَحْرًا».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us, from Qatadah, who said: Anas told us, he said: “There was an alarm in Madinah, so the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) rode a horse belonging to Abu Talhah called Mandub. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: There is nothing to fear; and we found it (the horse) to be like a sea.”

hadiths.ar: 2092 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، وَأَبِي التَّيَّاحِ ، سَمِعَا أَنَسًا ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «بُعِثْتُ أَنَا وَالسَّاعَةُ  كَهَاتَيْنِ وَزَادَ قَتَادَةُ: فَمَا فَضْلُ إِحْدَاهُمَا عَلَى الْأُخْرَى».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us, from Qatadah and Abu al-Tayyah, who both heard Anas say that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: “I and the Hour have been sent like these two.” And Qatadah added: “...so how much is one ahead of the other?”

hadiths.ar: 2093 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، سَمِعَ أَنَسًا ، «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَتَى عَلَى رَجُلٍ يَسُوقُ بَدَنَةً، فَقَالَ: ارْكَبْهَا قَالَ: إِنَّهَا بَدَنَةٌ، قَالَ: ارْكَبْهَا قَالَ: إِنَّهَا بَدَنَةٌ، قَالَ: وَيْلَكَ - أَوْ وَيْحَكَ - ارْكَبْهَا».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us, from Qatadah, who heard Anas: “The Prophet (ﷺ) came upon a man driving a sacrificial camel (badanah), and said: Ride it. He said: It is a sacrificial camel. He said: Ride it. He said: It is a sacrificial camel. He said: Woe to you — or: Alas for you — ride it.”

hadiths.ar: 2094 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، قَالَ: قَالَ أَنَسٌ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «سَوُّوا صُفُوفَكُمْ، فَإِنَّ تَسْوِيَةَ الصَّفِّ مِنْ تَمَامِ الصَّلَاةِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us, from Qatadah, who said: Anas said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Straighten your rows, for straightening the row is part of the perfection of the prayer.”

hadiths.ar: 2095 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا ، يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لَوْ كَانَ لِابْنِ آدَمَ وَادِيًا مِنْ مَالٍ لَابْتَغَى إِلَيْهِ ثَانِيًا، وَلَوْ كَانَ لَهُ ثَانِيًا لَابْتَغَى إِلَيْهِ ثَالِثًا، وَلَا  يَمْلَأُ جَوْفَ ابْنِ آدَمَ إِلَّا التُّرَابُ، وَيَتُوبُ اللهُ عَلَى مَنْ تَابَ» قَالَ أَنَسٌ: فَلَا أَدْرِي؛ شَيْءٌ أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ، أَوْ كَانَ يَقُولُهُ.
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us, from Qatadah, who said: I heard Anas say: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “If the son of Adam had a valley of wealth, he would seek a second; and if he had a second, he would seek a third. Nothing fills the belly of the son of Adam except dust, and Allah turns in mercy to whoever repents.” Anas said: “I do not know whether it was something revealed to him, or something he used to say.”

hadiths.ar: 2096 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: حَدِيثًا سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَا يُحَدِّثُكُمُوهُ أَحَدٌ سَمِعَهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدِي، سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ: «إِنَّ مِنْ أَشْرَاطِ السَّاعَةِ أَنْ يُرْفَعَ الْعِلْمُ، وَيَظْهَرَ الْجَهْلُ، وَيُشْرَبَ الْخَمْرُ، وَيَظْهَرَ الزِّنَا، وَيَقِلَّ الرِّجَالُ، وَيَكْثُرَ النِّسَاءُ، حَتَّى يَكُونَ فِي خَمْسِينَ امْرَأَةً الْقَيِّمُ الْوَاحِدُ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hisham told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, who said: A hadith I heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that no one after me will narrate to you, having heard it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ); I heard him say: “Among the signs of the Hour are that knowledge will be taken away, ignorance will appear, wine will be drunk, fornication will become widespread, men will become few and women many, until there will be one man to look after fifty women.”

hadiths.ar: 2097 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عِمْرَانُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبَا بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ وَعُثْمَانَ كَانُوا عَلَى حِرَاءٍ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: اثْبُتْ، فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ نَبِيٌّ، أَوْ صِدِّيقٌ، أَوْ شَهِيدٌ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Imran told us, from Qatadah, from Anas: “The Prophet (ﷺ), Abu Bakr, Umar and Uthman were on (Mount) Hira', and it shook. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Be still, for upon you there is only a prophet, a siddiq (truthful one), or a martyr.”

hadiths.ar: 2098 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، «أَنَّ امْرَأَةً أَخَذَتْ جَارِيَةً مَعَهَا حُلِيٌّ لَهَا، فَرَضَّتْ رَأْسَهَا بَيْنَ حَجَرَيْنِ، وَأَخَذَتِ الْحُلِيَّ، فَرُفِعَ ذَلِكَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَرَضَّ رَأْسَهَا بَيْنَ حَجَرَيْنِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammam told us, from Qatadah, from Anas: “A woman took a girl who had jewelry on her, crushed her head between two stones, and took the jewelry. The matter was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ), and he had her head crushed between two stones (in retaliation).”

hadiths.ar: 2099 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «الْبُزَاقُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ خَطِيئَةٌ، وَكَفَّارَتُهَا دَفْنُهَا».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: “Spitting in the mosque is a sin, and its expiation is to bury it.”

hadiths.ar: 2100 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا ، يَقُولُ: «قَالَتْ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، ادْعُ اللهَ لَهُ، تَعْنِي أَنَسًا، قَالَ: اللَّهُمَّ أَكْثِرْ مَالَهُ وَوَلَدَهُ، وَبَارِكْ لَهُ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us, from Qatadah, who said: I heard Anas say: “Umm Sulaym said: O Messenger of Allah, pray to Allah for him — meaning Anas. He said: O Allah, increase his wealth and his children, and bless him in what You have provided him.”

hadiths.ar: 2101 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَنَتَ شَهْرًا يَدْعُو عَلَى رِعْلٍ وَذَكْوَانَ وَلِحْيَانَ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us, from Qatadah, from Anas: “The Prophet (ﷺ) made qunut (supplication in prayer) for a month, invoking against (the tribes of) Ri'l, Dhakwan and Lihyan.”

hadiths.ar: 2102 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُتِيَ بِثَوْبِ حَرِيرٍ، فَجَعَلُوا يَعْجَبُونَ مِنْهُ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: لَمِنْدِيلُ - أَوْ قَالَ: لَبَعْضُ مَنَادِيلِ - سَعْدِ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ فِي الْجَنَّةِ أَلْيَنُ مِنْ هَذَا، أَوْ خَيْرٌ مِنْ هَذَا».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us, from Qatadah, from Anas: “A silk garment was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ), and they began to marvel at it. The Prophet (ﷺ) said: A handkerchief — or he said: one of the handkerchiefs — of Sa'd ibn Mu'adh in Paradise is softer than this, or better than this.”

hadiths.ar: 2103 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَعْتَقَ صَفِيَّةَ، وَجَعَلَ عِتْقَهَا صَدَاقَهَا».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Abu Awanah told us, from Qatadah, from Anas: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) freed Safiyyah and made her emancipation her dowry.”

hadiths.ar: 2104 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «بَيْنَا أَنَا فِي الْجَنَّةِ، إِذْ رَأَيْتُ نَهَرًا، فَقُلْتُ: يَا جِبْرِيلُ، مَا هَذَا؟ قَالَ: هَذَا الْكَوْثَرُ الَّذِي أَعْطَاكَ رَبُّكَ، فَأَدْخَلْتُ يَدِي، فَإِذَا تُرَابُهُ مِسْكٌ أَذْفَرُ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammam told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “While I was in Paradise, I saw a river. I said: O Jibril, what is this? He said: This is al-Kawthar, which your Lord has given you. I put my hand in, and its soil was fragrant musk.”

hadiths.ar: 2105 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «مَا بَيْنَ نَاحِيَتَيْ حَوْضِي كَمَا بَيْنَ صَنْعَاءَ  وَالْمَدِينَةِ، أَوْ كَمَا بَيْنَ الْمَدِينَةِ وَعَمَّانَ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hisham told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “The distance between the two sides of my Pond is like the distance between San'a' and Madinah,” or: “like the distance between Madinah and Amman.”

hadiths.ar: 2106 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم «كَانَ يَحْتَجِمُ فِي الْأَخْدَعَيْنِ وَالْكَاهِلِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Jarir ibn Hazim told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, that the Prophet (ﷺ) “used to have cupping done on the two veins of the neck (akhda'ayn) and between the shoulders (kahil).”

hadiths.ar: 2107 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «أَتِمُّوا الرُّكُوعَ وَالسُّجُودَ، فَوَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ، إِنِّي لَأَرَاكُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ ظَهْرِي إِذَا مَا رَكَعْتُمْ وَسَجَدْتُمْ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hisham told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Complete the bowing and the prostration, for by Him in whose hand is my soul, I see you from behind my back when you bow and prostrate.”

hadiths.ar: 2108 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا قُرَّةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: «نَظَرْنَا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْعِشَاءِ حَتَّى مَضَى شَطْرُ اللَّيْلِ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ فَصَلَّى بِنَا، كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى وَبِيصِ خَاتَمِهِ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ فِي يَدِهِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Qurrah told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, who said: “We waited for the Prophet (ﷺ) for the ʿIsha' prayer until half the night had passed. Then he came out and led us in prayer, and it is as if I can see the gleam of his silver ring on his hand.”

hadiths.ar: 2109 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ أَخَفِّ النَّاسِ صَلَاةً فِي تَمَامٍ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hisham told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, who said: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was among the lightest of people in prayer while being complete.”

hadiths.ar: 2110 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ يَغْرِسُ غَرْسًا - وَقَالَ مَرَّةً: أَوْ نَخْلًا - أَوْ يَزْرَعُ زَرْعًا فَيَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ بَهِيمَةٌ أَوْ إِنْسَانٌ أَوْ طَيْرٌ، إِلَّا كَانَ  لَهُ صَدَقَةً».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Abu Awanah told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: “There is no Muslim who plants a plant — and once he said: or a palm tree — or sows a crop, and an animal, a human or a bird eats from it, except that it counts as charity for him.”

hadiths.ar: 2111 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنِّي لَأَرَى التَّمْرَةَ فَمَا يَمْنَعُنِي مِنْ أَكْلِهَا إِلَّا مَخَافَةَ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِنْ تَمْرِ الصَّدَقَةِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammad ibn Salamah told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “I see a date, and nothing prevents me from eating it except the fear that it may be from the dates of charity.”

hadiths.ar: 2112 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: «زَجَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُشْرَبَ قَائِمًا».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hisham told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, who said: “The Prophet (ﷺ) sternly discouraged drinking while standing.”

hadiths.ar: 2113 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُصَلِّي، فَسَمِعَ رَجُلًا يَقُولُ: الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ، فَلَمَّا قَضَى صَلَاتَهُ قَالَ: أَيُّكُمُ الْقَائِلُ كَلِمَةَ كَذَا وَكَذَا؟ فَأَرَمَّ الْقَوْمُ، حَتَّى قَالَهَا ثَلَاثًا، فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ: أَنَا قُلْتُهَا يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، وَمَا أَرَدْتُ بِهَا إِلَّا الْخَيْرَ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ اثْنَيْ عَشَرَ مَلَكًا ابْتَدَرُوهَا حَتَّى رَفَعُوهَا، فَقَالَ تبارك وتعالى: اكْتُبُوهَا كَمَا قَالَ عَبْدِي، إِلَّا أَنَّهُمْ سَأَلُوا رَبَّهُمْ كَيْفَ يَكْتُبُونَهَا؟ قَالَ: اكْتُبُوهَا كَمَا قَالَ عَبْدِي».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammam told us, from Qatadah, from Anas: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was praying and heard a man say: ‘Praise be to Allah, abundant, good and blessed praise.’ When he finished his prayer, he said: Who was the one who said such-and-such words? The people fell silent, until he said it three times. Then a man said: I said it, O Messenger of Allah, and I intended only good by it. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I saw twelve angels racing to be the first to take it up, until they raised it. Then the Blessed and Exalted said: Write it down as My servant said it. Except that they asked their Lord how they should write it; He said: Write it as My servant said it.”

hadiths.ar: 2114 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، «أَنَّ نَاسًا مِنْ عُرَيْنَةَ قَدِمُوا الْمَدِينَةَ، فَاجْتَوَوْهَا، فَأَمَرَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِإِبِلٍ وَرَاعِيهَا، وَأَمَرَهُمْ أَنْ يَشْرَبُوا مِنْ أَلْبَانِهَا وَأَبْوَالِهَا قَالَ: فَسَمِنُوا حَتَّى تَرَبَّعُوا، ثُمَّ قَتَلُوا الرَّاعِيَ، وَسَاقُوا الْإِبِلَ، فَأَرْسَلَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي طَلَبِهِمْ، فَأُتِي بِهِمْ، فَقَطَعَ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَرْجُلَهُمْ، وَسَمَرَ أَعْيُنَهُمْ، وَأَلْقَاهُمْ فِي الشَّمْسِ حَتَّى مُوِّتُوا».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hisham told us, from Qatadah, from Anas: “Some people from Urayna came to Madinah, and found its climate unhealthy. So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered camels and a herdsman for them, and told them to drink their milk and urine.” He said: “They grew fat, until they were well, then they killed the herdsman and drove off the camels. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent (men) in pursuit of them, and they were brought back. He had their hands and feet cut off, their eyes branded with hot nails, and had them thrown in the sun until they died.”

hadiths.ar: 2115 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، وَعَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ، وَعَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ صُهَيْبٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «لَا يَتَمَنَّيَنَّ الْمُؤْمِنُ الْمَوْتَ لِضُرٍّ نَزَلَ بِهِ، فَإِنْ كَانَ لَا بُدَّ قَائِلًا فَلْيَقُلِ: اللَّهُمَّ أَحْيِنِي مَا كَانَتِ الْحَيَاةُ خَيْرًا لِي، وَتَوَفَّنِي إِذَا كَانَتِ الْوَفَاةُ خَيْرًا لِي».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us, from Qatadah, Ali ibn Zayd and Abd al-Aziz ibn Suhayb, from Anas, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Let none of you wish for death because of some harm that has befallen him; and if he must say something, let him say: O Allah, keep me alive as long as life is better for me, and take me when death is better for me.”

hadiths.ar: 2116 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا ، يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammam told us, from Qatadah, who said: I heard Anas say: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.”

hadiths.ar: 2117 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «يَكْبَرُ ابْنُ آدَمَ وَتَشِبُّ مِنْهُ اثْنَتَانِ، حِرْصٌ عَلَى الْمَالِ، وَعَلَى طُولِ الْعُمُرِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hisham told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “The son of Adam grows old, and two things stay young in him: love of wealth and love of a long life.”

hadiths.ar: 2118 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «تَسَحَّرُوا فَإِنَّ فِي السَّحُورِ بَرَكَةً».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Abu Awanah told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Eat the pre-dawn meal (suhur), for in the pre-dawn meal there is blessing.”

hadiths.ar: 2119 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «كَانَ يَقُولُ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ، وَعَمَلٍ لَا يُرْفَعُ، وَقَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ، وَدُعَاءٍ لَا يُسْمَعُ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammad ibn Salamah told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) “used to say: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowledge that does not benefit, from deeds that are not raised up, from a heart that is not humble, and from a supplication that is not heard.”

hadiths.ar: 2120 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «كَانَ يَقُولُ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبَرَصِ وَالْجُنُونِ وَالْجُذَامِ وَسَيِّئِ الْأَسْقَامِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammad told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) “used to say: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from leprosy (baras), insanity, elephantiasis (judham), and evil diseases.”

hadiths.ar: 2121 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: «بَعَثَتْنِي أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ بِقِنَاعٍ فِيهِ رُطَبٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَجَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْبِضُ قَبْضَةً يَبْعَثُ بِهَا إِلَى أَزْوَاجِهِ، ثُمَّ أَكَلَ الْبَقِيَّةَ أَكْلَ رَجُلٍ يُعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ يَشْتَهِيهِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammam told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, who said: “Umm Sulaym sent me with a tray containing fresh dates to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a handful and sent it to his wives, then ate the rest the way a man eats something he is known to desire.”

hadiths.ar: 2122 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «يُجْمَعُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، فَيُهَمُّونَ لِذَلِكَ، يَقُولُونَ: لَوِ اسْتَشْفَعْنَا إِلَى رَبِّنَا عز وجل حَتَّى يُرِيحَنَا مِنْ مَكَانِنَا هَذَا، فَيَأْتُونَ آدَمَ عليه السلام فَيَقُولُونَ: يَا آدَمُ، أَنْتَ أَبُو النَّاسِ، خَلَقَكَ اللهُ بِيَدِهِ، وَأَسْجَدَ لَكَ مَلَائِكَتَهُ، وَعَلَّمَكَ أَسْمَاءَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، اشْفَعْ لَنَا إِلَى رَبِّنَا حَتَّى يُرِيحَنَا مِنْ مَكَانِنَا هَذَا، فَيَقُولُ: إِنِّي لَسْتُ هُنَاكُمْ - وَيَذْكُرُ لَهُمْ خَطِيئَتَهُ الَّتِي أَصَابَ - وَلَكِنِ ائْتُوا نُوحًا أَوَّلَ رَسُولٍ بَعَثَهُ اللهُ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ، فَيَأْتُونَ نُوحًا فَيَقُولُ: إِنِّي لَسْتُ هُنَاكُمْ - وَيَذْكُرُ لَهُمْ خَطِيئَتَهُ الَّتِي أَصَابَ - وَلَكِنِ ائْتُوا إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلَ الرَّحْمَنِ عليه السلام، فَيَأْتُونَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، فَيَقُولُ: إِنِّي لَسْتُ هُنَاكُمْ - وَيَذْكُرُ لَهُمْ  خَطَايَا أَصَابَهُنَّ - وَلَكِنِ ائْتُوا مُوسَى عليه السلام، عَبْدٌ آتَاهُ اللهُ التَّوْرَاةَ وَكَلَّمَهُ تَكْلِيمًا، فَيَأْتُونَ مُوسَى عليه السلام فَيَقُولُ: إِنِّي لَسْتُ هُنَاكُمْ - وَيَذْكُرُ لَهُمْ خَطِيئَتَهُ الَّتِي أَصَابَ - وَلَكِنِ ائْتُوا عِيسَى عليه السلام، عَبْدُ اللهِ وَرَسُولُهُ، وَكَلِمَةُ اللهِ وَرُوحُهُ، فَيَأْتُونَ عِيسَى فَيَقُولُ: لَسْتُ هُنَاكُمْ، وَلَكِنِ ائْتُوا مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم؛ عَبْدًا غَفَرَ اللهُ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ، فَيَأْتُونِي، فَأَنْطَلِقُ؛ فَأَسْتَأْذِنُ عَلَى رَبِّي، فَيُؤْذَنُ لِي عَلَيْهِ، فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُ رَبِّي تبارك وتعالى وَقَعْتُ سَاجِدًا، فَيَدَعُنِي مَا شَاءَ أَنْ يَدَعَنِي، ثُمَّ يُقَالُ: ارْفَعْ مُحَمَّدُ، وَقُلْ تُسْمَعْ، وَسَلْ تُعْطَهْ، وَاشْفَعْ تُشَفَّعْ، فَأَحْمَدُ رَبِّي بِمَحَامِدَ يُعَلِّمُنِيهِ، ثُمَّ أَشْفَعُ، فَيَحُدُّ لِي حَدًّا، فَأُدْخِلُهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ، ثُمَّ أَرْجِعُ، فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُ رَبِّي وَقَعْتُ لَهُ سَاجِدًا، فَيَدَعُنِي مَا شَاءَ اللهُ أَنْ يَدَعَنِي، فَيُقَالُ: ارْفَعْ مُحَمَّدُ، وَقُلْ تُسْمَعْ، وَسَلْ تُعْطَهْ، وَاشْفَعْ تُشَفَّعْ، فَأَحْمَدُ رَبِّي بِمَحَامِدَ يُعَلِّمُنِيهِ، ثُمَّ أَشْفَعُ فَيَحُدُّ لِي حَدًّا،  فَأُدْخِلُهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ، ثُمَّ أَرْجِعُ، فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُ رَبِّي وَقَعْتُ لَهُ سَاجِدًا، فَيَدَعُنِي مَا شَاءَ اللهُ أَنْ يَدَعَنِي، ثُمَّ يُقَالُ: ارْفَعْ مُحَمَّدُ، وَقُلْ تُسْمَعْ، وَسَلْ تُعْطَهْ، وَاشْفَعْ تُشَفَّعْ، فَأَحْمَدُ رَبِّي بِمَحَامِدَ يُعَلِّمُنِيهِ، ثُمَّ أَشْفَعُ، فَيَحُدُّ لِي حَدًّا، فَأُدْخِلُهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ، حَتَّى أَرْجِعَ، فَأَقُولُ: يَا رَبِّ، مَا بَقِيَ فِي النَّارِ إِلَّا مَنْ حَبَسَهُ الْقُرْآنُ»، أَيْ وَجَبَ عَلَيْهِ الْخُلُودُ.
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hisham told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “The believers will be gathered on the Day of Resurrection and will be anxious about it. They will say: If only we would seek intercession with our Lord, Mighty and Majestic, so that He may relieve us of this place of ours. So they will come to Adam (peace be upon him) and say: O Adam, you are the father of mankind; Allah created you with His own hand, made His angels prostrate to you, and taught you the names of everything. Intercede for us with our Lord so that He may relieve us from this place. He will say: I am not the one for this — and he will mention to them his error that he committed — but go to Nuh, the first messenger Allah sent to the earth. They will come to Nuh and he will say: I am not the one for this — and he will mention his error that he committed — but go to Ibrahim, the Khalil of the Most Merciful (peace be upon him). They will come to Ibrahim and he will say: I am not the one for this — and he will mention some errors he committed — but go to Musa (peace be upon him), a servant to whom Allah gave the Torah and whom He spoke to directly. They will come to Musa and he will say: I am not the one for this — and he will mention his error that he committed — but go to Isa (peace be upon him), the servant of Allah and His Messenger, and His Word and a Spirit from Him. They will come to Isa and he will say: I am not the one for this, but go to Muhammad (ﷺ), a servant whose past and future sins Allah has forgiven. So they will come to me, and I will set out and ask permission of my Lord, and it will be granted to me. When I see my Lord, Blessed and Exalted, I will fall down in prostration, and He will leave me as long as He wills. Then it will be said: Raise your head, Muhammad; speak and you will be heard; ask and you will be given; intercede and your intercession will be accepted. So I will praise my Lord with words of praise that He teaches me, then I will intercede, and He will set a limit for me, and I will admit them to Paradise. Then I will return, and when I see my Lord I will fall down before Him in prostration, and He will leave me as long as Allah wills. It will be said: Raise your head, Muhammad; speak and you will be heard; ask and you will be given; intercede and your intercession will be accepted. So I will praise my Lord with words of praise that He teaches me, then I will intercede, and He will set a limit for me, and I will admit them to Paradise. Then I will return, and when I see my Lord I will fall down before Him in prostration, and He will leave me as long as Allah wills. Then it will be said: Raise your head, Muhammad; speak and you will be heard; ask and you will be given; intercede and your intercession will be accepted. So I will praise my Lord with words of praise that He teaches me, then I will intercede, and He will set a limit for me, and I will admit them to Paradise — until I return and say: O Lord, no one remains in the Fire except those whom the Qur'an has confined.” That is: those for whom eternal abiding is obligatory.

hadiths.ar: 2123 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عِمْرَانُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «إِنَّ اللهَ عز وجل لَا يَظْلِمُ الْمُؤْمِنَ حَسَنَتَهُ، يُثَابُ عَلَيْهَا الرِّزْقَ فِي الدُّنْيَا، وَيُجْزَى بِهَا فِي الْآخِرَةِ، وَأَمَّا الْكَافِرُ فَيُعَظَّمُ بِهَا فِي الدُّنْيَا، فَإِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ لَمْ تَكُنْ لَهُ حَسَنَةٌ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Imran told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: “Indeed Allah, Mighty and Majestic, does not wrong the believer in any good deed: he is rewarded for it with provision in this world and recompensed for it in the Hereafter. As for the disbeliever, he is given a high standing in this world for it, but when the Day of Resurrection comes, he will have no good deed.”

hadiths.ar: 2124 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عِمْرَانُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «يُعْطَى الْمُؤْمِنُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ قُوَّةَ كَذَا وَكَذَا مِنَ النِّسَاءِ قِيلَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، وَيُطِيقُ ذَاكَ، قَالَ يُعْطَى قُوَّةَ مِائَةٍ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Imran told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “The believer will be given in Paradise the strength of such-and-such (many men) with regard to women.” It was said: O Messenger of Allah, will he be able to do that? He said: “He will be given the strength of a hundred.”

hadiths.ar: 2125 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عِمْرَانُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لِكُلِّ إِنْسَانٍ ثَلَاثَةُ أَخِلَّاءَ، فَأَمَّا خَلِيلٌ فَيَقُولُ: مَا أَنْفَقْتَ فَلَكَ، وَمَا أَمْسَكْتَ فَلَيْسَ لَكَ، فَذَلِكَ مَالُهُ، وَأَمَّا خَلِيلٌ فَيَقُولُ: أَنَا مَعَكَ، فَإِذَا أَتَيْتَ بَابَ الْمَلِكِ تَرَكْتُكَ وَرَجَعْتُ، فَذَاكَ أَهْلُهُ وَحَشَمُهُ، وَأَمَّا خَلِيلٌ فَيَقُولُ: أَنَا مَعَكَ حَيْثُ دَخَلْتَ وَحَيْثُ خَرَجْتَ، فَذَلِكَ عَمَلُهُ، فَيَقُولُ: إِنْ كُنْتَ لَأَهْوَنَ الثَّلَاثَةِ عَلَيَّ أَوْ قَالَ: عَلَيْكَ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Imran told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Every person has three close friends. One friend says: What you spend is yours, and what you hold back is not yours; that is his wealth. Another friend says: I am with you, but when you reach the king's door I will leave you and return; that is his family and dependents. And another friend says: I am with you wherever you enter and wherever you leave; that is his deeds. Then he (the person) says: You were the least important of the three to me,” or he said: “to you.”

hadiths.ar: 2126 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عِمْرَانُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ .  وَعَنْ أَبِي عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «خَرَجَ ثَلَاثَةٌ فِيمَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ يَرْتَادُونَ لِأَهْلِيهِمْ، فَأَصَابَتْهُمُ السَّمَاءُ، فَلَجَئُوا إِلَى جَبَلٍ، فَوَقَعَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَجَرٌ، فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ: قَدْ عَفَا الْأَثَرُ، تَرَوْنَ قَدْ وَقَعَ الْحَجَرُ، وَلَا يَعْلَمُ بِمَكَانِكُمْ إِلَّا اللهُ، فَادْعُوا اللهَ بِأَوْثَقِ أَعْمَالِكُمْ. فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمُ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ كَانَ لِي وَالِدَانِ، فَكُنْتُ أَحْلِبُ لَهُمَا فِي إِنَائِهِمَا، فَإِذَا أَتَيْتُهُمَا وَهُمَا نَائِمَانِ، قُمْتُ قَائِمًا حَتَّى يَسْتَيْقِظَا مَتَى اسْتَيْقَظَا، وَكَرِهْتُ أَنْ يَدُورَ وَسَنُهُمَا فِي رُءُوسِهِمَا، فَإِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَا شَرِبَا، فَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّمَا فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ رَجَاءَ رَحْمَتِكَ وَخَشْيَةَ عَذَابِكَ، فَفَرِّجْ عَنَّا قَالَ: فَزَالَ ثُلُثُ الْحَجَرِ. قَالَ: وَقَالَ آخَرُ: اللَّهُمَّ، إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّهَا كَانَتِ امْرَأَةٌ تُعْجِبُنِي، فَأَبَتْ أَنْ تُمَكِّنَنِي مِنْ نَفْسِهَا حَتَّى جَعَلْتُ لَهَا جُعْلًا، فَلَمَّا أَخَذْتُهَا وَفَّرْتُ لَهَا نَفْسَهَا وَجُعْلَهَا، فَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّمَا فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ خَشْيَةَ عَذَابِكَ وَرَجَاءَ رَحْمَتِكَ، فَفَرِّجْ عَنَّا، قَالَ: فَزَالَ ثُلُثٌ آخَرُ. وَقَالَ الثَّالِثُ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنِّي اسْتَأْجَرْتُ أَجِيرًا يَعْمَلُ لِي  يَوْمًا، فَعَمِلَ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ اللَّيْلُ أَعْطَيْتُهُ أَجْرَهُ، فَتَسَخَّطَهُ وَلَمْ يَأْخُذْ، فَأَخَذْتُ أَجْرَهُ، وَوَفَّرْتُ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى صَارَ مِنْ كُلِّ الْمَالِ، ثُمَّ أَتَانِي يَطْلُبُ أَجْرَهُ، فَقُلْتُ: خُذْ هَذَا كُلَّهُ لَكَ، وَلَوْ شِئْتُ لَمْ أُعْطِهِ إِلَّا أَجْرَهُ، فَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّمَا فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ رَجَاءَ رَحْمَتِكَ وَخَشْيَةَ عَذَابِكَ، فَفَرِّجْ عَنَّا قَالَ: فَزَالَ الثُّلُثُ الْآخَرُ، وَخَرَجُوا يَتَمَاشَوْنَ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Imran told us, from Qatadah, from Sa'id ibn Abi al-Hasan, from Abu Hurayrah. And from Abu Awanah, from Qatadah, from Anas, from the Prophet (ﷺ), who said: “Three men among those before you set out looking for pasture for their families. Rain overtook them, and they took refuge in a mountain, and a rock fell upon them. They said to one another: The trail has been wiped out; you see that the rock has fallen, and no one knows where you are except Allah, so call upon Allah by the most trustworthy of your deeds. One of them said: O Allah, if You know that I had two parents, and I used to milk for them in their vessel; when I came to them and they were asleep, I would stand waiting until they woke, whenever they woke, for I disliked that their drowsiness should be disturbed; and when they woke they would drink. If You know that I did that hoping for Your mercy and fearing Your punishment, then relieve us. He said: A third of the rock moved away. Another said: O Allah, if You know that there was a woman whom I desired, and she refused to give herself to me until I offered her a sum of money; and when I had gained access to her, I left her (untouched) and gave her what I had offered. If You know that I did that fearing Your punishment and hoping for Your mercy, then relieve us. He said: Another third moved away. And the third said: O Allah, if You know that I hired a laborer to work for me for a day, and he worked, and when night came I offered him his wage, but he was displeased and did not take it. So I took his wage and invested it for him until it grew into a great amount of wealth. Then he came to me asking for his wage, and I said: Take all of this, it is yours; had I wished I would have given him only his wage. If You know that I did that hoping for Your mercy and fearing Your punishment, then relieve us. He said: The last third moved away, and they went out walking.”

hadiths.ar: 2127 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عِمْرَانُ الْقَطَّانُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: «كَوَانِي أَبُو طَلْحَةَ وَرَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ أَظْهُرِنَا، فَمَا نُهِيتُ عَنْهُ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Imran al-Qattan told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, who said: “Abu Talhah cauterized me (for an ailment) while the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was among us, and I was not forbidden from it.”

hadiths.ar: 2128 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَنَتَ شَهْرًا، فَدَعَا عَلَى حَيٍّ مِنْ أَحْيَاءِ الْعَرَبِ، ثُمَّ تَرَكَهُ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hisham told us, from Qatadah, from Anas: “The Prophet (ﷺ) made qunut for a month, invoking against one of the tribes of the Arabs, then he abandoned it.”

hadiths.ar: 2129 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم «نَهَى أَنْ يَشْرَبَ الرَّجُلُ قَائِمًا، فَقُلْتُ لِأَنَسٍ: فَمَا تَقُولُ فِي الْأَكْلِ قَائِمًا؟ قَالَ: هُوَ أَشَدُّ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Yazid ibn Ibrahim told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, that the Prophet (ﷺ) “forbade a man to drink while standing.” I said to Anas: What do you say about eating while standing? He said: “That is worse.”

hadiths.ar: 2130 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، قَالَ:  سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا ، يَقُولُ: «جَمَعَ الْقُرْآنَ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَرْبَعَةٌ، أُبَيُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ، وَمُعَاذٌ، وَزَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ، وَأَبُو زَيْدٍ » قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَنَسٍ: مَنْ أَبُو زَيْدٍ؟ قَالَ: أَحَدُ عُمُومَتِي.
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us, from Qatadah, who said: I heard Anas say: “Four people collected (memorized) the Qur'an in the time of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): Ubayy ibn Ka'b, Mu'adh, Zayd ibn Thabit, and Abu Zayd.” He said: I said to Anas: Who is Abu Zayd? He said: “One of my paternal uncles.”

hadiths.ar: 2131 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «مَا بَالُ أَقْوَامٍ يَرْفَعُونَ أَبْصَارَهُمْ فِي الصَّلَاةِ فَاشْتَدَّ قَوْلُهُ فِي ذَلِكَ حَتَّى قَالَ: لَيَنْتَهُنَّ عَنْ ذَلِكَ أَوْ لَتُخْطَفَنَّ أَبْصَارُهُمْ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammam told us, from Qatadah, from Anas, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “What is the matter with people who raise their gaze (to the sky) during prayer?” His words on that became severe until he said: “They must stop that, or their eyesight will be snatched away.”

sections.title_ar: ثَابِتٌ الْبُنَانِيُّ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ
sections.title_en: Thabit al-Bunani from Anas ibn Malik

hadiths.ar: 2132 - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، «أَنَّ رَجُلًا كَانَ يَكْتُبُ لِرَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَكَانَ إِذَا أَمْلَى عَلَيْهِ: سَمِيعًا بَصِيرًا، كَتَبَ: سَمِيعًا عَلِيمًا، فَإِذَا كَانَ: سَمِيعًا عَلِيمًا كَتَبَ: سَمِيعًا بَصِيرًا، وَكَانَ قَدْ قَرَأَ الْبَقَرَةَ وَآلَ عِمْرَانَ، وَكَانَ مَنْ قَرَأَهُمَا فَقَدْ قَرَأَ قُرْآنًا كَثِيرًا، قَالَ: فَتَنَصَّرَ الرَّجُلُ، وَقَالَ: إِنَّمَا كُنْتُ أَكْتُبُ مَا شِئْتُ عِنْدَ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ: فَمَاتَ فَدُفِنَ فَلَفَظَتْهُ الْأَرْضُ، ثُمَّ دُفِنَ فَلَفَظَتْهُ الْأَرْضُ، قَالَ أَنَسٌ: قَالَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ: فَأَنَا رَأَيْتُهُ مَنْبُوذًا عَلَى ظَهْرِ الْأَرْضِ».
hadiths.en: Yunus told us: Abu Dawud told us: Hammad ibn Salamah told us, from Thabit, from Anas: “A man used to write for the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). When he dictated to him: ‘All-Hearing, All-Seeing,’ he would write: ‘All-Hearing, All-Knowing’; and when it was ‘All-Hearing, All-Knowing,’ he would write: ‘All-Hearing, All-Seeing.’ He had recited al-Baqarah and Al Imran, and whoever recited those had recited a great deal of the Qur'an. He said: Then the man became a Christian and said: I only used to write whatever I wished for Muhammad. He said: Then he died and was buried, and the earth cast him out; he was buried again and the earth cast him out.” Anas said: Abu Talhah said: “I myself saw him cast out on the surface of the earth.”

hadiths.ar: 2133 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا طَلْحَةُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو قَالَ:  سَمِعْتُ ثَابِتًا يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْرُجُ عَلَيْنَا وَقَدْ نُودِيَ بِالْمَغْرِبِ وَنَحْنُ نُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ، فَلَا يَأْمُرُنَا وَلَا يَنْهَانَا».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Talhah ibn Amr told us, he said: I heard Thabit narrating from Anas, who said: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to come out to us after the call for Maghrib had been made, while we were praying two rak'ahs, and he would neither command us nor forbid us.”

hadiths.ar: 2134 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ عَطِيَّةَ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: «كَانَ الَّذِي تَزَوَّجَ عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ، عَلَى شَيْءٍ قِيمَتُهُ عَشَرَةُ دَرَاهِمَ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: al-Hakam ibn Atiyyah told us, from Thabit, from Anas, who said: “The dowry on which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) married Umm Salamah was something valued at ten dirhams.”

hadiths.ar: 2135 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ يَحْيَى الْأَبَحُّ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «مَثَلُ أُمَّتِي مَثَلُ الْمَطَرِ، لَا يُدْرَى أَوَّلُهُ خَيْرٌ أَمْ آخِرُهُ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammad ibn Yahya al-Abahh told us: Thabit told us, from Anas, that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: “The likeness of my community is like the rain; it is not known whether its beginning is better or its end.”

hadiths.ar: 2136 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «لَمَّا صَوَّرَ اللهُ، عز وجل، آدَمَ عليه السلام تَرَكَهُ مَا شَاءَ أَنْ يَتْرُكَهُ، فَجَعَلَ إِبْلِيسُ يُطِيفُ بِهِ يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ، فَلَمَّا رَآهُ أَجْوَفَ عَلِمَ أَنَّهُ خَلْقٌ لَا يَتَمَالَكُ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammad ibn Salamah told us, from Thabit, from Anas, that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “When Allah, Mighty and Majestic, shaped Adam (peace be upon him), He left him as long as He willed to leave him. Iblis began to go around him, looking at him, and when he saw that he was hollow, he knew that he was a creature that cannot control itself.”

hadiths.ar: 2137 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَشْجَعَ النَّاسِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammad ibn Zayd told us, from Thabit, from Anas, who said: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was the bravest of people.”

hadiths.ar: 2138 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ أَوْ عُثْمَانُ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «الشَّفَاعَةُ لِأَهْلِ الْكَبَائِرِ مِنْ أُمَّتِي».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: al-Hakam or Uthman told us, from Thabit, from Anas, from the Prophet (ﷺ), who said: “My intercession is for those of my community who committed major sins.”

hadiths.ar: 2139 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: «دَخَلَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَا نَحْنُ إِلَّا أَنَا وَأُمِّي وَخَالَتِي أُمُّ حَرَامٍ، فَقَالَ: قُومُوا أُصَلِّي بِكُمْ فَصَلَّى بِنَا فِي غَيْرِ وَقْتِ صَلَاةٍ، قَالَ رَجُلٌ لِثَابِتٍ: فَأَيْنَ جَعَلَ أَنَسٌ؟ قَالَ: جَعَلَهُ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ، فَلَمَّا قَضَى صَلَاتَهُ دَعَا لَنَا - أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ - بِكُلِّ خَيْرٍ مِنْ أَمْرِ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، فَقَالَتْ أُمِّي: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، خُوَيْدِمُكَ، ادْعُ اللهَ لَهُ، قَالَ: فَدَعَا لِي بِكُلِّ خَيْرٍ، فَكَانَ فِي آخِرِ مَا دَعَا لِي: اللَّهُمَّ أَكْثِرْ مَالَهُ وَوَلَدَهُ، وَبَارِكْ لَهُ فِيهِ». قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ : فَذَكَرُوا أَنَّ أَنَسًا قَالَ: فَوُلِدَ مِنْ صُلْبِي ثَمَانُونَ.
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Sulayman ibn al-Mughirah told us, from Thabit, from Anas, who said: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came in to us, and there was no one but me, my mother and my maternal aunt Umm Haram. He said: Stand, let me lead you in prayer. So he prayed with us at a time that was not a prayer time.” A man said to Thabit: Where did he put Anas? He said: “He put him on his right. When he finished his prayer, he supplicated for us — the people of the house — for every good of this world and the next. My mother said: O Messenger of Allah, your little servant; pray to Allah for him. He said: So he prayed for me for every good, and among the last things he prayed for me was: O Allah, increase his wealth and his children, and bless him in it.” Abu Dawud said: They mention that Anas said: “Eighty were born from my own loins.”

hadiths.ar: 2140 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِذَا أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ فَلَا تَقُومُوا حَتَّى تَرَوْنِي».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Jarir ibn Hazim told us, from Thabit, from Anas, who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “When the iqamah is called for prayer, do not stand until you see me.”

hadiths.ar: 2141 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: «خَرَجَ ابْنُ عَمَّتِي حَارِثَةُ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ غُلَامًا نَظَّارًا، مَا خَرَجَ إِلَى الْقِتَالِ، وَأَصَابَهُ سَهْمٌ فَقَتَلَهُ، فَجَاءَتْ أُمُّهُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم،  فَقَالَتْ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، إِنْ يَكُنْ حَارِثَةُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ فَسَأَصْبِرُ، وَإِنْ يَكُ غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ فَسَتَرَى مَا أَصْنَعُ، فَقَالَ: يَا أُمَّ حَارِثَةَ، إِنَّهَا جِنَانٌ كَثِيرَةٌ، وَإِنَّ حَارِثَةَ فِي الْفِرْدَوْسِ الْأَعْلَى».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Sulayman ibn al-Mughirah told us, from Thabit, from Anas, who said: “My aunt's son Harithah went out on the day of Badr as a youth, merely to watch; he had not gone out to fight. An arrow struck him and killed him. His mother came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: O Messenger of Allah, if Harithah is in Paradise, I will be patient; and if it is otherwise, you will see what I do. He said: O Umm Harithah, there are many gardens, and Harithah is in the highest Firdaws.”

hadiths.ar: 2142 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: «مَا صَلَّيْتُ خَلْفَ أَحَدٍ أَخَفَّ صَلَاةً مِنْ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي تَمَامٍ، وَكَانَتْ صَلَاةُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ رحمه الله مُقَارِبَةً، فَلَمَّا كَانَ عُمَرُ رحمه الله مَدَّ فِي الْفَجْرِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammad told us, from Thabit, from Anas, who said: “I never prayed behind anyone whose prayer was lighter yet complete than the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The prayer of Abu Bakr, may Allah have mercy on him, was similar. When Umar's time came, he prolonged the Fajr prayer.”

hadiths.ar: 2143 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، قَالَ: «أَخْرَجَ إِلَيْنَا أَنَسٌ قَدَحًا، فَقَالَ: سَقَيْتُ فِي هَذَا رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الشَّرَابَ؛ الْمَاءَ، وَالْعَسَلَ، وَاللَّبَنَ، وَالنَّبِيذَ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammad told us, from Thabit, who said: “Anas brought out a cup to us and said: I gave the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) drinks in this: water, honey, milk, and nabidh.”

hadiths.ar: 2144 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ ، وَحَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: «كُنْتُ أَخْدُمُ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَخَدَمْتُهُ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ، فَلَمَّا فَرَغْتُ مِنْ خِدْمَتِي، وَرَجَعْتُ أُرِيدُ أُمِّي، رَأَيْتُ صِبْيَانًا يَلْعَبُونَ، فَقُمْتُ أَنْظُرُ إِلَى لَعِبِهِمْ، فَانْتَهَى إِلَيْهِمْ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِمْ، ثُمَّ دَعَانِي فَبَعَثَنِي فِي حَاجَةٍ لَهُ، وَجَلَسَ فِي فَيْءٍ حَتَّى أَتَيْتُهُ،  فَاحْتَبَسْتُ عَنْ أُمِّي عَنِ الْوَقْتِ الَّذِي كُنْتُ آتِيهَا فِيهِ فَقَالَتْ: أَيْ بُنَيَّ، مَا حَبَسَكَ؟ فَأَخْبَرْتُهَا، فَقَالَتْ: فَمَا هَذَا الَّذِي بَعَثَكَ؟ فَقُلْتُ: يَا أُمَّهْ، إِنَّهُ سِرُّ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ: يَا بُنَيَّ، فَاحْفَظْ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سِرَّهُ، فَمَا أَخْبَرْتُ بِهِ أَحَدًا مِنَ النَّاسِ، وَلَوْ كُنْتُ مُخْبِرًا بِهِ أَحَدًا أَخْبَرْتُكَ بِهِ يَا ثَابِتُ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Sulayman ibn al-Mughirah and Hammad ibn Salamah told us, from Thabit, from Anas, who said: “I used to serve the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). One day I served him, and when I finished my service and was returning, intending to go to my mother, I saw some boys playing, so I stood watching their play. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to them, greeted them with salam, then called me and sent me on an errand of his, and sat in the shade until I came back to him. I was delayed in reaching my mother at the time I usually came to her, and she said: Dear son, what delayed you? I told her, and she said: What was the errand he sent you on? I said: Mother, it is a secret of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). She said: Dear son, keep the secret of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). So I never told it to anyone; and if I were to tell anyone, I would have told you, O Thabit.”

hadiths.ar: 2145 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، قَالَ: «كُنَّا عِنْدَ أَنَسٍ فَقَالَ: وَاللهِ مَا أَعْرِفُ الْيَوْمَ شَيْئًا كُنْتُ أَعْرِفُهُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالُوا: يَا أَبَا حَمْزَةَ، وَالصَّلَاةُ؟ قَالَ: أَوَلَيْسَ  أَحْدَثْتُمْ فِي الصَّلَاةِ مَا أَحْدَثْتُمْ؟».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammad ibn Salamah told us, from Thabit, who said: “We were with Anas and he said: By Allah, today I recognize nothing of what I used to know in the time of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). They said: O Abu Hamzah, not even the prayer? He said: Have you not introduced into the prayer what you have introduced?”

hadiths.ar: 2146 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُغِيرُ عِنْدَ الصَّبَاحِ، فَيَسْتَمِعُ، فَإِنْ سَمِعَ أَذَانًا أَمْسَكَ، وَإِلَّا أَغَارَ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammad ibn Salamah told us, from Thabit, from Anas, who said: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to launch raids at dawn. He would listen, and if he heard the adhan he would hold back; otherwise he would attack.”

hadiths.ar: 2147 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، «أَنَّ عَبَّادَ بْنَ بِشْرٍ الْأَنْصَارِيَّ، وَأُسَيْدَ بْنَ حُضَيْرٍ  الْأَنْصَارِيَّ، خَرَجَا إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي لَيْلَةٍ حِنْدِسٍ، يَعْنِي ظَلْمَاءَ، فَلَمَّا رَجَعَا إِلَى بُيُوتِهِمَا، صَارَ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمَا ضَوْءٌ، حَتَّى إِذَا أَرَادَا أَنْ يَتَفَرَّقَا، صَارَ مَعَ كُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا ضَوْءٌ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammad ibn Salamah told us, from Thabit, from Anas: “Abbad ibn Bishr al-Ansari and Usayd ibn Hudayr al-Ansari went out to the prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on a pitch-dark night. When they returned to their homes, a light appeared before them, until, when they were about to part ways, each of them had a light with him.”

hadiths.ar: 2148 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم «كَانَ يُكْثِرُ أَنْ يَدْعُوَ؛ يَقُولُ: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً، وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً، وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ». قَالَ شُعْبَةُ: فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِقَتَادَةَ، فَقَالَ: كَانَ أَنَسٌ يَدْعُو بِهِ، وَلَمْ يَرْفَعْهُ.
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us, from Thabit, from Anas, that the Prophet (ﷺ) “used to supplicate often, saying: O Allah, our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.” Shu'bah said: I mentioned that to Qatadah, and he said: Anas used to supplicate with it, and did not attribute it to the Prophet.

hadiths.ar: 2149 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَصُومُ حَتَّى يَقُولَ: صَامَ صَامَ، وَيُفْطِرُ حَتَّى يَقُولَ: أَفْطَرَ أَفْطَرَ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammad ibn Salamah told us, from Thabit, from Anas, who said: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would fast until it was said: He has fasted, he has fasted (and will not stop); and he would not fast until it was said: He has stopped fasting, he has stopped fasting.”

hadiths.ar: 2150 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ: «إِنَّ أَهْلَ الْيَمَنِ قَدِمُوا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَقَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ: ابْعَثْ مَعَنَا مُعَاذَ بْنَ جَبَلٍ يُعَلِّمُنَا كِتَابَ رَبِّنَا وَسُنَّةَ نَبِيِّنَا، فَأَخَذَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ بْنِ الْجَرَّاحِ، فَقَالَ: هَذَا أَمِينُ هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةِ فَبَعَثَهُ مَعَهُمْ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammad ibn Salamah told us, from Thabit, from Anas, who said: “The people of Yemen came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: O Messenger of Allah, send with us Mu'adh ibn Jabal to teach us the Book of our Lord and the Sunnah of our Prophet. So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took Abu Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah by the hand and said: This is the trustworthy one of this community, and sent him with them.”

hadiths.ar: 2151 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: «كَانَ يَنْعَتُ لَنَا صَلَاةَ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: فَإِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ  الرُّكُوعِ قَامَ حَتَّى نَقُولَ: قَدْ نَسِيَ، مِنْ طُولِ الْقِيَامِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us, from Thabit, from Anas, who said: “He used to describe to us the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): when he raised his head from bowing, he would stand so long that we would say: He has forgotten, because of the length of his standing.”

hadiths.ar: 2152 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «الصَّبْرُ عِنْدَ أَوَّلِ الصَّدْمَةِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us, from Thabit, from Anas, who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Patience is at the first strike of calamity.”

hadiths.ar: 2153 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا صَالِحٌ الْمُرِّيُّ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «عُمَّارُ مَسَاجِدِ اللهِ هُمْ أَهْلُ  اللهِ عز وجل».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Salih al-Murri told us, from Thabit, from Anas, who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Those who frequent the mosques of Allah are the people of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.”

hadiths.ar: 2154 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بِشْرٍ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَتَبَّعُ الطِّيبَ فِي رِبَاعِ النِّسَاءِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Abu Bishr told us, from Thabit, from Anas, who said: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to seek out perfume in the dwellings of women.”

hadiths.ar: 2155 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: «كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُكَلَّمُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ إِذَا نَزَلَ مِنَ الْمِنْبَرِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Jarir ibn Hazim told us, from Thabit, from Anas, who said: “The Prophet (ﷺ) would be spoken to on Friday when he came down from the pulpit.”

hadiths.ar: 2156 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: «كَانَ النِّسَاءُ يَدْخُلْنَ بِالْقِرَبِ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammad ibn Salamah told us, from Thabit, from Anas, who said: “The women used to come in carrying waterskins on the day of Uhud.”

hadiths.ar: 2157 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ ، عَنْ  ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: «جَاءَ خَالِي أَنَسُ بْنُ النَّضْرِ وَبِهِ سُمِّيتُ، لَمْ يَشْهَدْ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَدْرًا، فَعَظُمَ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِ، وَقَالَ: أَوَّلُ مَشْهَدٍ شَهِدَهُ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم غِبْتُ عَنْهُ، أَمَا وَاللهِ لَئِنْ أَرَانِي اللهُ مَشْهَدًا بَعْدَهُ لَيَرَيَنَّ اللهُ مَا أَصْنَعُ، قَالَ: فَهَابَ أَنْ يَقُولَ غَيْرَهَا، فَلَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ أُحُدٍ مِنَ الْعَامِ الْمُقْبِلِ، شَهِدَ، فَرَأَى سَعْدَ بْنَ مُعَاذٍ مُنْهَزِمًا، فَقَالَ: أَيْنَ يَا أَبَا عَمْرٍو؟ وَاهًا لِرِيحِ الْجَنَّةِ أَجِدُهَا دُونَ أُحُدٍ، فَقَاتَلَ حَتَّى قُتِلَ، فَوُجِدَ بِهِ بِضْعٌ وَثَمَانُونَ؛ مَا بَيْنَ ضَرْبَةٍ وَطَعْنَةٍ وَرَمْيَةٍ، فَقَالَتْ أُخْتُهُ الرُّبَيِّعُ بِنْتُ النَّضْرِ: وَاللهِ مَا عَرَفْتُ أَخِي إِلَّا بِبَنَانِهِ، كَانَ حَسَنَ الْبَنَانِ، قَالَ: وَأُنْزِلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآيَةُ: {مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رِجَالٌ صَدَقُوا مَا عَاهَدُوا اللهَ عَلَيْهِ} الْآيَةَ، قَالَ أَنَسٌ: فَكُنَّا نُرَى أَنَّهَا نَزَلَتْ فِيهِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Sulayman ibn al-Mughirah told us, from Thabit, from Anas, who said: “My maternal uncle Anas ibn al-Nadr — after whom I was named — came; he had not been present with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) at Badr, and this weighed heavily upon him. He said: The first battle the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) fought and I was absent from it! By Allah, if Allah shows me another battle after it, Allah will surely see what I do. He said: He feared to say more than that. On the day of Uhud the following year, he took part, and he saw Sa'd ibn Mu'adh retreating. He said: Where to, O Abu Amr? Ah, the fragrance of Paradise! I find it beyond Uhud. So he fought until he was killed, and more than eighty wounds were found on him — blows of the sword, thrusts of the spear, and shots of the arrow. His sister al-Rubayyi' bint al-Nadr said: By Allah, I recognized my brother only by his fingertips; he had beautiful fingertips.” He said: “And this verse was revealed: {Among the believers are men who have been true to what they covenanted with Allah} (the verse).” Anas said: “We used to think that it was revealed about him.”

hadiths.ar: 2158 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: «لَمَّا ثَقُلَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَتْ فَاطِمَةُ: وَاكَرْبَاهُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ عَلَى أَبِيكِ كَرْبٌ بَعْدَ الْيَوْمِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: al-Mubarak ibn Fadalah told us, from Thabit, from Anas, who said: “When the illness of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) grew heavy, Fatimah said: Oh, the distress! The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: There is no distress for your father after today.”

hadiths.ar: 2159 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَارَةُ بْنُ زَاذَانَ ، قَالَ: «كُنَّا عِنْدَ ثَابِتٍ، وَعِنْدَهُ شَيْخٌ، فَذَكَرْنَا مَا يُقْرَأُ فِي الْعِيدَيْنِ، فَقَالَ الشَّيْخُ : صَحِبْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ إِلَى الزَّاوِيَةِ يَوْمَ عِيدٍ، وَإِذَا مَوْلًى لَهُ يُصَلِّي بِهِمْ، فَقَرَأَ: {سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الْأَعْلَى}، {وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَى}، فَقَالَ أَنَسٌ: لَقَدْ قَرَأَ بِالسُّورَتَيْنِ اللَّتَيْنِ قَرَأَ بِهِمَا رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْعِيدِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Umarah ibn Zadhan told us, he said: “We were with Thabit, and an old man was with him, and we mentioned what is recited in the two Eid prayers. The old man said: I accompanied Anas ibn Malik to al-Zawiyah on the day of Eid, and one of his freedmen led them in prayer. He recited: {Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High} and {By the night when it covers}. Anas said: He has recited the two surahs that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited in the Eid prayer.”

hadiths.ar: 2160 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا ، يَقُولُ: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ فِي الدُّعَاءِ حَتَّى يُرَى بَيَاضُ إِبْطَيْهِ. قَالَ شُعْبَةُ: فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِعَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، فَقَالَ: إِنَّمَا ذَلِكَ فِي الِاسْتِسْقَاءِ، قُلْتُ: سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ أَنَسٍ؟ فَقَالَ: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Shu'bah told us, from Thabit, who said: I heard Anas say: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to raise his hands in supplication until the whiteness of his armpits could be seen.” Shu'bah said: I mentioned that to Ali ibn Zayd, and he said: That was only in the prayer for rain. I said: Did you hear it from Anas? He said: Glory be to Allah!

hadiths.ar: 2161 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: «كَانَ أَنْجَشَةُ يَحْدُو بِالنِّسَاءِ، وَكَانَ الْبَرَاءُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ يَحْدُو بِالرِّجَالِ، وَكَانَ أَنْجَشَةُ حَسَنَ الصَّوْتِ، وَكَانَ إِذَا حَدَا أَعْنَقَتِ الْإِبِلُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: وَيْلَكَ يَا أَنْجَشَةُ، رُوَيْدَكَ سَوْقَكَ بِالْقَوَارِيرِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammad ibn Salamah told us, from Thabit, from Anas, who said: “Anjashah used to lead the women's camels with chanting, and al-Bara' ibn Malik used to lead the men's. Anjashah had a beautiful voice, and when he chanted the camels would speed up. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Woe to you, O Anjashah! Gently — you are driving glass vessels (the women).”

hadiths.ar: 2162 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: «دَخَلَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي شَكْوَاهُ الَّذِي قُبِضَ فِيهِ، فَقَالَ: أَقْرِئْ قَوْمَكَ السَّلَامَ، فَإِنَّهُمْ أَعِفَّةٌ صُبُرٌ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Muhammad ibn Thabit told us, from his father, from Anas, who said: “Abu Talhah came to the Prophet (ﷺ) during the illness in which he passed away, and he said: Convey my greetings of peace to your people, for they are chaste and patient.”

hadiths.ar: 2163 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «أَوَّلُ شَيْءٍ يَحْشُرُ النَّاسَ نَارٌ تَحْشُرُهُمْ مِنَ الْمَشْرِقِ إِلَى الْمَغْرِبِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammad ibn Salamah told us, from Thabit, from Anas, from the Prophet (ﷺ), who said: “The first thing that will gather the people is a fire that will gather them from the east to the west.”

hadiths.ar: 2164 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «أَوَّلُ شَيْءٍ يَأْكُلُهُ أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ زِيَادَةُ كَبِدِ الْحُوتِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammad ibn Salamah told us, from Thabit, from Anas, from the Prophet (ﷺ), who said: “The first thing that the people of Paradise will eat is the extra lobe of the liver of a whale.”

hadiths.ar: 2165 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: «كَانَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ إِذَا حَاضَتْ لَمْ يُؤَاكِلُوهَا، وَلَمْ يُشَارِبُوهَا، وَلَمْ يُجَامِعُوهَا فِي الْبَيْتِ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللهُ عز وجل: {وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْمَحِيضِ قُلْ هُوَ أَذًى} إِلَى قَوْلِهِ: {حَتَّى يَطْهُرْنَ}، فَأَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُؤَاكِلُوهُنَّ، وَأَنْ يُشَارِبُوهُنَّ، وَأَنْ يُجَامِعُوهُنَّ فِي الْبُيُوتِ، وَيَفْعَلُوا مَا شَاءُوا إِلَّا الْجِمَاعَ، فَقَالَتِ الْيَهُودُ: مَا يُرِيدُ هَذَا الرَّجُلُ أَنْ يَدَعَ شَيْئًا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا إِلَّا خَالَفَنَا فِيهِ، فَجَاءَ أُسَيْدُ بْنُ حُضَيْرٍ، وَعَبَّادُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، فَذَكَرَا ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ قَوْلِ الْيَهُودِ، فَقَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، أَفَلَا نُجَامِعُهُنَّ؟ فَتَمَعَّرَ وَجْهُ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى ظَنَنَّا أَنَّهُ قَدْ وَجَدَ عَلَيْهِمَا، فَخَرَجَا مِنْ عِنْدِهِ، فَجَاءَتْ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم هَدِيَّةُ لَبَنٍ، فَبَعَثَ فِي آثَارِهِمَا حَتَّى سَقَاهُمَا مِنَ اللَّبَنِ، فَظَنَنَّا أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَجِدْ عَلَيْهِمَا».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammad ibn Salamah told us, from Thabit, from Anas, who said: “When a Jewish woman menstruated, they would not eat with her, nor drink with her, nor live with her in the house. So Allah, Mighty and Majestic, revealed: {They ask you about menstruation. Say: It is an impurity} to His words: {until they are pure}. So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded them to eat with them, drink with them, live with them in the houses, and do whatever they wished except intercourse. The Jews said: This man does not wish to leave anything of our practice without opposing us in it. Then Usayd ibn Hudayr and Abbad ibn Bishr came and mentioned to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) what the Jews had said, and said: O Messenger of Allah, should we not have intercourse with them? The face of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) changed color until we thought he was angry with them. They left from his presence, and then a gift of milk came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), so he sent after them and gave them milk to drink; and we thought that he was not angry with them.”

hadiths.ar: 2166 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَا تَحَابَّ رَجُلَانِ فِي اللهِ عز وجل إِلَّا كَانَ أَفْضَلُهُمَا أَشَدَّهُمَا حُبًّا لِصَاحِبِهِ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: al-Mubarak ibn Fadalah told us, from Thabit, from Anas, who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: “Two men do not love each other for the sake of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, but the better of the two is the one who loves his companion more intensely.”

hadiths.ar: 2167 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ،  عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم اشْتَرَى صَفِيَّةَ بِسَبْعَةِ أَرْؤُسٍ».
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Hammad ibn Salamah told us, from Thabit, from Anas: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) acquired Safiyyah for seven heads (of slaves).”

hadiths.ar: 2168 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ ، وَحَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، وَجَعْفَرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ ، - كُلُّهُمْ - عَنْ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ . قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ : وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ شَيْخٌ سَمِعَهُ مِنَ النَّضْرِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ - وَقَدْ دَخَلَ حَدِيثُ بَعْضِهِمْ فِي بَعْضٍ - قَالَ: «قَالَ مَالِكٌ أَبُو أَنَسٍ لِامْرَأَتِهِ أُمِّ سُلَيْمٍ - وَهِيَ أُمُّ أَنَسٍ -: إِنَّ هَذَا الرَّجُلَ - يَعْنِي النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُحَرِّمُ الْخَمْرَ، فَانْطَلَقَ حَتَّى أَتَى الشَّامَ فَهَلَكَ هُنَاكَ، فَجَاءَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ فَخَطَبَ أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ، فَكَلَّمَهَا فِي ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَتْ: يَا أَبَا طَلْحَةَ، مَا مِثْلُكَ يُرَدُّ، وَلَكِنَّكَ امْرُؤٌ كَافِرٌ، وَأَنَا امْرَأَةٌ مُسْلِمَةٌ، لَا يَصْلُحُ لِي أَنْ أَتَزَوَّجَكَ، فَقَالَ: مَا ذَاكَ دَهْرُكِ، قَالَتْ: وَمَا دَهْرِي؟ قَالَ: الصَّفْرَاءُ وَالْبَيْضَاءُ، قَالَتْ: فَإِنِّي لَا أُرِيدُ صَفْرَاءَ وَلَا بَيْضَاءَ، أُرِيدُ مِنْكَ الْإِسْلَامَ، قَالَ: فَمَنْ لِي بِذَلِكَ؟ قَالَتْ: لَكَ بِذَلِكَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَانْطَلَقَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ يُرِيدُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم،  وَرَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَالِسٌ فِي أَصْحَابِهِ، فَلَمَّا رَآهُ قَالَ: جَاءَكُمْ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ، غُرَّةُ الْإِسْلَامِ بَيْنَ عَيْنَيْهِ. فَجَاءَ، فَأَخْبَرَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَا قَالَتْ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ، فَتَزَوَّجَهَا عَلَى ذَلِكَ، قَالَ ثَابِتٌ: فَمَا بَلَغَنَا أَنَّ مَهْرًا كَانَ أَعْظَمَ مِنْهُ، إِنَّهَا رَضِيَتِ الْإِسْلَامَ مَهْرًا، فَتَزَوَّجَهَا، وَكَانَتِ امْرَأَةً مَلِيحَةَ الْعَيْنَيْنِ، فِيهَا صِغَرٌ، فَكَانَتْ مَعَهُ حَتَّى وُلِدَ لَهُ بُنَيٌّ، وَكَانَ يُحِبُّهُ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ حُبًّا شَدِيدًا، وَمَرِضَ الصَّبِيُّ، وَتَوَاضَعَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ لِمَرَضِهِ أَوْ تَضَعْضَعَ لَهُ، فَانْطَلَقَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَمَاتَ الصَّبِيُّ، فَقَالَتْ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ: لَا يَنْعَيَنَّ إِلَى أَبِي طَلْحَةَ أَحَدٌ ابْنَهُ، حَتَّى أَكُونَ أَنَا الَّذِي أَنْعَاهُ لَهُ، فَهَيَّأَتِ الصَّبِيَّ وَوَضَعَتْهُ، وَجَاءَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ مِنْ عِنْدِ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، حَتَّى دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا، فَقَالَ: كَيْفَ ابْنِي؟ فَقَالَتْ: يَا أَبَا طَلْحَةَ، مَا كَانَ مُنْذُ اشْتَكَى أَسْكَنَ مِنْهُ السَّاعَةَ، قَالَ: فَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ، فَأَتَتْهُ بِعَشَائِهِ، فَأَصَابَ مِنْهُ، ثُمَّ قَامَتْ فَتَطَيَّبَتْ وَتَعَرَّضَتْ لَهُ فَأَصَابَ مِنْهَا، فَلَمَّا عَلِمَتْ أَنَّهُ طَعِمَ وَأَصَابَ مِنْهَا، قَالَتْ: يَا أَبَا طَلْحَةَ، أَرَأَيْتَ لَوْ أَنَّ قَوْمًا أَعَارُوا قَوْمًا عَارِيَّةً لَهُمْ، فَسَأَلُوهُمْ إِيَّاهَا، أَكَانَ لَهُمْ أَنْ يَمْنَعُوهُمْ؟ فَقَالَ: لَا، قَالَتْ: فَإِنَّ اللهَ عز وجل كَانَ  أَعَارَكَ ابْنَكَ عَارِيَّةً ثُمَّ قَبَضَهُ إِلَيْهِ، فَاحْتَسِبِ ابْنَكَ وَاصْبِرْ، فَغَضِبَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: تَرَكْتِينِي حَتَّى إِذَا وَقَعْتُ بِمَا وَقَعْتُ بِهِ، نَعَيْتِ إِلَيَّ ابْنِي، ثُمَّ غَدَا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَهُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: بَارَكَ اللهُ لَكُمَا فِي غَابِرِ لَيْلَتِكُمَا فَتَلَقَّتْ مِنْ ذَلِكَ الْحَمْلَ، وَكَانَتْ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ تُسَافِرُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، تَخْرُجُ مَعَهُ إِذَا خَرَجَ، وَتَدْخُلُ مَعَهُ إِذَا دَخَلَ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: إِذَا وَلَدَتْ فَأْتُونِي بِالصَّبِيِّ فَأَخَذَهَا الطَّلْقُ لَيْلَةَ قُرْبِهِمْ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ، فَقَالَتِ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي كُنْتُ أَدْخُلُ إِذَا دَخَلَ نَبِيُّكَ، وَأَخْرُجُ إِذَا خَرَجَ نَبِيُّكَ، وَقَدْ حَضَرَ هَذَا الْأَمْرُ، فَوَلَدَتْ غُلَامًا، وَقَالَتْ لِابْنِهَا أَنَسٍ، انْطَلِقْ بِالصَّبِيِّ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَأَخَذَ أَنَسٌ الصَّبِيَّ فَانْطَلَقَ بِهِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَهُوَ يَسِمُ إِبِلًا أَوْ غَنَمًا، فَلَمَّا نَظَرَ إِلَيْهِ قَالَ لِأَنَسٍ: أَوَلَدَتْ بِنْتُ مِلْحَانَ؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ، فَأَلْقَى مَا فِي يَدِهِ، فَتَنَاوَلَ الصَّبِيَّ، فَقَالَ: ائْتُونِي بِتَمَرَاتٍ عَجْوَةٍ فَأَخَذَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم التَّمْرَ، فَجَعَلَ يُحَنِّكُ الصَّبِيَّ، وَجَعَلَ الصَّبِيُّ يَتَلَمَّظُ، فَقَالَ: انْظُرُوا إِلَى حُبِّ الْأَنْصَارِ التَّمْرَ فَحَنَّكَهُ رَسُولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَسَمَّاهُ عَبْدَ اللهِ». قَالَ ثَابِتٌ: وَكَانَ يُعَدُّ مِنْ خِيَارِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ.
hadiths.en: Abu Dawud told us: Sulayman ibn al-Mughirah, Hammad ibn Salamah and Ja'far ibn Sulayman — all of them — told us, from Thabit, from Anas. Abu Dawud said: And a shaykh who heard it from al-Nadr ibn Anas told it to us as well — and parts of one narration have entered into another — he said: “Malik, Abu Anas, said to his wife Umm Sulaym — who was the mother of Anas: This man — meaning the Prophet (ﷺ) — prohibits wine. So he left until he reached Syria and died there. Then Abu Talhah came and proposed to Umm Sulaym and spoke to her about it. She said: O Abu Talhah, a man like you is not turned away, but you are a disbeliever and I am a Muslim woman; it is not proper for me to marry you. He said: That is not what you want. She said: And what do I want? He said: Yellow and white (gold and silver). She said: I do not want yellow or white; I want Islam from you. He said: Who will vouch for me in that? She said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) will for you. So Abu Talhah set out to the Prophet (ﷺ), who was sitting among his Companions. When he saw him, he said: Abu Talhah has come to you, with the blaze of Islam between his eyes. He came and told the Prophet (ﷺ) what Umm Sulaym had said, and he married her on that basis.” Thabit said: “We have not heard of any dowry greater than it; she was pleased to have Islam as her dowry. So he married her. She was a woman with beautiful eyes, and of small stature. She remained with him until a little son was born to him whom Abu Talhah loved intensely. The boy fell ill, and Abu Talhah was humbled and distressed by his illness. Abu Talhah went out to the Prophet (ﷺ), and the boy died. Umm Sulaym said: Let no one inform Abu Talhah of his son's death until I am the one who tells him. She prepared the boy and laid him down. Abu Talhah came from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and went in to her. He said: How is my son? She said: O Abu Talhah, he has been calmer since he fell ill than he is at this moment. He said: Praise be to Allah. She brought him his supper, and he ate from it. Then she got up, perfumed herself, and presented herself to him, and he was intimate with her. When she knew that he had eaten and been intimate with her, she said: O Abu Talhah, what do you think: if some people lent something to another people as a loan, then asked for it back, would they have the right to refuse? He said: No. She said: Then Allah, Mighty and Majestic, lent you your son as a loan and has taken him back to Himself; so seek reward for your son and be patient. He became angry, then said: You left me until I had done what I did, then you informed me of my son's death! Then he went in the morning to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and told him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: May Allah bless you both in the rest of your night. And she conceived from that. Umm Sulaym used to travel with the Prophet (ﷺ), going out with him when he went out and entering with him when he entered. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When she gives birth, bring the child to me. The labor pains seized her one night when they were near Madinah, and she said: O Allah, I used to enter when Your Prophet entered and leave when Your Prophet left, and this matter has now come upon me. Then she gave birth to a boy, and said to her son Anas: Take the child to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Anas took the child and went to the Prophet (ﷺ), who was branding camels or sheep. When he saw him, he said to Anas: Has the daughter of Milhan given birth? He said: Yes. He put down what was in his hand, took the child, and said: Bring me some 'ajwah dates. The Prophet (ﷺ) took the dates and began to chew them and rub the child's palate, and the child began to smack his lips. He said: See how the Ansar love dates. So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) rubbed his palate and named him Abdullah.” Thabit said: “He was counted among the best of the Muslims.”

sections.title_ar: وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ زَيْدِ بْنِ جُدْعَانَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ .
sections.title_en: Ali ibn Zayd ibn Jud'an from Anas
